The proposed hybrid sequence set consists of two sequence subsets, namely a binary real sequence subset and its corresponding complex sequence subset. When such hybrid sequence set is used in a M-ary spread spectrum (MSS) OFDM communication system, the data rate of the MSS-OFDM system will be improved without any increase in PAPR. The construction method of PAPR-3dB hybrid sequence set is provided in this paper, and its corresponding performance is analyzed. Simulation results show the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Improved BP Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of improper learning rate setting and low accuracy caused by over-fitting in traditional BP deep neural network, an improved BP neural network algorithm is proposed. In this algorithm, drop-out mechanism is introduced to prevent neural network from overfitting, and in order to solve the problem of improper learning rate, exponential attenuated learning rate will be used instead of fixed learning rate in traditional BP neural network. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional BP neural network, the improved BP neural network can effectively improve the test accuracy by 3.06%.

articleTitle: Control operation circuit system design and simulation based on Multisim 13.0
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the control operation circuit system was designed to simulate and test the operation of the elevator in Multisim 13.0 software environment. The control operation circuit system was designed with 5 functional units: trigger latch circuit unit, code comparison circuit unit, count display circuit unit, feedback circuit unit, and delay circuit unit. Trigger latch circuit unit was used to generate, display and latch the request of elevator in different floors. Code comparison circuit unit was used to compare the current working floor number and the requested floor number. Count display circuit unit was used to display working status of current floor number. Feedback circuit unit was used to quench floor number indicator light when the elevator reaches the requested destination floor. Delay circuit unit was used to extend the period of stay on certain floor for the safety performance of the elevator. The result of simulation showed that the control operation circuit system worked well to realize the function needed.

articleTitle: BTReader: A High-Performance Fault Tolerant Self-Adaptive Broadcast Framework
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the environment of high-performance computing clusters, it is a common need for a large data file stored on cluster file systems to be broadcast fast to a large set of computing nodes. There are two methods to tackle this problem: MPI broadcast and concurrent read. The advantage of MPI broadcast is high data transfer efficiency, while it suffers from node faults and the complex interference environment. It also brings the side effect of synchronization. Concurrent read is fault tolerant and it can adapt to the complex interference environment. Each process can read asynchronously in the pattern of concurrent read. However, it suffers from the bandwidth bottleneck of the cluster file system. We propose a new broadcast framework called BTReader. BTReader provides the advantage of both MPI broadcast and concurrent read as well as avoids the disadvantage of MPI broadcast and concurrent read. Experimental results from a high-performance computing cluster shows that BTReader improves broadcast efficiency by 104.16% compared with MPI and promises robust fault tolerance ability and well adaptability to the complex interference environment.

articleTitle: A Low-cost Surface-mountable Transition for High-speed Digital and Wideband Millimeter-wave Packaging Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a low-cost and high-performance surface-mountable (SM) leadless transition structure for high-speed digital and wideband millimeter-wave packaging applications over a wide frequency range from DC up to the Ka band. This paper outlines the key issues involved in designing and optimizing the entire vertical transition path, starting from the top surface of a leadless surface mount package and ending at the print circuit board (PCB). The packages were manufactured in a standard, multilayer high-temperature co-fired ceramic (HTCC) process. The packages included 12 radio frequency (RF) input/output connections were sealed by the parallel seam welding sealing process, which ensured the good hermeticity, low cost and mass productivity. The ceramic packages were mounted on a PCB using standard surface-mount assembly process. The RF performance of the proposed transition structure was validated with on-wafer scattering parameter measurements. The measured results exhibit return and insertion loss values better than 15dB and 0.5dB, respectively, up to 40GHz. Moreover, the package shows the high thermal and mechanical reliability.

articleTitle: Faster All Convolutional Networks for SAR Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) has made great progress in the field of object classification in the past few decades. The most frequently used CNN structure is: convolutional layers + maximum pooling layers+ fully connected layers. In the classic structure, convolutional layers and fully connected layers are used for feature map extraction and classification respectively. In the maximum pooling layers, down-sampling is used to reduce the number of calculations of the whole structure. In order to reduce the loss of information caused by down-sampling, an improved version of CNN called an all convolutional networks (ACN), replaces maximum pooling layers with convolutional layers. In this paper, a faster ACN is proposed for SAR image classification. Compared to traditional ACNs, our faster ACN is built by inserting convolutional layers with descending stride, which is helpful for improving efficiency. Finally, experimental verification is performed on the MSTAR data set. Compared with traditional ACNs, our faster ACN can reduce the training time, while maintaining the same level of accuracy.

articleTitle: An Auction-based Pricing Model for Big Data Trading
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of big data industry, considerable attention has been paid to data trading in the big data markets. However, the problems of optimal pricing and trading data effectively between data owners and data users are far from well-studied. In this paper, we propose a pricing model based on auction mechanisms. The model provides a new approach to enable data trading efficiently and fairly. Furthermore, this model protects the process of auction from being manipulated by a new type of fraud called false-name bidding attacks, where attackers could use multiple anonymous identities to improve their utilities. The experimental results on thousands of simulated transactions show that our model achieves satisfying performance in terms of social surplus, which is the total utility of data owners and data users.

articleTitle: Visual closed loop in laser SLAM research
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of closed-loop detection errors in the graph-optimized laser SLAM algorithm in high-similarity scenes, we present a method of using binocular cameras for closed-loop detection. Use FAST feature points and BRIEF descriptors with rotation invariance for binocular depth estimation; and introduce the concept of local maps, use single-frame lidar data to match local maps, and improve the accuracy of the SLAM front-end. A k-ary tree dictionary based on the BoW (bag of words) model is used to evaluate the similarity of the pictures to complete the closed-loop detection, finally, construct a global optimization problem and solved it. After comparison experiments with mainstream open source lidar SLAM algorithms, it is shown that the research content improves the problem that the closed-loop detection method that only uses lidar data for closed-loop detection fails in a scene with high similarity, and the operation effect in a larger area is significantly better than that based on Filtered SLAM algorithm.

articleTitle: White blood cell segmentation based on dual path network and channel attention
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: White blood cell (WBC, leukocyte) in blood smear image plays a crucial role in the diagnosis of many blood diseases. WBC segmentation is an important preprocessing step in blood disease diagnosis. However, due to some factors such as different dying technologies and different WBC appearances, WBC segmentation is still challenging. To improve accuracy of WBC segmentation, we propose an end-to-end WBC segmentation network. Specifically, we first introduce Dual Path Network (DPN) as a context-aware feature encoder to extract multi-scale image features. Then, we use a channel attention module to capture the interdependencies between channel maps, and further enhance feature representation capability of the proposed network. Finally, we reconstruct WBC feature maps by a feature decoder, and use skip connections to reduce image information loss. Experimental results on three datasets show that the proposed method obtains higher segmentation accuracy than the other methods.

articleTitle: A Quantification Method of Harmonic Responsibilities Based on Current Tracing Principle
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A responsibility judgment of harmonic sources to loads in power systems is necessary for establishing economic reward and punishment mechanisms. Existing harmonic responsibility quantification methods mainly analyze the responsibility distribution between the user side and the grid side at the point of common coupling (PCC). The contributions of harmonic sources to each bus and branch cannot be quantified in power networks. This paper proposes a harmonic responsibility apportion method that can quantitatively analyze responsibility shares of harmonic sources in the whole power network. The current tracing principle is applied to establish the harmonic responsibility apportion model that represents the influence degree of harmonic sources. The harmonic current data of the entire network is substituted into the apportion model to obtain responsibility shares of harmonic sources at each bus and branch. The contribution of filters on harmonic suppression is analyzed based on the apportion model. Case studies on an IEEE 9-bus system are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Synchronous Binocular Visible Light Parallax Map for Face Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the binocular vision system, the parallax image is different when the real face of the three-dimensional structure is viewed from different viewing angles, while the face in photos and videos is flat or the planar structure is the same when viewed from different angles, so it is proposed A new method that uses a manual face binocular disparity map made by a synchronized binocular visible light camera combined with a convolutional neural network (convolutional neural network, CNN) to achieve two classifications. First, the Harr cascade classifier is used to extract faces in binocular images at the same time, and the extracted partial faces are made into a data set; then, the disparity map form that meets the experimental hypothesis is proposed and analyzed; finally, the ResNet18 network is used to compare different methods Binocular live body detection solution for human face. The accuracy rate of 99.12% is achieved on the self-made data set in the laboratory, and it has a good resistance to facial attacks on photos and videos. The results show that the method has a small amount of data, low hardware cost and good robustness to human faces due to changes in light and angle.

articleTitle: Fillet Design in Topology Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Topology optimization is a design tool to identify the best material layout in a prescribed design domain. Sharp connections between elements in the topology optimization results will cause stress concentration. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a fillet design method for density-based topology optimization. With the method, the Heaviside-based morphological filters are firstly constructed, which include the advanced open-close filter and close-open filter. Then, a dual projection method is proposed to achieve the round corner designs. Finally, the proposed method is tested through the compliance mechanism problem. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively avoid the appearance of sharp corners in the final designs. Moreover, the dual projection filters are prone to produce design without single hinge connections, which is beneficial for improving the manufacturability of the topology optimization results.

articleTitle: A new chaotic binary gravitational search algorithm and its algorithm test
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A new chaotic binary gravitational search algorithm (CBGSA) is proposed to accelerate the convergence speed and improve the searching precision of binary gravitational search algorithm. Firstly, the randomness, ergodicity and regularity of chaotic sequence are used to search the kbest set in order to enhance the global searching ability. Then the dynamic adjustment strategy of gravitational constant is introduced to increase the diversity of particles and improve the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm. Finally, by comparing the simulation test results of each algorithm in six typical functions, it is shown that CBGSA can effectively overcome the shortcomings of premature convergence, and has obvious advantages in convergence accuracy, convergence speed and stability.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Efficient User Association and Subchannel Assignment in Multi-Cell Multi-Carrier NOMA Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the problem of efficient user association and subchannel assignment in multi-cell multi-carrier nonorthogonal multiple access networks. An optimization problem is formulated to maximize the energy efficiency. The proposed solution includes two stages. First, we propose an iterative low complexity algorithm to handle the optimization problem. Second, we use the output from the iterative solution to train two deep neural network (DNN) models. To obtain the final output, the output of the DNNs are mapped in matrix which represents the final user association and subchannel assignment. The simulation results have shown the efficiency of the proposed framework compared to two step 2D matching algorithm and fractional programming (FP) method.

articleTitle: Induction Motor Electrical Fault Online Diagnosis Based on Joint Estimation Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To solve the online diagnosis difficult of the induction motors electrical faults, a new online diagnosis method based on the joint estimation unscented Kalman filter(UKF) is proposed in this paper. First, we studied the models of the broken rotor bars fault and the stator winding internal short fault of the induction motor, and it is determined that the rotor resistance and the stator resistance are used as the characteristic parameters of the online electrical fault diagnosis. Then, the state equation of the three-phase induction motor in the two-phase coordinate system is extended to the equation of state including the undetermined parameters for fault diagnosis. Finally, it is estimated based on the joint estimation UKF for the induction motor normal condition, broken rotor bars and stator winding internal short. The induction motor electrical faults are diagnosed online through an example. The result shows that the proposed method can realize the induction electrical fault diagnosis online quickly.

articleTitle: Analysis of pupil size amplitude signal in field fatigue detection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to extract the effective fatigue detection index from the weak pupil size change, the excavator driving comparative experiment was set up. The pupil information of the experimenter was detected under the given constant light environment. Fourier transform and statistical analysis of the collected data showed that the pupil of the task group decreased significantly after operation (P < 0.05) which was regarded as fatigue state. The amplitude of pupil size oscillation was clearly displayed when the pupil signal was converted from time domain to frequency domain. While in the control group, the pupil dilation was not significantly different from that before operation (P > 0.05) and the pupil amplitude did not change significantly. Experiments show that the amplitude of pupil size oscillation is more significant in frequency domain which is conducive to the application of pupil measurement method in reality.

articleTitle: Research on Construction and Application of Knowledge Mapping of Intelligent Transportation Inspection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The business knowledge of intelligent transportation inspection is scattered in the business system, database and expert experience, and it is impossible to visualize the entire business logic of transportation inspection. Aiming at the characteristics of complex and wide variety of operational inspection business relationships, an intelligent operational inspection knowledge mapping is constructed. Through the steps of operation inspection business ontology construction, knowledge acquisition, knowledge fusion, knowledge mapping display, knowledge mapping application and other steps, a logical knowledge mapping of operation inspection business is formed, which facilitates the recognition of the entire business relationship and assists the decision-making analysis of the operation inspection personnel.

articleTitle: Research and design of automatic dehumidification device for transformer conservator oil desiccant
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to prevent the humid air from entering the transformer oil during the cold and hot shrinkage of transformer oil, which will affect the insulation performance of transformer grease, a desiccant tank is commonly installed at the inlet of transformer conservator. The moisture absorption characteristics of silicone grease desiccant are used to solve the problem of wet air entering into transformer oil during the cold and hot shrinkage of transformer oil. However, with the long-term moisture absorption, the silica gel desiccant needs to be replaced when the humidity reaches a certain level, which may cause the transformer oil to enter the humid air. Therefore, this paper proposes to use the heater to automatically start the heater when the humidity reaches a certain degree, and automatically remove the moisture in the desiccant tank, so that the desiccant can be recycled. The actual use shows that the use of transformer conservator desiccant automatic dehumidifier can reduce the use cost of desiccant and save the manual and material resources when replacing the desiccant.

articleTitle: Slow Feature Analysis Based Quality Prediction for Slow Time-Varying Batch Processes
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Batch processes require effective quality analysis and prediction techniques to ensure product quality. In this paper, quality prediction work has been carried out for multiphase batch processes with slow time-varying characteristics based on the slow feature analysis (SFA) algorithm. To analyze the slow time-varying characteristics along the batch direction, sliding windows are constructed in the batch direction covering different batches, and accordingly a series of models are established using the SFA algorithm to capture the slow feature of the varying relationship between the process variables and the quality. At last, the proposed strategy is applied to the quality analysis and prediction of a typical slow time-varying batch process, the start-up process of the injection molding process, and the prediction results are compared with those obtained by the strategy using partial least squares (PLS) to build the regression models. The results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method in the quality prediction of slow time-varying batch processes.

articleTitle: Convolutional Recurrent neural network with attention mechanism based improved skip-gram algorithm for text sentiment classification
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of technology, increasing number of online data saved by texts has came into our life. Traditional machine learning classifier, such as SVM and naive Bayes, works well for many text classification tasks. However, these classifiers have sparsity problems and do not have long-term dependencies due to lack of text in short text and the limitations of convolutional and pooling layers. In this paper, we has designed a convolutional recurrent neural network based on improved skip-gram algorithm. We use L2 regularization method to adversarial training for skip-gram algorithm. It can not only improve the robustness and generalization ability of this model but also enhance the performance ability in text sentiment classification tasks. We used Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory network that includes attention mechanisms to get whole text information and reduce the effects of non-keywords. Finally, we realize text sentiment classification by CNNS. This model and algorithm were proved to be more effective and accuracy than other classifiers in the IMDB dataset.

Author Keywords: Bidirectional Long and short term memory network

articleTitle: Testing Research on the Modal Characteristics of Space Membrane Structure in Vacuum Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The space membrane structure has good application prospects in large spacecraft membrane antenna, solar sail and baffle because it has the advantages of low quality and small folding volume. The modal characteristics of membrane structure directly decide or to a large extent affect the surface accuracy maintenance and vibration control of the structure. The correctness of modal analysis needs to be verified by ground tests. Because the membrane structure is light and flexible, air has an important influence on its modal analysis results, so it is very necessary to carry out modal tests in vacuum environment. In this paper, taking the planar membrane structure as a research object, a set of modal testing system is designed and built, which is suitable for vacuum environment. The modal test under various working conditions is completed, and the effective test data are obtained. Through data processing and comparative analysis in this paper, not only the modal characteristics analysis of planar membrane structure is completed, but also the specific influence of air on the modal test results is summarized. This testing research lays a solid technical foundation for the modal characteristics investigation and design improvement of space membrane structure, which is of great engineering significance.

articleTitle: A Vision System for Shot Tracking and Thrown Distance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a vision system for the tracking of the shot and the measure of the thrown distance in a shot put competition. The pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) camera is used to capture images of the shot and track the shot to the landing position, and the lidar is used to measure the thrown distance once the landing position is determined. A new algorithm based on Hough gradient is developed in order to detect object quickly. The algorithm is further accelerated through GPU parallel computing and implemented on NVIDIA TX2. The control of the system is realized with an onboard arm processor. The system is able to handle video steam of 75 frame per second (FPS), where the image resolution is $640 \times 480$ pixels.

articleTitle: Step-length optimization based on genetic algorithm for a parallel mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of technology, parallel mobile robots have been paid more attention in various industries due to the strong load capacity, high running stability and rapid response speed. However, step-length optimization is an important but challenging task for this kind of mobile robot. Step length has dramatic effect on the stability of robot and the performance of electric cylinder. Balancing the speed characteristics and stability margin, we propose a genetic algorithm to solve this problem and design a novel fitness function that can measure the motion characteristics of parallel mobile robot. Effectiveness of our method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A Method of Phase Correction in Multichannel Channelized Receiver Based on Cubic Spline Interpolation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The phase difference caused by the inhomogeneity and temperature drift among the channels of the hardware device and the various channels of the multichannel digital channelized receiver will cause unpredictable errors in the subsequent positioning and direction finding results. This design implements the phase alignment based on cubic spline interpolation after the digital down conversion with the multiple data collected by the AD acquisition card by the MATLAB simulation platform. Through multiple experiments, the error is within an acceptable range while ensuring that the sample size meets statistical stability. The phase need to be corrected for each path is compensated by the regenerated local oscillator data to guarantee phase difference of each channel within one degree in this paper. In the design process, the local oscillator data with phase compensation and multichannel AD data are down converted, then the cubic spline interpolation algorithm is applied for phase calibration. The experimental data shows that the phase difference of each channel is controlled within one degree. Further data analysis and experiment can measure and calculate the time base error caused by AD and source amplifier board card. This method has important reference value to calibrate the hardware equipment index.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of UART Circuit of SoC Based on AMBA Bus
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: UART (Universal Asynchronous Receiver/transmitter) is a universal asynchronous transceiver used for serial data communication. It can not only receive data from peripheral devices, but also receive data from CPU, so as to achieve serial parallel conversion and parallel serial conversion. In this paper, a UART circuit based on AMBA (Advanced Microcontroller Bus Architecture) bus protocol is designed. The system bus is based on AXI protocol, and the low-speed module interface adopts APB bus. AXI bus communicates with APB bus through AXI-to-APB. UART is mounted on APB bus. The interactive communication between the system and external devices is realized in the system software. Quartus II is used for design and verification on FPGA chip. The verification results show that the transmission data is correct.

articleTitle: A Low Profile Log-Periodic Monopole Antenna with Top-Hat Loading
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A low profile log-periodic monopole antenna (LPMA) with Ultra-band (UWB) is proposed in this article. In order to reduce the profile, the proposed antenna is composed of two types of elements, including straight monopoles and top-hat loaded monopoles. It is fed by a microstrip-to-slotline transition network. Impedance matching is achieved by a microstrip stub and a slot stub. Compared with conventional LPMA, the profile of the proposed antenna is reduced by 199 % and it is only $0.071 \lambda$ (at 1.84 GHz). The overall size is 250 $\mathrm{mm} \times 45 \mathrm{mm} \times 11.6 \mathrm{mm}$. The simulated results shows that this LPMA has good reflection characteristics and stable radiation performance from 1.84 GHz to 13.9 GHz (VSWR <2.5).

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-Wideband T-junction Power divider Based on Rectangular Micro Coaxial Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, two ultra-wideband T-junction power divider based on rectangular micro coaxial structure are proposed. One is a 3-dB power divider and the other is a 2:1 unequal power divider. The rectangular micro-coaxial structure has the advantages of small size, ultra-wideband and small transmission loss, so the power divider based on this structure has good performance. The center conductor is slotted to realize device miniaturization. The simulation results show that the transmission loss is less than 0.3 dB from 60 GHz to 110 GHz in both dividers. And the return loss of 3-dB power divider and 2:1 unequal power divider are better than 19.5dB and 14dB respectively.

articleTitle: Improved Sliding Mode Control for Robust Trajectory Tracking of a Quadrotor UAV
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The problem of robust trajectory tracking control for a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with respect to parametric uncertainties and bounded external disturbances is investigated in this paper. The quadrotor dynamics are under-actuated, highly coupled and nonlinear, which make the control design problem challenging. Compared with the existing sliding mode control (SMC) methods, an improved SMC approach based on nonlinear sliding mode surfaces is developed in this paper to further reduce the controller parameters and maintain the trajectory tracking precision of a quadrotor UAV.

articleTitle: Research on elastic control method of hypersonic elastic vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to reduce the weight of hypersonic vehicle, improve its range and load capacity, the design concept of slender body and light weight is generally adopted, which makes its rigidity reduce and flexibility increase, and then leads to the reduction of elastic mode frequency, which is more and more close to the rigid body mode. in addition, it is also the static instability layout, so the aero-elastic coupling problem becomes particularly important. The “filter optimalization based on self-adaptive cuckoo search algorithm + Supertwisting active elastic control methods ”are studied to solve the problem. Based on the signals of attitude angle, angular velocity, generalized coordinates and the changing rate of generalized coordinates, the fast and accurate convergence of attitude tracking errors are realized under the premise of avoiding the excitation of vehicle vibration mode. The effectiveness and robustness of the control method are verified by mathematical simulation.

articleTitle: Atypical White Matter Amplitude of Low Frequency Fluctuation in Autsim – A Multivariate Pattern Analysis Study
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a type of neurodevelopmental disorder with unclear neuro-mechanism, which hinders the development of objective biomarkers for diagnosis. Previous studies have shown atypical grey matter function in individuals with ASD using the Amplitude of Low Frequency Fluctuation (ALFF) method. However, the white matter function is still unclear in ASD. In present study, resting state fMRI data from 64 individuals with ASD and 64 matched Healthy Controls (HC) were utilized. We calculated the amplitude of low frequency fluctuation of white matter of all subjects, then a searchlight Multivariate Pattern Analysis (MVPA) method was performed on these ALFF maps. Comparing with the HC group, the ASD showed atypical ALFF mainly in four white matter regions, which located at splenium of corpus callosum, body of corpus callosum, cingulum and anterior thalamic radiation. Meanwhile, the body of corpus callosum region could achieve the ASD/HC classification accuracy of 71.88%. The present study revealed atypical white matter function in ASD and showed the potential of white matter ALFF to become a diagnostic biomarker for ASD.

articleTitle: Estimation of tourism flow growth and spatial differentiation: A case study of Jilin Province
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The growth intensity and direction change of tourism flow in the region have an important impact on the regional tourism industry. In this study, an autoregressive distribution lag (ARDL) model is used to construct a tourism flow prediction model in Jilin Province, and a Markov chain model is used to construct a tourism flow transition state probability matrix in Jilin Province, and the spatial distribution of tourism flow in Jilin Province was studied. The study results shows that the fixed asset investment in Jilin Province has gradually reduced its contribution to the tourism industry, but the number of service personnel has gradually increased its contribution to the tourism industry, it indicate that the growth potential of tourism is strong in Jilin Province. In terms of the spatial distribution of tourism flows, the distribution of tourism flows is quite different in regions of Jilin Province. The results show that the spatial transfer trend of tourism flows across cities in Jilin Province is that the tourism population has a high probability of flowing to Yanbian, Changchun, and Jilin City. Baicheng, Siping, Songyuan, Tonghua and Baishan are the last. This research results could provide reference to the spatial planning and management of tourism industry in Jilin Province.

articleTitle: Accurate sEMG Classification for Hand Gesture Recognition Using Pattern Recognition Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a non-invasive method to collect electrical signals produced by muscles during motion. sEMG signals can be used to diagnose diseases, to assist in rehabilitation, control electric prosthesis, or to control robots. These signals are collected using flexible electrodes that are then stored into computers. Afterward, they are further processed to remove noise and extract meaningful features. An important application of sEMG is classification of hand gestures to control electric upper limp prosthesis. These prothesis can either be used to augment a human ability or restore a lost function to increase quality of life. In this paper, we preprocess the sEMG signal, extract hand-crafted features, then apply a proposed classification architecture to classify seven hand gestures achieving an intuitive control to a hand prosthesis. Our proposed model consists of one binary Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier and one multiclass Artificial Neural Network (ANN) classifier, instead of a single multiclass classifier model. The proposed approach achieved an average improvement of 2% in precision recall and f1 score for all seven gestures in comparison with a single multiclass baseline classifier. The proposed architecture has the ability to classify seven gestures with an average accuracy of 99% using only two electrodes in a short time frame of 200 ms.

articleTitle: Smart MICE: Definitions, Foundations and Development
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Smart MICE has been increasingly applied to describe the integration of technologies into Meetings, Incentive Travels, Conventions/Conferences and Exhibitions (MICE) industry. However, Smart MICE lacks definitional clarity and the understanding of its theoretical foundation is unclear. This paper aims to provide a clarified definition, and analyze technological and business foundations for Smart MICE. Among similar concepts, MICE informatization is the adoption and application process of management information systems. Online MICE is the combination of online conference and online exhibition. Smart MICE is an upgrade and logical progression of MICE industry. Based on literature reviews, three tiers of Smart MICE are high-tech service industry, smart experience enhancement and complex business network. Technologies in Smart MICE are applied for infrastructure and framework, feedback and experience, and identifying and tracking. Value proposition and components of partners are key factors in Smart MICE business model. Technological and business foundations are analyzed to gain a better perspective of Smart MICE. Future areas of research agendas are discussed to facilitate the development of Smart MICE.

articleTitle: Automated Scenario Generation and Evaluation Strategy for Automatic Driving System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new automated generation algorithm of test scenario for automatic driving systems, which is called Combinatorial Testing Based on Complexity (CTBC). Moreover, a new automatic evaluation strategy is proposed, which can conduct the test automatically and efficiently. With the defined concept of scenario complexity, we use CTBC algorithm to generate a more compact and effective set of test scenarios and find the optimal parameter considering both effectiveness and testing cost by the Bayesian optimization algorithm. Then, a hierarchical clustering method is used to partition the generated scenarios into clusters with high similarity. Finally, a two-way evaluation considering both the availability of test scenarios and the performance of the system under test is carried out on the automatic testing system. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is validated by applying it to a Traffic Jam Pilot system on a hardware-in-the-loop test platform. The results show that the bigger the complexity of scenario is, the easier it is to reveal system defects. Furthermore, the proposed algorithm can shift the overall complexity distribution of the test scenarios significantly to a higher place while ensuring the coverage.

articleTitle: Detection and Analysis of Fetal Movements Using an Acoustic Sensor-based Wearable Monitor
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Monitoring of fetal movements (FM) is considered an important part of fetal well-being assessment due to its association with several fetal health conditions, e.g. fetal distress, fetal growth restriction, hypoxia, etc. However, the current standard methods of FM quantification, e.g. ultrasonography, MRI, and cardiotocography, are limited to their use in clinical environments. In this paper, we evaluate the performance of an acoustic sensor-based, cheap, wearable FM monitor that can be used by pregnant women at home. For data analysis, we develop a thresholding-based signal processing algorithm that fuses outputs from all the sensors to detect FM automatically. Obtained results demonstrate the promising performance of the system with a sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy of 83.3%, 87.8%, and 87.1%, respectively, relative to the maternal sensation of FM. Finally, a spike-like morphology of acoustic signals corresponding to true detected movements is found in the time-frequency domain through spectrogram analysis, which is expected to be useful for developing a more advanced signal processing algorithm to further improve the accuracy of detection.

articleTitle: A Review on Deep Learning Techniques Applied to Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Object detection has received great attention in recent years. Traditional machine learning object detection pays more attention to extract interpretable features. Deep learning uses CNN for self-learning features, which greatly improves the accuracy. This article summarized and analyzed the existing deep learning object detection method from one-stage and two-stage object detection methods. The roadmap of deep learning target detection is comprehensively analyzed. We have compared the detection performance of typical deep learning target detection algorithms. Finally, aiming at the problems and development trend of machine vision, we make prediction and prospect for the application and development of object detection in the future.

articleTitle: Cooperative communications in 5G point-to-multipoint systems for Smart Grid Communications
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of wireless communication network, 5G H-CRAN network has gradually become the focus of research. The increasing demands for mobile data multimedia services and high bandwidth multimedia services require the network to provide efficient multicast services in smart grid communications. The multicast effect is mainly determined by the worst users of QoS in all multicast users, which are clustered at the edge of the cell. Therefore, there is a need to find ways to enhance the user experience in the edge area. In this paper, a 5G multicast enhancement scheme based on cooperative transmission is proposed, which can effectively enlarge the coverage of the network and improve the signal quality of edge users. We model and discuss the effect of cooperative transmission enhancement through different collaboration patterns. We define the system to ensure effective throughput metrics in the process of cooperative enhancement equalization. The simulation results show that cooperative mode selection of QoS is guaranteed in different systems.

articleTitle: Review on the Architectures and Applications of Deep Learning in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This article is a brief review of the architectures of the state-of-the-art deep learning networks, including Deep Belief Networks (DBNs), AutoEncoders (AEs), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and their applications in agriculture. The paper is organized as follows. First, a brief introduction to some basic concepts is conducted to clarify the widely spoken terms. Then, main deep learning architectures are introduced, and characteristics of them are compared briefly. Thirdly, by surveying related literatures in the applications of the above architectures in agriculture, the typical and proper applications of each structure are summarized and analyzed. Last but not least, the challenges and outlook of deep learning networks are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Application of EPA Real-Time Industrial Ethernet in Ship Control Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The existing ship platform monitoring systems generally use can bus as the control network. The bus network has the disadvantages of small bandwidth, low transmission rate, difficult expansion and poor versatility, which is difficult to meet the application requirements of integrated platform monitoring, management and control in the development of ship informatization. In order to realize the integrated integration of ship platform control network, this paper proposes an application scheme of building ship platform integrated control network by using EPA real-time industrial Ethernet technology. By analyzing the transmission requirements of platform application business for control network, combined with the technical characteristics of EPA real-time industrial Ethernet, and taking typical ship application as background, the topology of platform integrated control network is analyzed The corresponding suggestions are given for the key problems such as structure, equipment composition, networking mode and communication scheduling mode, which can provide reference for the design and application of ship integrated control network.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Model based on Chi-square Test and Stacking Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of the Internet, the amount of network data continues to grow. IDS based on traditional machine learning algorithms faces the following problems. On the one hand, massive data may reduce the detection efficiency. On the other hand, IDS based on the single machine learning model shows a trend of diminishing marginal utility. To deal with these aforementioned issues and ensure the security of network, this paper proposes a network intrusion detection model based on chi-square test and stacking approach. Firstly, in order to reduce the difficulty of learning and detection tasks, chi-square test is used to select the effective features to reduce the dimensionality of the dataset. Secondly, to optimize detection accuracy, we build a more powerful intrusion detection model by ensemble learning stacking approach, which integrates multiple machine learning algorithms such as SVM, BPNN, K-Means and XGBoost. At the same time, the K-Fold cross-validation method is used to train this model to reduce possible overfitting. This model is verified using the NSL-KDD dataset. The results obtained from the experiments show that the proposed model performs better in the field of intrusion detection than the single machine learning model. The accuracy, precision and recall reached 97.9%, 95.2% and 98.7%, respectively.

articleTitle: Time Sequence Prediction for Unmanned Surface Vehicle Collision Avoidance based on LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the near future, unmanned surface vehicle (USV) will be tested frequently at sea and will certainly coexist with manned ships. USV should behave like human pilots to determine when to maintain a planned course, and when to avoid collisions. A supervised deep learning approach, incorporating maneuvering avoidance actions of human pilot as labels, can resolve this problem competently. In contrast to previous studies, this study proposes a deep learning-based conflict resolution method for collision avoidance of USV. A Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) artificial neural network model is constructed. The model is capable to yield a prediction of the avoidance desired course by utilizing time sequential information from the past related to the own vehicle and target vehicles as inputs. Simulation of navigation in a head-on encounter scenario verifies that the proposed LSTM model can achieve human-like effects when performing avoidance actions.

articleTitle: Polyphonic Sound Event Detection Based on CapsNet-RNN and Post Processing Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Sound event detection (SED) aims to detect the onset and offset times of sound events and gives a label to each event. In real-world, polyphonic SED is a challenging task because multiple sound events may occur at the same time. Recently, deep learning has offered valuable techniques for it, such as convolutional neural networks (CNN) and recurrent neural networks (RNN). In this paper, we design a new model that a combination of the capsule neural networks (CapsNet) and RNN, for the detection layers, we use various temporal segmentation methods and optimization algorithms to obtain the best performing threshold. CapsNet overcomes some limitations of CNN, such as the loss of position information after max-pooling. The RNN mainly models the temporal dependency of context information. The combination of CapsNet and RNN greatly enhances the relationships of part and whole, and improves the experiment performance in polyphonic SED. Experiments on the TUT-Sound Events 2017 show that the proposed approach improves ER by 21% and F1-score by 39.6% absolute compared with the state-of-the-art algorithms, respectively.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pseudo Labels Sampling for Semi-Supersvied Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Person re-identification approaches based on deep learning have recently advanced considerably. However, most of the existing re-ID studies focus primarily on closed-set applications and neglect realistic, open-world settings; this limitation restricts the application of person re-ID in practice. Generally, closed-set re-ID methods usually assume that annotated data is sufficient for use when training or testing a deep learning model. However, in open-set applications, it is unrealistic to collect and annotate a available number of training data. For this purpose, we proposed a semi-supervised learning person re-identification method by dynamic pseudo-labelled data sampling. Using the dynamic pseudo labels sampling framework to fully exploit labelled and unlabelled data, we train and optimize the model in an iterative process. The semi-supervised learning method labels only a subset of pedestrians, while the single-sample learning method labels only one data point for each pedestrian. Then, a pseudo label is generated for the unlabelled data, and the labelled data and a subset of the pseudo-labelled data are then used as an extended dataset for training. To make use of the unlabelled data, pseudo labels are generated from the unlabelled data with a dynamic strategy. Based on the predicted confidence, only use selected pseudo-labelled data for training, and the Convolution Neural Network (CNN) model is updated through retraining with an extended dataset. The effectiveness of this method is demonstrated by experiment on publicly available datasets. Compared with the state-of-the-art methods, the performance is improved.

articleTitle: A Solution Analysis of U.S. Weapon Equipment Systems-of-Systems Development and Application
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, the development and deployment of the U.S. weapon equipment systems-of-systems (SoS) have yielded rich research results. However, there are still large gaps in the SoS development, joint testing, and design and acquisition of our own equipment SoS. The barriers of these steps have not yet been opened up. This article mainly analyzes the solutions of the U.S. weapon equipment SoS from three aspects, such as capability-based requirement generation and architecture design technology, interconnected-oriented integration test technology, and weapon equipment design and acquisition technology based on complex adaptive systems. We explore key technologies involved in order to form an overall understanding and explore related research approaches.

articleTitle: The application of CNN-LightGBM algorithm in remaining useful life prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is an important content of aero-engines prediction and health management. There are many single models to research the RUL. However, many complexity equipment has the character of many state variables and severe nonlinear features, and a single model faces the challenge of feature extraction inadequately. The lack of prediction accuracy makes it difficult to predict the RUL of machine’s accuracy. To address this problem, a new type of model combined with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and LightGBM’s integrated learning method is approached to RUL’s prognosis. The features of the raw data are extracted by convolutional neural network firstly, then the output of the convolutional neural network is used as the inputs of LightGBM model for RUL predictions. In order to validate the effectiveness of above approach, experiments on the dataset provided by NASA (C-MAPSS) are carried out, and the result shows that the prediction error after fusing CNN with LightGBM is decreased significantly compared with the same parameter settings CNN and LightGBM models alone, which validate the efficiency of the integrated model for remaining useful life prediction.

articleTitle: Cooperative Vehicle-Infrastructure System Use Case Design for Smart Highway
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart highway construction in domestic and foreign transportation systems, an increasingly number of countries have begun to explore and improve the deployment and development of cooperative vehicle-infrastructure system in smart highway. According to China’s “New-Generation National Traffic Control Network and Smart Highway Pilots Project”, it is significant to enhance traffic safety, efficiency and capacity. However, there is difficulty in the cooperative vehicle-infrastructure use case design. Based on the full analysis of the development status at home and abroad and the analysis of actual engineering needs, this paper came up with the architecture of cooperative vehicle-infrastructure system based on edge computing technology, combined with the current smart highway demonstration project. After feature, demand and policy analysis of the smart highway project, this paper put forward the cooperative vehicle-infrastructure use case design. The use cases are feasible and practical in Jilin and Zhejiang province. The use case design and analysis have significant guiding role for the research and development and engineering implementation of the smart highway cooperative vehicle-infrastructure system in China.

articleTitle: Urban Environmental Sound Monitoring Network Based on Combination of Mobile and Stationary Nodes
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Urban noise has posed a threat to people's physical and mental health. Significant progress has been made in noise monitoring related projects at home and abroad, but these projects usually utilize stationary monitoring equipment to measure noise whose deployment is susceptible to the cost and complex urban environment and thus they cannot effectively cover the monitored area. In this paper, a kind of joint mobile and stationary nodes based urban environmental sound monitoring network is proposed to achieve low-cost, high-precision, and high-flexibility noise monitoring. The network adopts NETTY framework, which effectively alleviates the impact of high concurrency on server performance in the context of large-scale sensor nodes. In addition, this paper designs a visual monitoring platform for the display of noise distribution and abnormal sound events. In order to verify the performance of the system, 10 mobile nodes and 50 stationary nodes are deployed in the campus environment. The experimental results show that the proposed system can realize urban environmental noise monitoring with high performance in real scenes.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence factors of online teaching on the psychological status of the students in Vocational Colleges during the epidemic of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Objective: To understand the psychological status and influencing factors of college students during the online teaching under the COVID-19 outbreak, so as to provide scientific basis for the mental health education of the population group in the future. Methods: Using the method of stratified cluster sampling and self-compiled questionnaire, the students of a vocational college in Hebei province were investigated by network questionnaire. Results: Among the 4827 college students surveyed, 1138 showed anxiety, with a detection rate of 23.6%. The detection rate of depression was 10.7% in 516 patients. The incidence of anxiety was 21.4% in boys and 24.6% in girls ($\chi$2=6.024,P=0.014); The incidence of depression was 9.4% in boys and 11.3% in girls $(\chi 2=4.248, {\mathrm {P}}=0.039)$; The results of the unconditioned Logistic regression showed that: female and senior students with poor hardware and network conditions, dissatisfaction with online teaching, difficulty in completing homework, and poor self-control were more likely to suffer from anxiety. The OR values(95% CI)were 0.646(0.590$\sim$0.706),0.899(0.853$\sim$0.946), 0.822(0.752$\sim$0.899), 1.151(1.019$\sim$1.301), 1.221(1.144$\sim$1.303), and 0.867(0.840$\sim$0.895), respectively. And female students with poor hardware and network conditions, dissatisfaction with online teaching, difficulty in completing assignments, and poor self-control were more likely to suffer from depression. The OR values(95% CI) were 0.863 (0.757$\sim$0.985), 0.841(0.739$\sim$0.956), 1.243(1.059$\sim$1.460), 1.059(1.012$\sim$1.107) and 0.904(0.864$\sim$0.946), respectively. Conclusion: The psychological problems of anxiety and depression in college students during online teaching should not be ignored. Colleges and universities should strengthen the psychological counseling for college students and promote their healthy growth.

articleTitle: LSS target threat estimation and capture prediction trajectory simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To address the potential airspace security threats of "low, slow, and small" targets, a dynamic Bayesian network model is used to determine the multi-target potential threat value’ and then establish the threat level. The target with the highest threat value is captured, and the improved A-Star algorithm is used. The size of the search space is reduced by combining with the maneuvering performance of the rotor-type UAV to improve the efficiency of real-time capture trajectory planning. Through simulation experiment analysis and verification, the multi-target threat value given by the dynamic Bayesian network was consistent with that in the expert experience evaluation. At the same time, the improved A-Star algorithm can give the optimal capture trajectory of the target with the greatest potential threat.

articleTitle: Image Inpainting Using Multi-Scale Neural Network and Shift-Net
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Image Inpainting is to repair the images with given mask or missing area and produce a realistic fake image similar to the original image. Methods with Generative Adversarial Networks(GANs) and deep convolutional neural network(CNNs) have achieved great performance on generating visual plausible results. However, those results still have blurry issues on restored region and unpleasant boundaries. Based on these problems, a two-phase neural network method is proposed to produce better results on image inpainting in this paper. The proposed method adopts the Shift-Net [1] as the first phase to generate primary images, which are then fed into refinement network (the second phase) for further detailed texture restoring. This model adopts improved Wasserstein GAN(WGAN-GP) to ensure the training stability and performance on generating high-resolution images. Experiments on shows the proposed model can produce clear and realistic plausible face images. Through the comparison with state-of-the-art methods on both PSNR and SSIM metrics, the proposed method has a better performance on recovering the feature information on missing region.

articleTitle: Multi-lane discontinuous lane line instance segmentation based on discrimination loss function
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the emergence of new technologies such as 5G networks and data centers, traditional infrastructure such as transportation, energy, water conservancy and municipal government have the basis for intelligent technological transformation. Smart high-precision maps are an important part of smart transportation and autonomous driving. That our automatically lane line segmentation provide technical support for high-precision navigation maps. There are two kinds of lane line segmentation methods currently, one is segmenting all lane lines in the scene semantically, and then uses post-processing for single-lane clustering, and the second uses the semantic or instance segmentation to split the pseudo-pixel-level continuous lane lines. For the instance segmentation of non-continuous lane line is still to be further studied, this paper proposed a LaneNet+ network to achieve lane line (including non-continuous lane line) instance segmentation end-to-end, this paper draws on the LaneNet neural network architecture, builds multitasking networks, semantically split network and embedded space network, respectively, and then cluster each lane line and achieve lane line instance segmentation. The total loss function is the arithmetic average of the semantic segmentation network loss function and the embedded space network loss function. The training sample dataset is a pixel-level labelled photos taken by the car’s dashcam, with a sample size of 12k, a number of iterations of 90,000, and the model was trained on the server of 2 Nvidia GPUs for approximately 12 hours. The model accuracy rate is 95%. Lane line instance segmentation can accurately distinguish the lane lines of different lane numbers, after that converted to the geographic coordinate system, and combine the GPS positioning information of the vehicle, then lane-level positioning and navigation of the vehicle can be realized.

articleTitle: Analysis of Requirements and Architecture of the Next Generation Flight Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The increase in air traffic flow and the increase in environmental awareness have put forward higher requirements for today’s air navigation systems. How to apply new technologies to safely solve these problems is a problem that the new generation of air navigation systems needs to address. As the air node in the navigation system, the flight management system plays an important role in ensuring flight safety and reducing environmental impact. Through the analysis of the research status of the air navigation system, the functional requirements of the new generation flight management system are sorted out and analyzed, and the typical functions are further analyzed. Take a flight management system architecture as an example to demonstrate how to meet the functional requirements of the new generation flight management system, and analyze the important modules in the system. On this basis, it is recommended to further study the technical direction of the new generation flight management system.

articleTitle: Research on Massiveness Characteristics Weights of Big Knowledge Based on the Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Faced with massive, heterogeneous, and autonomous data resources, the term of “Big Knowledge (BK)” has been proposed to deal with challenges in the era of Big Data. Researchers have defined the “BK”, and studied the massiveness characteristics of BK But no specific weight reference value is given for the rules of each characteristic. Therefore, by combining qualitative and quantitative research, this paper explores five basic massiveness characteristics of big knowledge: massive concepts, massive connectedness, massive clean data resources, massive cases and massive confidence. This paper mainly explores the weight of five massiveness characteristics related to “big knowledge” based on the Grey Relation Analysis (GRA) combined Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA). Simultaneously, it explores the correlation between the Five Large-scale Knowledge Engineering Projects and Big Knowledge. The obtained reference relevance which provides a certain reference for measuring large-scale knowledge engineering projects in the future. Finally, the research perspective of BK is analyzed.

articleTitle: Portable Gesture Recognition Based on Flexible Stretchable Electronic Skin
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In response to the large size and high price of traditional wearable gesture recognition systems, we presented a gesture recognition system based on self-developed flexible electronic skin (e-skin) with the advantages of easy portability, low cost and high recognition rate. Fourteen flexible sensors were integrated into the e-skin gesture recognition glove, which could monitor the movement of each finger joint. Meanwhile, an accelerometer was integrated, which could collect rollover information of the wrist. Furthermore, we innovatively proposed an improved dynamic time warping (DTW) algorithm to build a gesture template library, which is used to recognize complex and continuously changing gestures. Finally, the recognition results are displayed in the form of text, pictures and even the voice broadcast. Continuous recognition experiments on eight daily gestures were carried out, and the segmentation accuracy and recognition accuracy of continuous gestures is 97.49% and 93.73% respectively, which can meet the needs of deaf-mute people for normal communication with the outside world.

articleTitle: 3D Liver and Tumor Segmentation in CT Scans with Robust Self-Paced Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Liver segmentation is a challenging problem where fully supervised deep learning models require large amounts of voxel-wise labels, which are usually laborious, expensive, and time consuming to obtain. However, massive non-annotated 3D CT volumes are usually easily accessible. Most deep learning based works to address semi-supervised CT medical image segmentation problems have mostly been graph-based or adversarial-based. In sharp contrast, this work investigates the potential of a semi-supervised learning method; novel self-training framework utilizing self-paced learning strategy to generate and select pseudo-labels from easy-to-transfer(well represented classes) to hard-to-transfer(less represented classes) samples. The proposed scheme introduces an effective pseudo-label generation and selection algorithm to generate highly confident pseudo-labels, jointly learn and optimize a model which can be solved by alternatively generating pseudo labels on unlabeled target data and re-training the model with the generated labels. Further, we also propose a novel class balancing framework to avoid the gradual eminence of easy-to-transfer discriminative features on pseudo-label generation utilizing class-wise normalization of confidence scores. Comprehensive experiments conducted on publicly available datasets show that the proposed method outperformed other state-of-the-art semi-supervised and some fully supervised methods on the segmentation results of tumors and achieved very competitive performance for liver segmentation.

articleTitle: Path Modeling based on Entity-Connectivity for Knowledge Base Completion
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Knowledge reasoning aims to infer missing facts based on existing facts in the knowledge base(KB), which is also known as knowledge completion. The representation learning method uses certain formula as a constraint to embed the triples of facts (head, tail, relations) into the low-dimensional continuous vector space. Since there are not only direct inference pattern but also indirect inference pattern in fact relation inference. PTransE introduce graph feature model into the embedded and make the indirect relation path also participate in translation training. However, indirect relationships has widened the differences on the number of high-connectivity entities (multi-connectivity entities) and low-connectivity entities in the training. The more closer related entities in the graph will be more closely related to each other, and the weaker ones will be weaker, which leads to the unfitting of the low-connectivity entities. In this paper, we propose PTransE based on entity-connectivity (C-PTransE) model to optimize the evaluation function by adjusting the proportion of distance score and path score according to the high and low connectivity of entities. ln this way, the isolation of the high-connectivity entity from the low-connectivity entity can be alleviated, and the overfitting of the high-connectivity entity can be alleviated. A large number of experiments on real data sets show that this method can make link prediciton more effectively.

articleTitle: The Application Study of Credit Risk Model In Financial Institution via Machine-learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As a kind of statistical model, credit scoring technology is widely used in the risk assessment of loan applicants. It can predict the credit risk of applicants based on the information provided by the borrowers, such as their historical data and the data from banking system. Based on the data provided by a financial institution, this paper focuses on the credit risk analysis and evaluation based on machine learning algorithms, including Logistic Regression algorithm, Decision Tree algorithm, and Random Forest algorithm. What’s more, this paper completes data preprocessing, variable selection, WOE coding discretization and credit scorecard creation. The basic score of this credit scorecard is 750 points. The probability of default will double when the score is reduced by every 60 points. The experimental results exhibit machine learning algorithms are feasible approaches to evaluate credit. Besides, within the study’s training and testing samples, such objective evaluation parameters as precision, recall, AUC, KS, and F1 score, which indicate Random Forest algorithm, Decision Tree algorithm, and Logistic Regression algorithm can all apply to financial risk analysis.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Visualization: An Application in Tourism Logo Research Using CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the past, limited research applied Bibliometric visualization to explore the intellectual structure of academic tourism knowledge. This study uses CiteSpace to analyze and visualize the knowledge structure in the field of tourism logo. Through quantitative statistical analysis of 79 scholarly publications related to tourism logo on Web of Science (WoS) from 1983 to 2019, the paper identifies and visualizes the evolution of the theme, the collaboration network, as well as documents of the most popular topics that many pieces of research have cited, such as “ tourism organization ”, “ reframing device ”, “ brand element ”, and “ community branding ”. More importantly, in the keyword co-occurrence analysis, this study provides new directions despite hot keywords for further tourism logo research, such as “ heritage tourism”, “nation branding”, and “logo design”. What’ s more, applying a new Bibliometric visualization technique is beneficial to the development of Bibliometrics.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-User Slicing Technology for 5G Transmission Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The power grid control business requires "physical isolation" from the collection business transmission channel. The application of the three major 5G scenarios proposes that different scenarios require different network capabilities. Therefore, the proposed network slicing can effectively ensure the network quality of different transmission levels of the network. Network slicing requires different transmission channel networks to achieve "physical isolation", and as an important component of 5G end-to-end slicing, the back-transmission network is necessary to conduct research on multi-user slicing of the transmission network. In response to the challenges faced by 5G transmission network slicing, the article proposes a hierarchical slicing management and control architecture based on the idea of centralized hierarchical collaboration. It sets up an industrial structure based on domain controllers and transmission resource orchestrators and builds a test and verification platform to verify Transmission network slicing for 5G multi-users. The test results show that the system can realize multi-purpose slice management function and good slice isolation, effectively support the application of 5G network in the power grid and meet the requirements of power grid isolation.

articleTitle: The Real-Time All-In-Software CNC Engraving System Design Based On RTX Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: there are uncertainties in quite a few of simulative applications caused by poor real-time performance of the Windows Operation System. On the basis of full demonstration, the author introduces RTX, a Windows based solution for real time from IntervalZero Inc. and concludes the designing method of RTX real time system in Windows environment, as well as, the programming of main function modules of all-in-software CNC engraving system under RTX in combination with the design requirements of a certain type of CNC engraving. In the end, this method is applied to a certain CNC engraving system successfully and the experimental result demonstrates that the system is reliable and steady, with the correct result and without any loss of data, during the entire experiment. The all-in-software program can satisfy the demands of the CNC engraving system in real time based on RTX platform.

articleTitle: A hybrid algorithm for three-dimensional loading capacitated vehicle routing problems with time windows
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Online shopping and fierce competition among logistics companies have led to unprecedented demand for logistics services. However, recent studies on the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) have considered only simple constraints. In this paper, we combine the Three-Dimensional Loading Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (3L-CVRP) with the Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (VRPTW) and describe a variant of the VRP, named 3L-CVRPTW. Apparently, 3L-CVRPTW accounts for the actual needs in the logistics industry. To address this problem, we first propose an innovative method for loading problems, applying a strategy of grouping customers, and adjusting the sequence of the boxes, which improves the loading efficiency. On this basis, we propose the Tabu-Neighborhood search and combine it with the Artificial Bee Colony(ABC), to generate the approximate optimal route. Compared with the recent relevant studies, our approach has a better performance on Zhang’s benchmarks and Solomon’s VRPTW instances.

Author Keywords: Three-Dimensional Loading Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem

articleTitle: Combining user interest and feedback in an online book personalized recommendation system
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of electronic business platform, more and more people buy something they need by the Internet. Also, a large amount of people purchase book from the web. In this condition, a great quantity of data is aggregated, which makes search, retrieval, and discovery of books become difficult and complex. It is highly desirable to provide personalized services with high quality for users from the perspective of respecting their privacy. In order to address these issues and reduce the impact of information distance on users, book recommendation system is based on data mining. In this paper, we develop an online book recommendation system, which combines user interest and book feedback information on the basis of privacy protection. User preference parameter and user parameter come up for a better personalized recommendation acceptance rate. Meanwhile, we describe an online evaluation experiment performed on a web site. We compare it against another recommendation system based on association rules without the user preference parameter and user parameter. The results show that the proposed recommendation scheme shows advantages with respect to association rules on higher user acceptance rate.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Radio for 6G
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
