abstract: This paper discusses the functional requirements of 6G radio, which is driven by the emerging 6G scenarios identified by a concise interconnection model. Then, a multifunctional radio framework is proposed as a solution for 6G radio, which aims to extend the radio functions from wireless transmission to computing and sensing. The new introduced functions can be exposed to 3-party to support more emerging services. The key issues of capability exposure, unified waveforms, resource scheduling, joint data processing, and service continuity are also addressed.

articleTitle: Node classification problem based on potential information and representation learning between nodes
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Representation learning of social network nodes refers to the feature expression of nodes in low-dimensional vector space. Most of the current methods are based on the network topology to achieve node feature learning, but the potential information of the network topology is not fully utilized. To solve this problem, we propose a graph embedding algorithm based on the similarity between nodes. This method obtains a new network topology through the second-order similarity between nodes. This network topology can enhance the correlation between nodes, thereby improving the effect of node classification in the network. We use Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 evaluation indicators to evaluate the benchmark algorithm and the SNE algorithm proposed in this paper on four real data sets. The experimental results show that the SNE algorithm can improve the effect of node classification.

articleTitle: Selection and scheduling of perception resources based on group intelligence perception technology in network autopilot
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to ensure that the representative car can guarantee the quality of the perceived information while minimizing the total cost of the perceived task in the group intelligence perception information of common perceptual road conditions. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes a combination of greedy algorithm and genetic algorithm to compare the vehicle selection method generally used to solve the knapsack problem. There are many improvements in the overall data reliability of the representative car. The experimental results show that the overall data reliability of representative vehicles has been greatly improved, the total task processing time is reduced and the average perception data reliability of representative vehicles is improved.

articleTitle: Modeling customer satisfaction of bus transit with bus lanes based on ordinal regression
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To support the reconstruction of bus lanes, a customer satisfaction survey of bus transit based on passenger experience was conducted in Shanghai, obtaining with 1,860 valid samples along 16 bus lanes. The survey aimed to understand how bus passengers perceive bus lanes and which factors influence their level of satisfaction. An ordinal regression model was built to explain passenger satisfaction with the service quality of bus lanes. Two types of factors, including bus system operation indicators and passenger attributes, were presented in the model with different influences. It was found that the demands of passengers who worked in government, enterprise, or institution, or in liberal or self-employed professions, and who took the bus for commuting purposes need to be prioritized. It is necessary to pay more attention to bus ridership and the waiting time at bus stops along bus lanes when canceling old lanes and adding new lanes.

articleTitle: Local partition subdivision algorithm for approximate nearest neighbor query
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper solves the problem of approximate nearest neighbor queries on high-dimensional large data sets. The two most representative methods to solve the approximate nearest neighbor query problem on high-dimensional and large-scale data sets are based on inverted multi-index and based on inverted index. The query algorithm based on the inverted multi-index requires frequent access operations to the memory, which causes more waste of resources than the query operation based on the distance order. Traditional query algorithms based on inverted indexes need to divide the entire feature space into a large number of regions to ensure the accuracy of query results when solving the problem of high-dimensional large data sets, so a large amount of space resources are required. Based on the inverted index, a query algorithm is proposed. Through the subdivision process of Voronoi Cells that are initially divided into part of the original data set, the purpose is to significantly improve the high-dimensional data set without dividing a large number of regions. On the query performance, and avoid frequent access operations to the random access memory. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the proposed method not only effectively improves the query processing efficiency, but also ensures the accuracy of the query.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method for Bearing and Gear Based on Deep Learning Waveform Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A fault diagnosis method for bearing and gear based on deep learning waveform image recognition is proposed in this paper. The method can extract valid fault features automatically from time and frequency domain waveform curves of raw vibration signal and complete fault diagnosis. The training method for CNN model based on deep learning combined with transfer learning is designed, which needs only a small amount of faults sample data. The fault diagnosis algorithm and steps are given. The method is tested with a set of time and frequency domain vibration waveform data of gears and bearings in normal and different fault states. The results show that the proposed method has high recognition accuracies for the different types of faults and has good applicability.

articleTitle: A Clustering Routing Algorithm for Extending the Lifecycle in WSN
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to extend the life of wireless sensor networks and improve the stability of wireless sensor networks, a cluster head election mechanism based on energy center of gravity and regional segmentation is proposed. The sensor network monitoring area was divided into finite subregions, and the common nodes of each subregion competed for cluster heads in their own regions, which made the distribution of cluster heads in the whole network more uniform. Each sub-region node is selected for the cluster head based on two factors: energy center and communication distance. The cluster head is responsible for receiving the data perceived by ordinary nodes in the region, and the received information is fused and compressed and transmitted to the base station, thus solving the problems of uneven cluster head distribution and unbalanced node energy loss in the clustering algorithm. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional LEACH clustering algorithm and the improved LEACH-M algorithm, the new algorithm can achieve the purpose of balancing the energy loss of each node, effectively reduce the overall energy loss of the sensor network, and thus extend the network life cycle.

articleTitle: Study on Conflict-free path planning for picking robots based on traffic rules
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of Electronic Commerce and Logistics in China, it has become an inevitable trend to use robots to pick goods in distribution centers, and multi-robot conflict-free path planning is the key point to this application. Based on the analysis of existing algorithms for multi-robot path planning, this paper combines advantages of search-based methods and rule-based methods, and proposes an algorithm based on traffic rules. Experiment results show that this algorithm is fast and suitable for distribution centers with lots of robots, which can continually plan paths for robots.

articleTitle: A MRP-based policy conflict resolution mechanism for micro-service composition
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the micro-service composition, the policy conflict resolution mechanism has such problems as single resolution policy, coarse-granularity and inflexible resolution. To solve these problems, we propose a policy conflict resolution mechanism based Multiple Resolution Policy (MRP). It uses the policy generated tree model to express access control policy set of micro-service composition. The mechanism supports four resolution policies that include negative priority, timing priority, positive priority and recent priority. It can balance the security and availability of system better. In addition, coarse-grained resolution of policy level and fine-grained resolution of attribute level are implemented by calculating attribute relevance. The security intention of original policy set is changed minimally in the process of conflict resolution that can meet the flexible, dynamic conflict resolution needs of composite service better. Finally, we carry out some simulation experiments to verify and evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of the mechanism.

articleTitle: Establishment of multiplex PCR for screening Escherichia coli and Salmonella in Chinese herbal medicine
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The purpose is to study a multiplex PCR method for screening qualified Chinese herbal medicine granules for pharmaceutical enterprises. In this experiment, the uidA gene in Escherichia coli genome, inv A gene in Salmonella genome and 16S rDNA were used as target genes. Three pairs of primers were selected to establish and optimize the multiplex PCR system for the detection of bacteria in drugs. The amplified products were 194 bp, 362 bp and 1374 bp, respectively. The specificity of the multiplex PCR was verified by 11 strains of bacteria. The results showed that the sensitivity of multiplex PCR detection could reach $10^{3}-10^{4}$ CFU/ml at the cell level; bacteria were found in two of the six drugs tested in the market; bacteria were found in all the four drugs that did not pass the drug test, but none of the tested drugs had Escherichia coli and Salmonella. The results showed that the multiplex PCR detection method could detect Escherichia coli and Salmonella in Chinese herbal medicine granules rapidly, accurately and efficiently, which provided reference for the preliminary screening of Chinese herbal medicine granules.

articleTitle: Personalized dynamic recommendation integrating high-level similarity social relationships
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of the Internet, people have communicated more closely. People are more likely to find more similar partners online and communicate offline. Therefore, the demand for such activity recommendation is growing, but too many activities will inevitably make users confused and difficult to choose. Personalized recommendation system can help users filter out the content that they are not interested in or have a low evaluation, and recommend the content that they may be interested in to the participating users. However, the existing research focuses on the analysis of personal participation records, while the impact of dynamic interaction between participants on user participation preferences has not been explored, and the sparse user trust matrix and other problems hinder the improvement of recommendation performance.Therefore, it is important to integrate the social relationship dynamically into the personalized recommendation system. Secondly, considering that users trust different friends in different fields, in order to infer the social relations of users in specific fields more accurately, we will use network representation technology to embed the social trust relations in specific fields into low-dimensional space. We propose a personalized dynamic recommendation method integrating high-level similarity social relationships. The results show the superiority of the proposed model by comparing with the state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Regional hierarchical optimization control method based on critical region and boundary flow control
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The macroscopic fundamental diagram (MFD) is put in place to characterize the traffic characteristics of the road network for addressing the problem of area traffic congestion in the road network caused by the uneven distribution of traffic flow. A critical region identification model is constructed to identify key control areas. A set of regional traffic signal classification optimization control strategies, steps, and models are proposed based on the boundary flow control model. First, the road network is divided into three-level areas according to the critical region, namely, core, buffer, and peripheral sub-regions, to obtain two boundaries. Second, the calculation model of MFD critical value, regional aggregate traffic flow control amount, inter-region driving rate difference, and boundary optimization traffic flow difference is constructed with simulation modeling and mathematical methods. Third, regional hierarchical optimization control strategy and model are implemented to assess and feedback traffic state of each sub-region until all sub-regions reach a non-congested state. In addition, the regional hierarchical optimization control method is applied and analyzed in the experimental road network of the central district in Hefei City, China. Results demonstrate that the proposed method has superior operability and can quickly balance regional traffic flow and effectively reduce vehicle delays in congested areas to relieve regional traffic congestion.

articleTitle: Pyramid Fusion Convolutional Network for Image Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Convolutional neural network has been proved to be an effective architecture for single image super-resolution. However, some of the high-frequency features are still not exhibited enough in the reconstructed image. To address this issue, we propose the Pyramid Fusion Convolutional Network to progressively improve performance. In the pre-trained module, our network constructs pyramid fusion architecture to exploit the inherent multi-scale information. At each feature level, we design a parallel convolutional skip-connections module to ensure the integrity of information. After that, a novel loss function with edge preservation is defined to train and seek optimal parameters. Unlike most typical approaches that only employ the final feature maps as input in the mapping module, we extract effective mapping results from different levels of features to deliver more accurate estimation. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations have been demonstrated that our method performs better than state-of-the-art algorithms on a massive number of benchmarked images.

articleTitle: GLS Integrity Assessment Method Based on Clustering and Improved EM Parameter Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To solve the problem of inaccurate GBAS landing system integrity estimation caused by non-Gaussian error, an algorithm based on clustering and improved EM parameter estimation was proposed. Firstly, based on the Gaussian mixture distribution, a pseudo-range error observation distribution model containing non-Gaussian errors was established, and then the pseudo-range error observation values were roughly classified by using the local clustering center point communication clustering algorithm. An improved EM algorithm was proposed for the Gaussian mixture distribution. The expansion coefficient is selected appropriately according to the parameter estimation results. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively estimate the parameters of the pseudo-range error observation distribution model and improve the accuracy of GLS integrity estimation.

articleTitle: Articulated robot dynamics simulation research and control system design
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The dynamic characteristics and energy dissipation level of articulated robot directly affect the stability of its control system. Taking IRB140 articulated robot as the research object, against the shortcomings of PID and other control algorithms, a torque feedforward control method based on electromechanical coupling dynamic model is proposed, and a block diagram of the feedforward control system of the articulated robot model is built, so as to completed the dynamic simulation and feedforward control experiment analysis, realize the purpose of visual control. Finally, the experimental platform of articulated robot control system is built to complete the positioning accuracy test and the experiment of transporting real objects. Through experimental analysis, it can be conclued that the proposed torque feedforward control method can realize the movement of each joint of articulated robot model along a predetermined trajectory, the dynamic performance index of each sports joint is stable and the energy dissipation is small, more importantly, the designed articulated robot control system can accurately accomplish the transporting tasks under different motion paths, the designed articulated robot control system can accurately complete the transporting tasks under different motion paths, so it is meet the actual production requirements.

articleTitle: Fine Classification Methods for Multi-load users at Different Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart power grid in China, the interaction between power enterprises and load users is growing increasingly, which has led to the accumulation of a large amount of user-side load data. In the process of deeply mining the value of load characteristics, power load user classification is a key step, the traditional classification method is no longer suitable for the current diversified market. Therefore, in this paper we propose a load user classification method that is more suitable for the current situation of the power market. Firstly, the method performs a cluster analysis on the pre-processed data, optimizes the selection of the initial cluster center to sets the optimal k value. And then we improve the K-Means clustering algorithm to achieve a better clustering effect, which will classify the users with similar or identical load characteristics into a same category. In order to provide a more reliable and fine user classification method for power enterprises, this paper proposes to carry out secondary clustering on load users, extract finely divided load characteristic curves of different types, and establish a model of user load classification. After establishing the classification model, experiments are carried out using common classification algorithms such as SVM, KNN and Decision Tree. Through the evaluation indicators, SVM is selected as the classifier for fine classification of load users, which can realize a model of power user load classification with higher applicability, and provide us with a more scientific basis when we plan and make decisions for the power grid in the future.

articleTitle: Binary Classification with Supervised-like Biclustering and Adaboost
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Biclustering based classification methods have achieved great success. In existing biclustering based classification methods the residue score threshold used for searching biclusters is fixed and the number of mined useful biclusters is small. To solve the two problems, in this study we proposed a novel binary classification method based on supervised-like biclustering and adaboost. Supervised-like means the biclusters is searched twice with two different bicluster quality indicators MSD and weights instead of unique indicator MSR in other biclustering based classification methods. In initial search, the residue score threshold is identical for all biclusters. In the second search, some biclusters of low quality are searched again with smaller residue threshold. Besides, due to some limitations, many biclusters cannot be found. To obtain more biclusters, two additional operations are adopted. In the proposed method, we initially mine column constant biclusters from datasets, then transform the biclusters to weak classifiers. Through adaboost, the initial strong binary classifier can be constructed. Finally, with supervised-like strategy, the better final strong binary classifier can be obtained. To verify the performance of the proposed method, it is compared with seven binary classification methods on two datasets. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method outperformed other binary classification methods.

articleTitle: Modeling and searching technology of distribution network data resources based on knowledge mapping
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to realize the explicit expression of the distribution network data relationship of the power grid enterprises and the efficient search of data resources, a method for modeling and intelligent searching of distribution network data resources based on knowledge mapping is proposed. This method firstly identifies the core ontology of the distribution network based on the ontology construction process and the distribution network business, then maps and extracts the identified ontology model and the relational database physical model to form a knowledge mapping of distribution network data resources. On this basis, combining the BiLSTM-CRF-based distribution network named entity recognition algorithm and the BERT-based Chinese semantic matching algorithm, a distribution network data resource search engine technology is proposed to realize the search text feature extraction and result matching. Finally, the application verification data of a power grid company shows that the distribution network knowledge mapping has a good effect on the expression and visualization of data resource relationships. At the same time, the accuracy rate of the proposed distribution network data resource search engine technology method reaches 72.2%.

articleTitle: Parameter identification and verification of Preisach hysteresis model based on Levenberg–Marquart algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Because the sharing mechanism of magnetic measurement data has not yet been established, and the large database of material properties on which the Hysteresis Modeling relies is not complete, phenomenological modeling study without the microscopic physical nature of hysteresis has attracted much attention. In this paper, based on Preisach model and cosh distribution function, the Everett function is introduced to establish the analytical expression of hysteresis characteristics firstly. Then, the root mean square error (RMSE) between the hysteresis model analysis results and the measured values of the commonly used silicon steel sheet is taken as the fitness function, and the parameters of Preisach model are identified by Levenberg Marquardt (L-M) algorithm. Finally, the actual measured values of hysteresis loops under different working conditions are compared with the calculation results of hysteresis model, which verifies the accuracy and effectiveness of the model, which lays a theoretical foundation for the fine finite element analysis of electrical machinery and electrical appliances.

articleTitle: Event-triggered neuroadaptive attitude control for spacecraft with fixed-time prescribed performance
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the robust event-triggered attitude control problem for rigid spacecraft with guaranteed transient and steady-state performance in the presence of external disturbances, unknown inertia parameters, and input saturation is investigated. First, using the prescribed performance control theory, a novel fixed-time polynomial function is designed to impose desired performance. Then, by integrating the radial basis function neutral network approximation technique into the backstepping control framework, an event-triggered neuroadaptive saturated control law is proposed. With the Lyapunov framework, it is proved that the proposed control law ensures the satisfaction of the prespecified performance, and the ultimate boundedness of all closed-loop signals. Finally, numerical simulations are presented to validate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Further results on H∞ state estimation for delayed discrete-time neural networks via activation function-dependent zero equalities
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper studies the problem of $\mathcal{H}_{\infty}$ state estimation for discrete-time neural networks with a time-varying delay. The activation function is assumed to satisfy a sector-bounded condition. A novel Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional is firstly constructed by considering more information of activation function. Then by employing zero equalities based on activation function and its difference, Jensen’s inequality and reciprocally convex approach to deal with the forward difference of the Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional, a less conservative criterion is derived, which can ensure the globally asymptotical stability of the error system with $\mathcal{H}_{\infty}$ performance. The estimator gain matrix can be obtained by solving linear matrix inequalities. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness and superiority of the method.

articleTitle: LSTM sentiment classification model based on one kind of dynamic loss weighting function
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In Sentiment classification, the polarity of commentary text is unbalanced, which leads to the bias of the classification model. The Classification model based on the neural networks usually weight the loss function, but the effect of improving the performance of the model is limited. To solve this problem, we propose LSTM sentiment classification model based on the dynamic weighted loss function. Based on the LSTM text classification model, this model adjusts the weighting values of different categories in the loss function. According to the prediction error rate of different categories in the training process, the model can effectively improve the accuracy of a few classes while taking into account the recall rate of most categories. The proposed model has been tested on data sets of hotel reviews and electronic product reviews. The results show that the F1 values of a few classification results can reach 81.2% and 91.7%. Compared with other weighted loss methods, the proposed model has a significant improvement.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of Influencing Factors in Marine Repair Period
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a marine repair period analysis and prediction model based on principal component analysis (PCA). The model performs factors affecting the marine repair period, and provides a feasible method for predicting the marine repair period. The empirical conclusion shows that the eight initial factors that affect the repair cycle of “SC” marines only formed four types of factors after conversion with PCA and FA, and degraded the predicted risk of marine repair period by reducing the number of influencing factors. From the prediction results, the prediction error rate of the repair cycle of the “SC” type marine is only -3.62 % and 4.28 %. The prediction results show that the relative errors predicted are small and can meet the requirements of higher accuracy, which can verify the practicality of this method.

articleTitle: Integrating Guided Anchoring into One-stage Object Detectors
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate how to effectively integrate Guided Anchoring into one-stage object detectors. Integrating directly guided anchoring scheme may lead to two immediate difficulties, inconsistency between feature map and shape of anchors, and more serious objective imbalance due to introducing more objectives at this time. To mitigate these issues, we propose an adaptive one-stage detector (AOSD) based on guided anchoring with two novel components: shaping convolutional neural network (SCN) and bent L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> loss. The former component focuses on adapting the original feature map by generated various anchors. The latter component can bend gradients of inliers to re-balance involved objectives. Benefited from the two proposed components, AOSD keeps the advantage of being good at large object detecting, meanwhile especially enhances small object detection and accurate localization. Our evaluations show that the proposed AOSD may perform more accurately and more efficiently than the corresponding strong baselines, achieving 37.4 average precision (AP) points with a small feature extractor ResNet50.

articleTitle: New research progress on synthesis and properities of eco-friendly insulating gas heptafluoroisobutyronitrile((i-C4F7N))
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As global climate change intensifies, higher requirements are imposed on the insulation and environmental performance of eco-friendly gases for electrical insulation. Although SF6 gas has excellent insulating properties and arc-quenching capabilities, it has been classified as one of the greenhouse gases in the Kyoto protocol. At present, SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> emissions have been restricted. Many researchers and academic institutions are committed to the research and development of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> replacement gas in order to achieve the development of green energy. The GWP of heptafluoroisobutyronitrile($i-C_{4}F_{7}N$) is only 2210, which is far lower than that of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>. The gas $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ as a potential and alternative gas for SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> has attracted academics’ attention. Recently, GE has built a 420 kV $i-C_{4}F_{7}N/CO_{2}$ GIL. In the first part, this review briefly introduced the background of insulating gases and the discovery of $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$. Then it broadly covers the new progress on the preparation of $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ in the second part. Methylperfluoroisobutyrate, perfluoroisobutyryl acid, tetrafluoroethylene, hexafluoropro-pylene and perfluoro(4-methylpent-2-ene) can be used as the initial starting material to synthesize $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$. In the third part, the review presented the new research progresses on dielectric properties of $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ and $i-C_{4}F_{7}N/CO_{2}$ gas mixture. The pure $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ shows a dielectric strength which is approximately twice that of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>. In addition, experimental study indicates that the dielectric strength of the $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ gas mixture with 18–20% $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ can be achieved similar to that of pure SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>. Further, it reviews the research progress on the insulation properties of the $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ gas mixture over the past 3 years. They have a great influence on reducing greenhouse gas emissions from the electrical industry and the application of $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ in industry. In the last part, the research progress on dissociative ionization dynamics of dielectric gas $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ was described. Furthermore, the decomposition products and mechanism of the environmentally friendly insulating gas $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$, $i-C_{4}F_{7}N/CO_{2}$ or $i-C_{4}F_{7}N/N_{2}$ gas mixture under different experimental conditions (temperature or discharge) are reviewed. Besides, the achievements on the main decomposition pathways of $i-C_{4}F_{7}N$ and the enthalpy of each path at different temperatures were described.

articleTitle: A Study of trustworthiness for P2P lending
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: this paper aims to examine transaction trust building and factors concerning P2P e-loaning, a topic of great interest in the academic literature. On the footing of the social cognition theorem, this paper designs a structural model concerning transaction trust from the perspective of lenders, and probes into the process of trust establishment and its determinants. The study employs SmartPLS2.0 for processing the figures arising from questionnaire to solve the designed model and test proposed hypotheses. The researched results show that the lender’s trust tendency, information quality, social capital and secure guarantee from lending platforms perform a vital part in transaction confidence, but for different dimensions of social capital, influence is variable. This paper finds that, the more specific and truthful the individual message concerning a certain debtor, the more credible the debtor and the more successful the loaning deal will be, and relational social capital wields a substantial impact on trading confidence while structural does not. This paper also finds that security guarantee services stemming from e-lending websites exercise a certain degree of impact on the lender’s confidence in borrowers. This paper concludes with pointing out valuable insights for regulators and creditors.

articleTitle: The influence of organic organizational structure on employees’ overall justice: Mediating role of renqing perception
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Renqing is one of the core concepts of the Chinese traditional culture which implies a typical set of informal social norms. This paper examines the influencing mechanism between organic organizational structure, employees’ renqing perception and their overall justice perception in the Chinese workplace. Specifically, we define renqing perception as the extent to which employees perceive that people’s actions in their organizations follow the renqing norm. We hypothesize that employees’ perception of organic organizational structure will positively relate to both their renqing perception and overall justice. Moreover, renqing perception serves as a significant mediator in the relationship between organic organizational structure and overall justice. Results from two-wave surveys of 325 Chinese employees provide largely consistent support for our hypotheses. Theoretical and practical implications are discussed.

articleTitle: Moving Horizon Body State Estimation for Quadruped Robot with Multi-Sensor Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The position and velocity information of the quadruped robot are essential for controlling. With accurate estimation, more precise feedback can be provided, thus the performance of the robot will be improved. Single inertial navigation solution (INS) or kinematic analysis cannot meet the requirement in long-term motion because of the presence of drift in sensoring or noise resulting from impact and oscillation. Meanwhile, in practical cases, states of the robot are often constrained by conditions. But traditional estimation methods, such as Kalman filtering, cannot deal with constraints, resulting that the estimation may violate the physical reality. As an optimal estimation method with superior performance, moving horizon estimation (MHE) carry out online estimation by solving the optimal problem with constraints explicitly. It has unique advantages in processing nonlinear system, uncertain measurement system and state constrained system. This paper proposes an estimation method for multi-sensor fusion. The moving horizon estimation method integrates inertial navigation and robot kinematics, overcoming single channel solution’s shortcomings, and makes the optimal estimation for the legged robot. The results of simulation prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A New Random Phases Correction Algorithm for Synthesizing Engine Noise
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Order noise is an essential part of engine noise and a vital indicator of the vehicle's interior’s sound quality. Based on the Kaiser window function and Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), the synthesis techniques are proposed to extract and synthesize engine order sounds. However, using the Short-Time Fourier Transform algorithm to extract order noise is prone to spectral leakage and fence effects, affecting the accuracy of order tracking analysis. In this paper, the pitch-synchronous sinusoidal decomposition method is used to analyze the spectrum characteristics of some essential window functions and their differences. The Kaiser window function short-time Fourier transform, and the synthesis techniques are proposed for the extraction and synthesis of engine order sounds. A random phase correction algorithm is developed to conquer the problem that the phase discontinuity of a single harmonic component during order synthesis leads to the interference effect of the synthesized sound. After all, it improves the coherence of the synthesized sound. Moreover, MATLAB software and engine order-noise are applied for producing a sound modulation software to achieve order slicing, phase extraction, and sound synthesis of sound samples. The results show that: the engine order sound extraction and synthesis method can meet the requirements of synthesized sound accuracy; the proposed random phase correction algorithm can reduce the interference effect and improving the coherence of the synthesized sound.

articleTitle: A method for extracting urban road with shadow from the Chinese Gaofen-2 data
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the improvement of remote sensing satellite spatial resolution, more recognizable details can be obtained from remote sensing image. It may lead to inaccurate classification results. Most existing methods cannot correctly discriminate roads from its background, especially when the road is in complex scenes. To improve the accuracy of occluded road extraction, the spectral characteristics of shadow areas and roads in different bands are calculated. There are significant differences among land covers in the near-infrared band. Therefore, the near-infrared image of Gaofen-2 (GF-2) is selected for pre-processing to extract the urban road in this paper. First, the road feature is more prominent and similar to shaded region in the near-infrared image. Further setting threshold segmentation to extract road can reduce fracture caused by occlusion. Next, the centerline will be extracted after removing misclassified parts. The unwanted regions can be divided into two main types. One is the isolated non-road patch, which can be removed using the geometric features of road. The other is the connected false segment, which can be removed in conjunction with the width and medial axis skeleton of road. At last, the metric function and neighborhood similarity are employed to link broken centerlines to generate a complete road network. The qualitative and quantitative experimental results demonstrate that our method can better perform urban road extraction with shadow and the extracted centerline is smoother.

articleTitle: RF field effect transistors based on two-dimensional materials
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Two-dimensional materials (2D) have attracted considerable attention as atomically thin channel materials for field-effect transistors. The 2D materials consists of atom thick covalently bonded lattice, in which the carriers are confined in the atomically thin channel with excellent gate controllability. Additionally, the 2D materials are free of surface dangling bonds and hence exhibit good electronic properties even at the limit of single atom thickness. As a result, the 2D materials can offer significant potential for future electronic transistors scaling to single atomic body thickness. The radio frequency (RF) electronic is one of the most promising field in wireless communication. Here, we review the recent efforts and progress in radio frequency transistors based on 2D materials, including graphene, transition metal dichalcogenide (TMDCs) and black phosphorus. The merits, limits and prospects of each material are also be discussed.

articleTitle: Comprehensive performance improvement of IWM-EVs with active suspension based on multi- objective integrated optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is well known that active suspensions require high actuation power and consume a lot of energy in the aggressive operation condition, which will reduce the achievable driving range for electric vehicles. To solve the contradiction between dynamic performances and efficiency in active suspension system and improve the capacity utilization rate, this paper presents a multi-objective optimization method for the comprehensive performance improvement in active suspension adopted in IWMEVs (in-wheel motor electric vehicles). The simulation results show that not only a better balance between the ride comfort and stability in vehicle is accomplished, but also the active suspension utilization rate is improved. This research demonstrates the application potential of the co-operative optimization method in parameters design of active suspension system.

articleTitle: A method of recommending waiting roads to passengers based on vacant taxi number prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Currently, the low operation efficiency of taxis is a common problem faced by urban taxi service systems. When there is a high vacancy rate of taxis, it can still be difficult to find a taxi, mainly due to the uninformed selection of waiting roads on the part of passengers. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a method of recommending waiting roads to passengers based on vacant taxi number prediction. By extracting the spatio-temporal and ambient features influencing the vacancy rate from the historical trajectory big data and weather data of urban taxis, this method first predicts the vacant taxi numbers of various roads using the CatBoost framework. Then the probability of taking a taxi in a future time slot on each road is calculated. Finally, the adjacent road with the best probability to the passenger based on his/her current location is recommended. Thus, the difficulty of taking a taxi is overcome to some extent. This study conducted a simulation experiment for model training and validation based on the historical trajectory big data of taxis in Xi’an and compared the proposed method with LightGBM and SVM. According to the experimental results, the proposed CatBoost method was superior to other methods in root-mean-square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) indices, and it has some practical values for resolving the taxi-passenger contradiction.

articleTitle: A Method for Assessing Transient Overvoltage of AC/DC System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to predict the transient over-voltage of AC/DC system during large disturbances effectively, this paper puts forward a method for assessing transient overvoltage based on deep learning, such as convolutional neural networks (CNN). Firstly, a non-linear network structure with multiple layers of hidden layers is built, based on the basic principle of CNN input feature construction. According to the topology of the power grid nodes, the voltage, phase angle and power of each node collected by the wide area measurement device are used as input layers. The relationship and the occurrence of the fault to the time sequence of the resection are spliced to obtain a matrix characterizing the state of the grid. Then, the hyperparameters of CNN are optimized and adjusted, and the gradient descent method is used for supervised training. The weight matrix between the input layer and the convolutional layer is optimized layer by layer to realize the automatic extraction of key eigenvalues, and the deep structure of CNN is used to construct the temporary structure. A mapping model between the overvoltage and the input data to quickly and accurately estimate the transient overvoltage of the AC/DC system. Finally, the modified Nordic32 AC/DC hybrid system is analyzed to verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: State-of-the-Art Deep Person Re-identification: A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Recently, deep learning has achieved great success in person re-identification (ReID). This paper aims to review the state-of-the-art person ReID algorithms based on deep learning. In terms of different application problems in person ReID, the algorithms presented are roughly divided into three categories, i.e., image-based person ReID, video-based person ReID, unsupervised person ReID. For each category, we review the most representative research works in recent years. Our survey aims to address existing problems, challenges and future research directions based on the analyses of the current latest advancements made toward deep learning based person ReID techniques.

articleTitle: Research on Invulnerability Evaluation of Optical Network Geography Disaster
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In view of the lack of an effective evaluation model for optical network survivability evaluation caused by geographical disasters, this paper has studied and proposed an evaluation model for optical network survivability considering geographical disasters, designed and proposed an evaluation index for survivability based on communication efficiency. On this basis, a survivability assessment method considering protection and unprotected conditions is proposed. Simulation results show that this method can effectively evaluate the invulnerability of optical networks under geographical disasters.

Author Keywords: Communication efficiency of the whole network

articleTitle: Research on Fault Inversion Verification Technology Based on Practical-Test-Platform of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The practical test can truly reflect the electromagnetic transient characteristics generated in the operation process of distribution network, but the test process is complex, the topology change is inconvenient, and the high-voltage test also has a certain degree of danger, which is not suitable for frequent test and display. This paper proposes an inversion verification technology based on the monitoring data of the Practical-Test-Platform of distribution network. Based on the data obtained in the practical test, constructed the $\pi$ type equivalent circuit line. The positive sequence impedance and zero sequence impedance parameters of $\pi$ type equivalent circuit structure of all line sections of the Practical-Test-Platform are derived by using the calculation principle of symmetrical sequence component. Then the Practical-Test-Platform is digitized in MATALAB/ Simulink environment, and the inversion is carried out in the way of execution of a ground-short-circuit fault test respectively on the same node. The simulation results show that the ground-short-circuit fault waveform obtained by this inversion method has a high similarity with the original fault, which verifies the high referenced value of the inversion verification technology.

articleTitle: Intelligent Manufacturing in China: : Innovation Drive and Responsible Innovation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: More than a decade ago, when it came to "Made in China", we thought more about cheaper products with less technical content, but now we can see from the "Made in China" advertisements in Times Square in the United States, that China's manufacturing products have become more and more intelligent, personalized, and globalized, which has shaped a new era of Chinese manufacturing into the world. This is China's "Intelligent Manufacturing". Whether it is Haier, Gree, Huawei, Ankai or Zhigao, what these brand products represent is the current development status and characteristics of China's "Intelligent manufacturing": innovation drive as the driving force and responsible innovation as the development concept. In the past decade, China's manufacturing industry has gradually shifted from the traditional "Made in China" to "Intelligent Manufacturing", which reflects the continuous efforts of China's manufacturing transformation and upgrading, and the actual effect of innovation driven by manufacturing. This paper mainly includes four aspects: Firstly, it introduces the overall situation of the transformation and upgrading of traditional manufacturing to “Intelligent Manufacturing” and the ethical issues it contains: outlines the background of traditional Chinese manufacturing and discusses the reasons why traditional manufacturing needs transformation and upgrading and its developing direction, analyzes the ethical connotation and problems in the process of transformation and upgrading. Secondly, this paper discusses the innovation-driven demand of "intelligent manufacturing", discusses the position and role of innovation in China's development concept, expounds the relationship between innovation and China's "intelligent manufacturing" industry, and analyzes the elements of China's "intelligent manufacturing" to realize innovation-driven: (1) research and development, (2) talents. Thirdly, it discusses the relationship between “responsible innovation” as a newly developed concept of international technology development strategy and China's “intelligent manufacturing”: introduces the background, concept, framework and approach of “responsible innovation” and introduces a China case of engineering development within the framework of Responsible Innovation. Finally, this paper explores the issue of social governance innovation in China's “intelligent manufacturing”, and how the “intelligent manufacturing” could be regarded as the balance and impetus of innovation, development and sustainability in China.

articleTitle: How Chinese Language Style Influence the Communication Effect of Fashion Internet Celebrities’ Weibo Accounts
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As one of the fastest-growing and most profitable groups, fashion Internet celebrities are leading the development of a new business model of "Internet celebrity economy". From the linguistic point of view, this thesis will explore how different language styles affect the communication effect of fashion Internet celebrities’ Weibo accounts. First of all, based on the related theories of language style and the research methods of automatic text analysis, this paper divides the language features of fashion Internet celebrities’ Weibo accounts into three categories: "interactive style", "cognitive style" and "emotional style". After that, the relationship between the language style of fashion Internet celebrities’ Weibo account and its communication effect is constructed by the quantitative statistical method of multiple linear regression, and the hypothesis model is established and verified. Finally, based on the results of the quantitative research, this thesis provides some suggestions on how to improve the language style of fashion Internet celebrities’ Weibo accounts and enhance their influence. (Abstract)

articleTitle: User Local and Global Interest Depth Interaction for Recommendation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Using auxiliary information such as social networks or item attributes to improve the performance of recommender systems is a key issue in the research of recommender systems. It plays a very important role in alleviating the interactive sparsity of collaborative filtering methods. In response to this problem, a recommendation algorithm that user local and global interest depth interaction is proposed, which analyzes the user’s implicit preferences from two perspectives: based on the user’s historical behavior records, using a fully connected neural network to extract the user’s local interests; based on the user’s historical behavior items, through the association between entities in the knowledge graph, mines the entities associated with the user’s historical behavior, forming a multi-layer global interest layer to generalize user interests. The user’s local interest vector activates the item entity in the global interest layer to generate the user’s global interest vector. Finally, the deep neural network is used to complete the feature interaction of users’ local interests, global interests and recommended items. The user’s local and global interests accurately describe user preferences and improve the accuracy of click-through rate prediction. Experiments show that the recommendation performance of the algorithm on the two public data sets is better than the comparison baseline and the classic recommendation algorithm.

articleTitle: Method for Solving Electromagnetic Field of a One Side Axis Counting Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A calculation method for the induced electromotive force in induction coils is proposed of one side axis counting sensor. First, for the without rail and without wheel case, magnetic induction intensity calculation models inside and outside of an iron core are proposed based on the imaginary magnetic charge method. Second, the calculation method of the magnetic induction intensity generated by the eddy current in the space is given. Third, by building a two-dimensional simplified physics model of a wheel and decomposing the eddy current field state of a moving wheel, the steady-state component equation and transient component equation of the wheel eddy current field are obtained. Finally, an experiment platform is built to verify the accuracy of the proposed calculation models. The research can not only promote the development of the one side axis counting sensor but also significantly improve its electromagnetic field theoretical level.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Functionally Graded Cellular Structures Based on Triply Periodic Minimal Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To better realize the lightweight and high strength characteristics of cellular structures, this paper proposes a topology optimization design method for cellular structures based on triply periodic minimal surfaces (TPMS). A parameterized implicit model of the cellular structure is established based on the I-Wrapped Package (I-WP) minimal surface. A three-dimensional numerical homogenization method is used to calculate the macroscopic effective properties of the I-WP based cellular structure. The relationship between the macroscopic effective properties and the volume fraction is interpolated with the polynomial interpolation function. The topology optimization model with a volume constraint is established. The optimization problem is solved by the optimality criteria algorithm. Finally, a local design variable interpolation model is used to ensure the high-order continuity of the functional graded cellular structures (FGCS). Two numerical examples are investigated to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A New Model of Safety Management System for Railway Operation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Safety management systems (SMSs) were introduced to the rail industry as a proactive way to manage safety and prevent accidents. However, accidents still occur where the SMS has been implemented but ineffective. It is, therefore, of great importance to have a reality check of what the role and functions of an SMS are in order to understand why the SMS does not prevent organisational accidents and to identify the weakness of SMS as underlying causes in accidents.This paper is a summary of the report based on previous research (Pan, 2014). It presents a systemic review of SMS elements based on analysis of accident reports and proposes an innovative SMS model in order to discover potential improvements for SMS implementation. The review based on selected accident reports focused on analysing the individual SMS elements involved in the accidents and identified the most critical elements in accidents are safety-related information management, risk assessment and competence management. The main findings from the research lie in the failure patterns of SMS elements in accidents, organisational features of the rail accidents, inadequate standards for SMS design, and industrial emphasis in implementation. We gave our recommendations on SMS implementations based on this review. And future research can be processed in the areas of improvement of the SMS model, detailed analysis of SMS involvement in the accidents, and the actual value of the SMS.

articleTitle: Research on Power Load Classification Based on Feature Weighted Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The daily load curve of the substation in the power system can be used for the classification and synthesis of load characteristics. The typical daily load curve data obtained and processed by the SCADA system is the basis for the study of load classification. In order to solve the problem of original curve mode aliasing, a signal processing method based on variational mode decomposition (VMD) is proposed. At the same time, in view of the unique problem of the feature weight of the Euclidean distance in the fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering algorithm, a feature weighted fuzzy clustering method is used to propose a feature weighted VMD-FCM clustering algorithm. Examples show that VMD algorithm can effectively decompose the intrinsic mode of signals, improve the convergence speed and clustering accuracy of FCM function; Based on the Euclidean distance, the weight coefficient improves the practicability and accuracy of FCM algorithm. The results show that the improved method can effectively distinguish different load types, which has a guiding role in load forecasting, pricing standards and even marketing strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Factors Influencing the Masses’ Will of Browsing Anti-Epidemic Posters Online under the COVID-19 Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As the outbreak of novel coronavirus in 2020 is a public crisis event sweeping across the globe, electronic posters as a kind of information transmission medium featuring outstanding visual effect and easy transmission are playing a significant role in timely issuing information, properly guiding the public opinion and alleviating the mental anxiety of the masses under the epidemic situation. In this paper, in order to optimize the transmission efficiency of electronic posters, special effort is made to screen main factors influencing the masses’ will of browsing electronic posters online under the epidemic situation from three aspects (Platform, Posters and Audiences) based on the literature research. Then, through the questionnaire survey and DEMATEL method, analysis is made on various factors and the relevance between factors. According to the research results, Information Visualization is the most important demand factor, the basic function of platform the core impact factor and the audiences’ anxiety the core impacted factor. Through comparing the result respectively concluded from the DEMATEL and the binary logistic regression analytical method, the research’s conclusions can be supplemented and extended. At last, based on the specific analysis and comparison result, suggestions on optimizing online anti-epidemic popular science posters are proposed to enhance the masses’ will of browsing and improve the transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: An improved particle swarm optimization algorithm and its application to solve constrained optimization problems
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm (IPSO) for constrained nonlinear optimization problems. The main improvements of the original PSO are the incorporation of particle local information and the introduction of dynamic inertia weight. A new velocity update equation is proposed, which consider the local information around each particle. During consecutive generations, an dynamic inertia weight is produced to improve the search speed and search precision of IPSO. In addition, a dynamic multi-stage penalty function is used to deal with the constraints and a modified feasibility-based rule is adopted to update the personal best position and the global best position of the IPSO. The effectiveness of the proposed IPSO is validated through a set of benchmark constrained test functions and an engineering optimization problem. The experimental results show that IPSO can obtain some solutions better than or as well as those previously reported in the literature, which reveals that the proposed IPSO is a promising approach to solve this sort of optimizing problems.

articleTitle: Online Object Tracking based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Object Tracking is one of the essential steps in computer vision applications such as human-computer interaction, video surveillance, and augmented reality. Visual object tracking remains one of the most challenging tasks in object tracking due to many variations of conditions. In this paper, we utilize Residual Network ResNet as a feature extractor and address the limitations of object tracking using Generative Adversarial Networks. We describe a generative adversarial network to improve object tracker’s classifier during the online training phase. The network generates adaptive features to augment the positive samples detected by the convolutional layer of the tracker’s model in order to improve the model’s classifier. The network is integrated with Generative Adversarial Networks tracker and the object tracking results are presented.

articleTitle: The Passive DOA Estimation by Virtual Time Reversal on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The Virtual Time Reversal algorithm has the advantages of low computational complexity and high accuracy in low signal-to-noise ratio, so it is easy to implement in hardware engineering. The parallel design of FPGA can greatly improve the speed of direction finding system and satisfy the real-time direction finding. The paper adopts Virtex-7 FPGA of Xilinx Company with Verilog-HDL to program the design of Passive DOA Estimation by Virtual Time Reversal (PVTR-DOA). Firstly, according to the principle of Virtual Time Reversal algorithm, a parallel processing scheme is proposed. This design establishes the algorithm module through Vivado software platform, and uses package IP tool to package the algorithm module into a custom IP core. Then, the data to be tested in DDR3 and the custom IP core are moved through DMA data interaction mode for signal processing. The FPGA design uses MicroBlaze core to implant C code on SDK platform to control the embedded system. Finally, the effectiveness and real-time direction finding of the hardware design are verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: A Novel Two Degrees of Freedom Control Strategy for PS/S Current-fed IPT System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to achieve good transmission characteristics of ICPT system, zero-phase-angle (ZPA) operation and constant voltage output characteristics are always required. However, the operating point is significantly affected by the variation of the magnetic coupling and load conditions. This paper presents a two-degree-of-freedom control strategy for a parallel-series/series IPT network. ZPA operation is achieved by controlling the phase shift angle of the switched capacitor. On this basis, a new three-level current control strategy is proposed to achieve constant voltage output. The detailed steady-state operation, control strategy, small-signal modeling are reported, and the theoretical results are validated with a 120W lab-prototype.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Modeling Technology and Software Realization of Air & Flue Gas Ducts Structures
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the speed and accuracy of building model of flue duct structure in finite element calculation, an intelligent modeling module and method of flue duct structure is proposed, the realization scheme of man-machine interactive information menu, man-machine model modification menu, embedded rules and design experience, intelligent modification information menu in intelligent modeling is proposed. The intelligence of the modeling module and the relationship between the modeling module and other intelligent modules are also studied. Through the research results, the intelligent modeling speed of flue duct structure can be increased by more than 80%, and the modeling efficiency and precision of flue duct structure have been greatly improved.

articleTitle: An edge-caching algorithm based on fine-grained SVC for video streaming
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, with the drastic increase in the number of video requests, higher requirements have been put forward for video transmission services. This paper introduces the video caching model that work on edge-caching devices to improve QoE of users who request videos. Combined with a fine-grained scalable video coding technology, we design a new algorithm which can allocate cache space by analyzing past video request data to improve the hit rate of user video requests. Numerical results show that the proposed method can outperform ubiquitous solutions e.g. least-recently/frequently used and First Input First Output method in terms of a quantitative score over users’ experience.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of 3D Faces Based on Monocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Deep learning is receiving more and more attention in the reconstruction of three-dimensional (3D) faces. However, most of the reported methods use a single 2D image to reconstruct a 3D face, which looks true but is lack of 3D accuracy and personalization. In order reconstruct 3D faces for applications with dimensional accuracy requirement such as medical treatment, we propose a deep learning based multi-view reconstruction method, which aims to provide sufficient 3D constraints to obtain high-quality 3D face models. We propose a multi-view hybrid loss function to calculate the loss at the image level and the perception level. Weakly supervised learning is implemented to train an end-to-end network, and regressed directly to extract the face reconstruction parameters. The multi-view approach not only improve the reconstruction effect of the face in the front, but also from the side, such as the jaw, which is critical in dentistry. We set the region of interest mask to improve the accuracy of reconstruction in specific regions. We have done comparative experiments with several state-of-the-art reconstruction methods, and the results show that the method in this paper can effectively improve the overall 3D face reconstruction accuracy.

articleTitle: Probabilistic framework for evaluating the capability and resilience of C4ISR using Bayesian networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The command information system (C4ISR) is vulnerable to enemy’s attacks in combat. The C4ISR, which is more resilient, is more able to resist the enemy’s attack and quickly restore its function after damage. In this paper, we innovatively propose a method in which we comprehensively use Bayesian networks (BN) and dynamic Bayesian networks (DBN) to evaluate the resilience of C4ISR. BN is used to evaluate the capability of C4ISR, and DBN is used to obtain the curve of system capability over time. Finally, we evaluated the resilience of C4ISR using the acquired curve of capability.

articleTitle: DEM-based GF-3 SAR Image Geometric Rectification Method of Transmission Line and Tower Location with Real Time Ephemeris
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: GF-3 satellite is a remote sensing satellite, and it can provide data support for multiple fields, including transmission line and tower location surveillance. However, the existence of system errors reduces the accuracy of location, which restricts the generalization of GF-3 to those applications. Geometric rectification technique is focused on the elimination of system errors and geometric distortion in SAR images. In this paper, focused on the accurate transmission line and tower location, the DEM-based system errors calibration method is proposed, which is used for electrical power system. The experimental results show that the location accuracy of our method reaches the level of no more than 20 meters compared with the geolocation accuracy of 100 meters with real time ephemeris.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of microgrid based on wavelet decomposition and convolution neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The topological structure of the microgrid is different, and the internal power flow changes in both directions, which makes the fault diagnosis and protection of the microgrid difficult. In addition, the research on microgrid failures in the past years has mainly focused on internal failures, with few mentions of failures in network tie lines. This article proposes a fault diagnosis method combining Meyer wavelet decomposition and convolutional neural network. Through wavelet decomposition of the three-phase voltage and current signals at the time of the fault, approximate coefficients and detail coefficients are extracted, and the convolutional neural network input is formed to establish the fault. Diagnosis model to detect fault type and fault location. Experiments show that this method has high diagnostic accuracy, and it can efficiently diagnose faults in the network and the faults of the interconnection line between networks. Finally, compared with the traditional BP neural network and the original convolutional neural network, it also has better fault diagnosis result.

articleTitle: Effects of Waterlogging Stress on Antioxidant Enzymes in Rice Plants
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The influence of flood disaster on rice growth and development is a research hotspot in the farmland water conservancy. In this paper, Xiushui 12 rice planted in large area in South China was used as material, The method of displacement and submergence of potted plants, Study on Effects of waterlogging stress on antioxidant enzymes in rice plants, Clearing the depth and diachronic of flooding in different growing stages of rice, Provide theoretical references for regional paddy field drainage and farmland water conservancy construction. The results show that the content of antioxidant enzymes in rice plants is higher than that in early growth stages, indicating that proper water stress can increase the content of antioxidant enzymes., rice at different growth stages showed a certain ability to resist flooding stress, but the tolerance to flooding and sensitivity were different, The S1 stage is the strongest and the S2 stage is the most sensitive. The optimal flooding depth and duration of rice at three stages of S1, S2 and S3 were plant height 3/4 (W2), plant height 1/2 (W1), plant height 3/4 (W2) and 5d (T2)., 3d (T1), 3d (T1).

articleTitle: Stability analysis of discrete ecological dynamical systems with composite stochastic parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the stability analysis of random composite discrete power systems with random parameters. Firstly, by the orthogonal polynomial approximation of discrete random function in the Hilbert space, we convert two-dimensional discrete stochastic system into its equivalent deterministic system. Then, using two independent and identically distributed random variables, we construct the July criterion on the basis of mathematical analysis and the algebraic criterion in the asymptotic stability theory of discrete dynamical systems. Finally, we prove that the system is stable in part in its parameter plane, and the random intensity can cause a change in the stability region of the system. Furthermore, we give the numerical simulation to illustrate the correctness of the results in this paper.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of rolling bearing based on MPA-VMD and RCMFE
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of non-linear, non-stationary and background noise interference in rolling bearing fault signals, the extraction of fault features becomes very complicated. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on marine predator algorithm based-variational mode decomposition (MPA-VMD) and refined composite multiscale fuzzy entropy (RCMFE). First, use MPA-VMD to decompose the original fault signal, and select the IMF signal with strong correlation with the original signal for reconstruction; Then use RCMFE to obtain the fault features of rolling bearings, and use the LDA algorithm to reduce the dimensions of the extracted fault features; Finally, beetle antennae search based support vector machine (BAS-SVM) is used to discriminate the fault types of the fault features after dimensionality reduction. Experimental results display that the method proposed in this paper can effectively extract and classify rolling bearing faults, verifying the practicability and validity of the method.

Author Keywords: marine predator algorithm based- variational mode decomposition

articleTitle: Blow-up phenomena for a class of p-Laplacian heat equations with logarithmic nonlinearity term
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper deals with a quasilinear parabolic equation with p-Laplacian and logarithmic nonlinearity terms under homoge-neous Dirichlet boundary condition in a smooth bounded domain. By means of the logarithmic Sobolev inequality and potential wells method, blow-up results are obtained.

articleTitle: Building a Private Cloud Based on Microservices for Computer Science Laboratory in Universities
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Computer science labs in universities have different demands in cloud computing compared with typical IT companies. They differ greatly in software requirements and resource utilization. As an instance, we propose building a private cloud based on microservices with Docker and Kubernetes in our laboratory to match our labs’ typical requirements.The private cloud proposed in this paper is composed of multiple components such as authentication, service gateway, distributed storage, knowledge management, code management, etc. Furthermore, some typical research software systems are deployed as microservices in the private cloud. To satisfy complex software environment requirements, a multi version microservice is implemented.
