In our microservices platform, users can submit their own microservices and manage these microservices’ life cycle through a web interface. In addition, the platform will automatically start and stop low frequency services to improve resource utilization rate. We use laboratory resources to conduct experiments and build a platform. With deploying the platform in our laboratory, it shows that the platform meets most of typical demands in research work and improves research efficiency.

articleTitle: A privacy preserving and public verifiable signature scheme for consortium blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: From the perspective of privacy, blockchain can be divided into three categories: private blockchain, consortium blockchain and public blockchain respectively. Unlike private blockchain and public blockchain, consortium blockchain is only available for users holding the same access licenses to the blockchain system even they may belong to different organizations. Consequently, authentication in the consortium blockchain is of great importance since participants in the same consortium are within the same trust domain. In this paper, we propose a privacy preserving and public verifiable signature scheme for consortium blockchain. In our scheme, all the members in the consortium have the privilege to generate a signature on a file without leaking his sensitive identity. What’s more, the generated signature can be verified to the consortium instead of a single member. The presented scheme is suitable to be deployed for providing data authentication in consortium blockchain due to its high efficiency and security level.

articleTitle: Data Analysis for Field orienteering Monitoring by COMPASS System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Affected by the topographic and weather conditions, and the athletes’ physical, skill and psychological qualities, it’s rather difficult to guarantee the athletes’ safety during the orienteering training and competition process. In this paper, a orienteering training monitoring and data analysis system based on COMPASS positioning and communication was proposed, and two data series collected by the system were analyzed. The data showed that: 1) According to comprehensive punch efficiency and performance efficiency, athletes No.9, No.13 obtained the best performance efficiency; 2) the safety warning ability and higher efficiency of orienteering training can be improved using the monitoring system based on COMPASS positioning and communication.

articleTitle: Research on Detection Method of Traffic Anomaly Based on Improved YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of the detection of abnormal traffic incidents with large target scale changes, high requirements for location positioning accuracy, and high real-time requirements, a method for detecting abnormal traffic incidents is proposed. In terms of vehicle detection, K-means dimensional clustering is performed on the a priori box size on the multi-scale prediction branch feature map, which enhances the scale adaptability. The loss function of boundary box is improved to improve the locating ability. The channel attention and spatial attention structure (CBAM) is embedded in front of each shortcut layer of the YOLOv3 basic network Darknet53 to expand the network’s perception of the target feature area. In terms of vehicle tracking, the pedestrian re-identification network in Deep SORT is replaced with a vehicle re-identification network, which effectively reduces the ID switch of the target. The experimental results show that the proposed abnormal event identification rules can accurately detect pedestrians on elevated roads, abnormal parking and reversing events in real time.

articleTitle: Influence Maximization in Microblog Social Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, the continuous rise of social networks has promoted the research of maximizing influence. Therefore, it is more and more important to mine a group of users with the largest influence range in social network, which is also of great significance for the promotion of some products. To solve the above problems, this paper studies the influence maximization in microblog social network, and proves that the problem is NP hard, and the objective function of the problem satisfies monotonicity and submodule. An effective algorithm is proposed to solve this problem. The algorithm fully considers the nature of microblog social network and microblog users, and measures the influence of users themselves with activity, communication power and coverage. Based on the independent cascade model, a communication model is designed according to the influence of users and the interaction times between users. Through the experiment on the real microblog data set, it is proved that the algorithm has good performance in the propagation range and operation efficiency, and the propagation effect is more in line with the reality.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy membership algorithm in dynamic voltage regulation control
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The non-contact compensation type AC voltage regulator possesses the advantages of small size, high efficiency, low cost, etc. due to its simple structure and convenient control, and is widely used in the field of AC voltage regulation technology field. However, the non-contact compensation type AC voltage regulator belongs to the class of voltage regulation, and the characteristics of its discontinuous system make it have the disadvantages of low control precision and weak system reliability. Fuzzy control strategy, through fuzzification and approximate reasoning, can solve the problem of such discontinuous control systems. Some research show that using the fuzzy membership strategy to optimize the switching rules of the control system can greatly improve the control precision of the voltage regulation, that is, improve the regulation accuracy of the AC voltage regulator. It can be seen from the experiment results that the regulation accuracy of the system after optimizing the switching rule is 5-10 times preset, which proves the effectiveness of the improvement.

articleTitle: A Structural Representation Method for Information of Things in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: IoT (Internet of Things) has already gained more and more attentions globally. But the IoT is still young. With development of IoT and more and more requirements of integration of things information based on different connection technologies, a connection-technology-independent representation method for information of things is needed to give a unified definition and specification for information of things. In this paper, the necessary the unified definition and specification for information of things are discussed and a structural representation method for information of things in IoT is introduced, including the selection of representation tool, structural definition for information of things and concrete definition for information of things. The method can be a basis for standardization of things’ information, connection-technology-independent middleware and applications for IoT in future.

articleTitle: Relation of Web Service Orchestration, Abstract Process, Web Service and Choreography
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: We refine the relation of Web service orchestration, abstract process, Web service, and Web service choreography in Web service composition, under the situation of cross-organizational corporation. We also introduce the formal verification process of this relation through an example.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Target Detection and Tracking System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to meet the real-time detection and tracking of moving target, a hardware platform based on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is built. After analyzing Sum of Absolute Difference (SAD) algorithm and cross search algorithm, this paper focuses on the design of parallel search structure of tracking module, parallel matching structure of search module and parallel computing structure of SAD unit. Through the analysis of real-time video processing results, the effectiveness of the design scheme is proved.

articleTitle: Research on Hydraulic Decoking Monitoring System Based on FBG Vibration Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the petrochemical industry, delayed cooking is an important production process. This paper analyzes the principle of FBG vibration sensor. The automatic monitoring system of hydraulic defocusing is studied based on fiber optic vibration sensor. The fiber optic sensing system can detect the removal of coke in the coke tower automatically, and it can reduce the labor intensity of workers. It can also improve the automation level of real-time monitoring of hydraulic decoking system.

articleTitle: An Optimized Process of Multiscale Retinex Algorithm Based on Hardware System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper introduces an optimized process of Multiscale Retinex (MSR) algorithm that apply to the hardware system. Retinex theory is a constant color model derived from the Human Visual System (HVS) and can obtain more stable result for image enhancement than classic algorithms. Generally, the MSR model in Retinex is more suitable for enhancing images on hardware since it has less computation than other models. On the basis of ensuring the stability of the MSR algorithm results, we further optimize its calculation process. And the key issue in the restructuring model process is how to use the simplest Gaussian Convolution Kernel (GCK) to accomplish the Multiscale Gaussian Convolution (MSGC) assignment. Moreover, we briefly introduce the video display and the algorithm processing mechanisms in the hardware application, which includes a sophisticated Image Processing IP (IP-IP) based on the rearranged calculation process we designed. Under the real-time condition, the hardware system based on upgraded MSR can enhance smoothly color image and embrace a perfect performance in terms of visual intuition.

articleTitle: Study on Head Injury Criterion affected by the various rupture mode of window shield
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As a consequence of the innovation in the field of vehicle passive safety, the protection performance of vehicle against vulnerable road users (VRU) keeps attracting the attention of the society. In the basis of the unusual wind shield performance on the pedestrian protection test, this paper has started with the comparison analysis of the historical collecting data, following with standardizing an impact curve. In addition, an “Triangle-Arch” model has been established and the reliability has been verified. By parameterizing the entire complicated collision process, the intrinsic relationship, with regard to the windscreen performance, between the domain of passive safety (acceleration waveform) and glass manufacturing (glass properties) has been constructed.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Inclination Correction for Point Cloud in Dynamic Subsidence Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The stability of an instrument is a key factor in determining the quality of data acquired. During the process of dynamic deformation monitoring in mining areas, due to the impact of highly intensive underground mining practices, some non-uniform subsidence is likely to occur on the ground surface. Such subsidence will lead to relatively large inclination of the instrument within a short time, and consequently cause the automatic inclination compensator to exceed its limits during the scanning process. This is a particular problem encountered when the terrestrial laser scanner (TLS) is used for deformation monitoring in mining areas. This paper mainly analyzes the influence of inclination of the scanner upon precision of point cloud data based on the working principle of the scanner and puts forward an error correction method. First, the inclinations of an instrument at the beginning and at the end of a scanning process are recorded; second, the inclination of the instrument at every moment is determined basing on the relationship between the scanning time and the inclination of the instrument through interpolation, in this way the scanning point coordinates are being corrected. In the end, reasonability and effectiveness of the correction method are verified by means of experiment and comparison between the target control point and the feature planes within the scanning area before and after correction.

articleTitle: Maximum and minimum information transmission delay of the strong product networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Topological structure of interconnection network is a graph. Diameter and radius a graph play significant roles in analyzing efficiency of interconnection network, these are efficient parameters to measure the transmission delay or time delay in the network. Strong product graph is a effective method for designing large-scale interconnection networks through some small networks, and topological properties of such large networks are associated strongly with that of the corresponding smaller ones. In this paper, we investigate the diameter and radius of the strong product graph, and using these two parameters to measure the information transmission delay of the strong product networks.

articleTitle: Study on dynamic characteristics of a frictional and meshing V-belt drive based on finite element method
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the present study, Dynamic characteristics of friction and meshing V-belt is investigated by use of the finite element method, the dynamic model of the new friction and meshing composite V-belt is established, and the friction characteristics of the driven wheel and the load distribution of the belt body are analyzed. The results show that the friction zone between the driven wheel and the belt body of the friction and mesh composite V-belt drive will change from static angle to dynamic angle with the increase of tension transfer. (Abstract)

articleTitle: PTR-MirrorGAN: Parallel Text Redescription module for advancing MirrorGAN
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: During generating images from a given text description, two aspects of consistency are usually considered: visual consistency and semantic consistency. Although there has been a great improvement in the use of generative adversarial networks to generate images, it remains a challenging project to ensure that the semantics of the generated images are consistent with the semantics of the input text descriptions. This study proposed a Real-Fake Images Parallel Text Redescription Module (RFIPTRM) for advancing MirrorGAN based on the idea of mirroring and reconstructed the loss of the image generation model by adding the loss between the real text and the text from generated images to the genarators for balancing the textual semantic space. Intuitively, there may be inconsistency between the textual semantic space structure of our real text and the generated image, so we conducted adversarial learning between redescriptive text from the real images and the real text to improve the inconsistency of this text space structure. Comprehensive experiments conducted on the public benchmark datasets CUB and COCO have proved that PTR-MirrorGAN is superior to other methods and achieved a better generation effect.

articleTitle: Trajectory generalization based on spline curve and Gaussian distribution
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper primarily focuses on curve generalization over the repetitive trajectory. The method proposed in this paper assumes that the trajectory data in every timestamp satisfy Gaussian distribution and leverages a cubic uniform B-spline curve to represent the parameter of this Gaussian distribution. The parameter of the B-spline curve is calculated via maximum likelihood estimation. This paper compares the trajectory generalization methods based on the proposed method with the traditional Gaussian mixture model using the collected Brewing movement trajectory and demonstrates the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Pilot Test of Using Organic Nutrition Strengthening Technology to Treat High Nitrogenous Wastewater
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Biochemical treatment of coal chemical wastewater with high ammonia, organic nutrients enhancing technology, removal of organic pollutants and ammonia nitrogen the pilot study, the results show that when the contents of CODcr, NHs-N and TN in the test influent are $200 \sim 1000 mg/L, 200 \sim 250 mg/L$ and 300-350mg/L respectively, the dosing amount of the organic nutrients of 10mg / L, HRT 40H, water quality indicators have reached "diversion of water pollutant discharge standards along" (DB37/599-2006) protection of regional standards.

articleTitle: New results of optimal (u × v,{3,4}, 1,(⅔,⅓))-OOSPCs
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Multiple-weight optical orthogonal signature pattern codes (OOSPCs) were introduced by Kwong and Yang for 2-D image transmission in multicore-fiber optical code-division multiple-access (OCDMA) networks with multiple quality of services (QoS) requirement. In this paper, by using cyclotomic classes we obtian two series of optimal $\left(u \times v,\{3,4\}, 1,\left(\frac{2}{3}, \frac{1}{3}\right)\right)$ OOSPCs.

Author Keywords: multiple-weight optical orthogonal signature pattern code

articleTitle: Replicating Stock Trading Strategy by Means of Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Training a robot to replicate a successful trader’s strategy in the stock market could create huge amount of value. In this paper, we try to replicate trading strategies generated by technical indicators using different neural network and input features configuration. Experimental results suggest that satisfactory results could be achieved by means of convolution neural networks just from stock raw data without prior knowledge about the technical indicators the trader is applied to triggering his trading signals.

articleTitle: Assign orders to workstations in robotic sorting systems considering destination information
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Robotic sorting system is the newest implementation in intralogistics to replace costly manual workers. Such a system can be flexibly designed on a two-tier platform where robots derive on the top tier and sort parcels from workstations to drop-off points on spiral conveyors connected to roll containers at the lower tier. While enjoying higher throughput and lower operating cost than a traditional conveyor-based sorting system, such systems still face many challenging issues. One of those is the assignment of orders to workstations. We build a semi-open queueing network to estimate the system performance and design a heuristic to improve the assignment rule based on two benchmark rules. The analytical model is validated through simulation. Numerical results show that our heuristic procedure can improve both the system throughput time and the energy consumption by at least 10%.

articleTitle: Realization of the complementary doping top-gated graphene filed effect transistor
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The complementary doping top-gated graphene field effect transistor (GFET) was fabricated. The neutral polarity of channel doping in the GFET can be converted from n-type to p-type via altering the gate voltage sweeping range. This conversion can be attributed to the charge exchange between graphene and interface trap sites formed in O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> based atomic layer deposition $Al_{2}{O}_{3}$ dielectric layer. The external electric field across the metal/oxide/graphene stack could be tuned by the gate voltage. The charge carriers in channel are stored in trap sites and thus the intrinsic electric property of graphene is changed. This work opens the possibility of complementary p-and n-type top-gated graphene devices for multiple applications.

articleTitle: Comparative study of Amplitude Spectrum Estimation Methods for Vibration Test under Continuous Sinusoidal Excitation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Amplitude spectrum estimation is a kind of effective method for the vibration states. The effects of several commonly spectrum estimation methods in sinusoidal logarithmic frequency sweep vibration test were studied and the anti-interference abilities of four amplitude spectrum estimation methods (Harmonic, Average, RMS and Peak) were tested under measurement noise and input noise. Besides, their results were compared under the same estimation situation. At the same time, the amplitude spectrum estimation under the second-order system with single degree of freedom was extended to the second-order system with multiple degrees of freedom. After testing, comparing and verifying, the research provides a basis for selecting the appropriate amplitude spectrum estimation method in the vibration test.

articleTitle: Dynamic Frequency Assignment Method on the Battlefield with Complex Interference Constraints
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The dynamic frequency assignment problem (FAP) is an inevitable research topic in future wars. In this paper, we model the dynamic FAP as a combinatorial optimization problem. We divide the dynamic FAP into two phases and present a method to solve the problem in a tactical wireless communication network. Then based on the simulated annealing algorithm (SA) and the greedy algorithm, we propose an algorithm that optimizes the neighborhood search space, thus facilitating the generation of new solutions and the process of frequency adjustment. The improvement reduces the frequency number and cuts the influence of interference. The simulation results show that the improved method can solve the dynamic FAP on the battlefield, leading to a better assignment result than the general SA.

articleTitle: Research on Topology Automatic Recognition Technology of Medium Voltage Equipment in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The topological structure of the power grid is an intuitive reflection of the power transmission path and is an important power model information that determines the results of various power analysis and calculations. It plays a vital role in the operation of the power grid. At present, in the field of power distribution, relying on operation and maintenance personnel to maintain in the production management system, there are deviations between the data and the actual situation; especially in the case of a large number of equipment, the inaccuracy of the topology and the lagging update seriously affect the distribution network Stable operation. Therefore, the operators hope to be able to generate the topology map of the medium voltage distribution grid by themselves with the help of automated means. In this paper, by installing intelligent terminals and topology identification modules on the medium voltage equipment of the distribution network, the equipment is plug and play, and the topology identification information is obtained through the power frequency communication technology and the traveling wave ranging technology, and through the calculation and analysis of the master station, Solve the problem of automatic analysis, realize automatic identification of medium voltage equipment topology and automatic generation of topology diagrams. Through such technology, the topology of the distribution network can be obtained in real time and dynamically, better support the analysis and calculation of the distribution network, and better support the safe and stable operation of the distribution network.

articleTitle: A Pipeline-Friendly In-place Linear Transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In-place linear transformation has the characteristics of saving memory space. In this paper, based on Gaussian elimination, we propose an in-place linear transformation that is friendly for pipeline computations. The simulations show that the throughput of the proposed algorithm is up to around 60% higher than the prior approach. For larger-scale transformations, the proposed algorithm is comparable in single-thread performance with the math libraries, such as Eigen and MKL, while these libraries do not possess the in-place property.

articleTitle: Phoneme Sonority Sequence and Combination Mechanism of Consonant Clusters in Kazakh
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The relationship between sonority sequencing principle and syllable structures has been stated in phonology, and sonority hierarchy has been classified according to the type of articulation. Based on the above theory of acoustic phonetics, this experiment was designed to extract the sound intensity of each segment as the reference for sonority grade to analyze the combination mechanism of consonant clusters and their properties in syllable fabric in Kazakh. The results indicate that the combination mechanism of Kazakh consonant clusters is in the pattern of “strong +weak /high +low”. This pattern determines that Kazakh consonant cluster can only appear at the end of syllables rather than at the beginning of syllables. In all consonant clusters, the frequency of the first segment is inversely proportional to the sound intensity of the segment, which ensures the smooth transfer of sonority from the strong to the weak between the syllable nuclear and the first segment of consonant cluster. At the same time, the Kazakh syllable division rules determine that the combination of Kazakh consonant clusters is not stable. Consonant clusters could be destroyed and divided into two different syllables, so consonant clusters are more likely to be located at the end of a word.

articleTitle: Thoughts on the “14th Five-Year Plan” of Informatization Construction in University
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The article reviews the completion of the 13th Five-Year Plan for Informatization of South China University of Technology, combined with the new situation of the 14th Five-Year Plan for Informatization, and proposed that the 14th Five-Year Plan for informatization of our university should focus on innovation and integration, and accelerate the deployment of “New Infrastructure”, and take the construction of educational information system supporting the “double first-class” development level as the strategic goal. This article discusses the five key construction points of our university.

articleTitle: Design of External Damping Network and Discretization Algorithm for Long-endurance Inertial Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Shipborne strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) need to ensure long-term navigation accuracy and reliability. When SINS is used for a long time, without the assistance of external information, due to the drift of the inertial devices, the navigation results show divergent characteristics after integral operation. Horizontal damping introduces a damping network in the Schuler cycle of the system, so that the Schuler periodic oscillation error is damped. Compared with Kalman integrated navigation, the damping navigation system has better long-term stability. Through reasonable parameter settings damping network can ensure that navigation results do not diverge for a long time. This paper firstly constructs the external horizontal damping network, and then introduces bilinear transformation to derive the discretization damping method in detail. Simulation results show that the discretization damping network can ensure the reliable positioning accuracy during the long-term operation of the system, which proves that the damping network and the discretization method have broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Analysis of Rural Residents’ Demand for Health Information and Its Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Purpose: To understand the demand and influencing factors of medical information services for rural residents. Methods: Questionnaire was used to investigate the health information demand of rural residents, the degree and its influencing factors. Results: 41.36 percent of farmers need health information frequently, while the other 58.6 percent occasionally and rarely need it; whether their work or study are related to medicine and “whether residents inquire about health information actively” are the main factors to the degree of information demand. Conclusion: Medical and health practitioners should strengthen the publicity and education of health knowledge, improve the awareness of disease prevention and proactive health information query of rural residents, thus to increase their awareness of health information and promote the change of unhealthy behaviors.

articleTitle: Implementation Strategies and Issues for a Low-power Synchronized Timer in a Distributed Wireless Sensing Domain
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Synchronization between wireless sensor nodes is still an open question, especially in low-cost and low-power systems. In this paper we consider a type of star network in which the master periodically sends a synchronization message to the sensor nodes of its subnet. The aim of this paper is to analyze in detail the implementation limits of the commonly adopted solution, evidencing that an eccessively simple strategy leads to increasing errors or energy consumption. The solution proposed consist on implementing a continuous calibration algorithm operated by the slaves.

articleTitle: The Application of Big Data Technology in Financial Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: How to combine the big data technologies and the corporate financial analysis methodologies to collect, store and analyze various data and finally dig out useful and valuable business information is an interesting research question. This paper summary the application principles and the realization path of the big data technologies in corporate financial analysis. Then, this research analyses the theoretical and practical values of the combination of the big data technologies and corporate financial analysis methodologies. Last but not least, this paper constructed a process framework model for corporate financial analysis in the big data environment. The proposed process framework model is beneficial for the process improvement of corporate financial analysis. The proposed process framework model is also useful to improve the accuracy of corporate financial analysis.

articleTitle: Predictive Control with Disturbance Prediction for SCR Denitration System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of large delay and large inertia of the SCR denitration system of thermal power units, predictive control technology has been widely used and has shown superior control performance. However, when the system is subject to external disturbances, although the conventional predictive control algorithm has certain robustness, the overall anti-disturbance performance is not ideal. Therefore, for the measurable but uncontrollable external interference signal, we propose a control strategy for the prediction and compensation of disturbance information between coupling loops in this paper. This strategy includes the predictive control increment of the coupling loop through the disturbance prediction value generated by the disturbance model to the current control loop, make full use of the causal information of known disturbances to maximize the impact of uncontrollable inputs on process dynamics. The simulation results show that the control strategy has better interference suppression ability and effectively improves the control effect of SCR ammonia spraying.

articleTitle: Superpixel-level Structural Similarity Metric for Image Fusion Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is highly desirable to carry out an objective metric to evaluate the fused image quality. Existing metrics always extract image local features from image rectangular blocks to achieve assessment. However, the fixed shape of image block does not fit the natural attributes of the images and it is also not consistent with the perceptual characteristics of human visual system (HVS). In this paper, we presented a super-pixel level structural similarity metric for fused image quality assessment. Firstly, image features including brightness, gradient amplitude and texture complexity are extracted from adaptive super-pixel regions rather than rectangular blocks. Then, structural similarity of super-pixel level features between fused image and source images are calculated. Finally, the final metric is obtained by weighting average all local metrics according to super-pixel saliences. Experimental verifications are carried out in infrared and visible images, multi-focus images and medical images. Moreover, the experiments on stability analysis are carried out on a set of infrared and visible image sequence. The experimental results show that the proposed quality evaluation method has better performance and it is closer to the human visual evaluation results.

articleTitle: Research on Novel Method of Gait Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The main technology of gait recognition is feature expression and extract. At present, it is mainly divided into two categories: statistical feature based approach and model based approach. It has been widely used in many aspects, such as medical diagnosis, airport or railway station monitoring and motion tracking. Gait recognition mainly focuses on the analysis and processing of human motion image sequence, which usually includes four stages: target segmentation, feature extraction, feature processing and recognition classification. This paper is using Hanavan model that is model based approach to extract human gait features, and support vector machine and K-NN algorithm are used for classification and recognition. Finally, through experimental simulation analysis, it is concluded that SVM is more effective in gait classification.

articleTitle: Decision Support for Unit Control of Seawater Desalination Based on Prediction Intervals for Water Consumption Forecast
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The seawater desalination device such as the reverse osmosis (RO) is highly energy consumptive, thus its control becomes an important research topic in the field of energy saving and environment protection. One solution is to reduce the number of running equipment as much as possible without impacting the water production process. In this work, a unit start-stop decision support algorithm is proposed by using the interval prediction of downstream water consumption based on the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). By incorporating the gradient truncation and the displacement iteration, the Iteration-Gated Recurrent Unit (I-GRU) algorithm is proposed to enhance the prediction on continuous autocorrelation data. A composite loss function of QD loss, Case-0 loss and L1 loss is proposed to treat the particularity of the operation data and model used for interval prediction. Finally, the decision-support approach is applied to the unit start-stop control based on the error probability distribution of the interval core value generated by the water consumption forecasting model. Experiments results are presented to show the feasibility and validity of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on tuning of antenna for RFID reader based on 13.56MHz
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The communication performance between RFID reader and tag based on 13. 56MHz largely depends on the design and debugging of antenna matching circuit of the reader. The better the antenna tuning is, the more energy the tag gets, and the farther the reading and writing distance is. This paper introduces the design of the matching circuit from two dimensions of direct matching and 50 ohm long distance matching, and introduces the debugging method of the matching circuit in detail. The actual test results show that the method can not only improve the communication distance between reader and tag, but also effectively reduce the high-order harmonics of the circuit, which has a strong promotion significance.

articleTitle: An efficient parallel algorithm for determining flow directions over flat surfaces based on raster digital elevation models
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The determination of flow directions is an essential step for drainage network extraction, and flat surfaces are common features in flow direction determination. With the challenge of a massive volume of digital elevation models (DEMs), to reduce the running time and memory usage, there is a growing need to develop parallel algorithms to calculate flow directions over flat surfaces. We propose an efficient parallel algorithm for flow directions over flat surfaces based on the existing serial algorithm and three-step parallel framework. The proposed algorithm assigns pre-divided tiles to consumer processes to build local graphs. Then the producer process builds global graphs based on all the local graphs. Finally, consumer processes update the local graphs based on the global graphs and determine flow directions over flat surfaces. For all tested DEMs, the speed-up ratios are greater than 5 with 11 consumer processes. The strong scaling efficiencies are greater than 40% with 11 consumer processes. The proposed algorithm can run generally faster, use less memory, and process massive DEMs that cannot be successfully processed using the existing serial algorithm. This study shows that the proposed algorithm is an ideal parallel algorithm for determining flow direction over flat surfaces in massive DEMs.

articleTitle: Staffing Optimization In Aircraft Assembly Pulsation Line
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The utilization rate of staff resource deeply affects the production performance in the aircraft assembly pulsation line. Most of the researches are focused on the problem that how to create and solve the staffing optimization model. However, in the aircraft assembly pulsation line, due to the complex logical relationship and resource requirements, it is difficult to express such constraints in the staffing model. In this paper, a new method is proposed for the solution of staffing optimization question in the aircraft assembly pulsation line. First, the formal expression of staff resource and line is defined, based on which the staff allocation method is established to minimize the total number of staff in the line. The initial plan for the allocation of staff is achieved through the genetic algorithm. Second, creating model based on discrete event simulation platform. And a simulation-based method is built to solve the staff resource considering the constraint of the capacity. The solution of staff allocation is calculated by applying the simulation iteration. Finally, taking an aircraft assembly pulsation line as an example, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: AGOPredict: A Predictor for Identifying Argonaute Proteins
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In eukaryotes, argonaute proteins (Agos) play a vital role in RNA interference (RNAi) pathways by functioning as RNA-guided RNA endonucleases. In prokaryotes, Agos usually bind small RNAs or small DNAs to defense against foreign invasive genomes. In recent years, studies have shown that prokaryotic argonaute protein (pAgo) has the potential as candidate “scissors” for gene editing. But at present, the number of Agos is still very small, and many potential Agos are yet to be discovered. Therefore, it is necessary to find a way to quickly and easily identify Agos. In this work, we developed a SVM-based predictor named AGOPredict for identifying Agos by using the optimal dipeptide composition. The SVM model can reach 98.48% accuracy with 0.97 MCC evaluated by the leave-one-out cross-validation. AGOPredict will be a promising tool, which will accelerate the discovery of new Agos, provide more data sources for Ago researchers, and promote the follow-up research of Ago.

articleTitle: An Efficient Heuristic Algorithm for Solving 0-1 Knapsack Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The model for 0-1 knapsack problem based on greedy strategy and expectation efficiency has some advantages, e.g., quick convergence and low complexity, but it also inherently exists some limitations to be enhanced and improved, such as the restricted greedy and the overmuch calculation on expectation efficiency. To this end, an efficient algorithm is proposed to optimize the previous model. At first, the greedy degree is maximized, that is, some items are permanently loaded into knapsack in advance as many as possible. Then, the conventional expectation efficiency model is improved greatly, at the same time, the number of calculations with respect to expectation efficiency is decreased by ignoring some unnecessary items. Compared to the previous algorithm, the experimental results reveal that the proposed optimization algorithm has the significant advantages in time.

articleTitle: Research on Precision Marketing Model of the Inspection and Certification E-commerce Platform based on Personalized Recommendation and It’s Application
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Inspection and certification industry is an important part of modern service industry, at present, most of the world’s inspection and certification institutions only include a narrow field of inspection and certification services and could not meet the customer’s increasingly improving inspection comprehensive, extensive, timeliness, accuracy, convenience and other aspects of the needs. So, it’s extremely significant to plan a practical marketing strategy for inspection and certification e-commerce platform. In order to solve this problem, through the analysis of the precision marketing process of the inspection and certification e-commerce platform, this paper proposes the personalized recommendation mechanism for precision marketing, and forms the precision marketing model of the inspection and certification e-commerce platform. The model is effectively applied in China’s inspection and certification e-commerce service cloud platform - CCTEK, could provide detailed guidance for inspection and certification e-commerce platform, which promotes the inspection and certification e-commerce platform using personalized recommendation and other big data technology to achieve precision marketing.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-mode Auto-drilling Technology of AC Variable Frequency Rig
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In view of the fact that single mode auto-drilling can not meet the requirements of different targets and different drilling stages for automatic drilling, several kinds of auto-drilling technology in multi-mode are studied, including constant rate of penetration (ROP) control, constant weight on bit (WOB) control, constant pump pressure control, constant power control and constant torque control, and corresponding auto-drilling control systems are constructed respectively. In view of the complexity of drilling process and the difficulty in establishing mathematical model, the active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) strategy is proposed after analyzing the relationship among various factors affecting the drilling. The algorithm does not need the precise mathematical model of the control object, and can modify the control parameters in real time through self-learning. The experiment results show that the control effect is good, the auto-drilling can be realized on the basis of multi-mode target, and the control algorithm is also universal.

articleTitle: A high efficiency acoustic energy scanvage circuit applied on ECG signal detection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: An efficient audio energy acquisition circuit is adopted, which uses a two-stage Dixon voltage doubling rectifier to amplify the audio energy by 4 times and rectify it into a DC voltage to supply power to the later circuit. The diodes in the Dixon rectifier adopt the structure of active diodes based on comparators. At the same time, the comparator adopts unbalanced bias structure, which counteracts the offset voltage caused by the comparator mismatch by establishing the built-in offset voltage, which effectively solves the problem of current leakage of the comparator. The simulation results show that the reverse leakage current of the unbalanced bias comparator is significantly reduced and the input AC audio energy is magnified 4 times and rectified into a stable DC voltage, which realizes the voltage doubling and rectifying function of the audio energy acquisition circuit. the voltage conversion efficiency is more than 80%.

articleTitle: Three Evaluation Indexes of P2P Online Lending Willingness and Prediction Based on ANN-LR
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The P2P online lending industry has gradually developed with the rise of the Internet. As the main source of funds for the industry, the capital contribution of investors affects the sustainable and stable development of the industry. A scientific and reasonable prediction of the willingness to invest can be used for the operation and decision-making of online lending platforms. In order to avoid the bias of using the capital contribution S to measure the willingness to invest, this paper progressively proposes three evaluation indexes ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> that integrate the borrower’s lending amount D, lending interest rate r and investment risk p to measure the willingness of P2P online lending. According to the above three indexes, the ANN-LR method is used to predict the willingness to lending. Firstly, the Logistic Regression (LR) method is used to predict the capital contribution risk P of each bid, and then the three progressive and relative indexes are used to predict the willingness of P2P online lending. The predicted results show that, in the prediction of the willingness to invest in P2P online lending, if more accurate the prediction result is required, you can choose ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>. If you want to shorten the total duration of learning while ensuring the accuracy of the results, you can choose ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> for comprehensive consideration. The results obtained are more scientific and reasonable, and more realistic, and ρ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> can be selected.

articleTitle: Water Body Extraction of Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Image Based on Combining Residual U-Net and Conditional Random Field
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the training difficulty of neural network model increases with the increase of the number of network layers due to the disappearance of gradient, a method by combining residual U-Net and conditional random field for water body extraction from hyperspectral remote sensing image is proposed. A deeper model based on the U-Net semantic model by adding residual units is constructed, and then a conditional random field is connected after the output of the model to further optimize the output category and refine the image segmentation results. As experimental data, the Zhuhai-1 hyperspectral satellite image is selected to training and validation for the proposed method. The experimental results show that, compared with the water index method, support vector machine, U-Net semantic model and residual U-Net model, the proposed method has the best effect in water body extraction from the hyperspectral remote sensing image.

articleTitle: Research on Customers’ Purchase Decision Factors for Smart Speaker
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The technological revolution of the past few decades has brought about some future inventions. Technological breakthroughs are largely driven by information revolution: Internet connects the world, and mobile computing makes this kind of connection become ubiquitous. This revolution makes users’ lives more convenient and smart. Smart products are becoming more and more popular, and smart speaker is considered as the entrance for people to step into smart life. With the support of smart technology, thanks to its special functions being different from that of traditional speaker, it attracts more and more people’s attention, and is especially pursued and loved by technology lovers and young people. The research summarizes 12 related factors affecting consumer’s purchase of smart speaker with the method of literature analysis combining with user survey. It uses decision-making laboratory method to analyze and study 40 pcs of online and offline questionnaire data and draws cause-and-effect diagram. The finally obtained three main factors affecting consumers’ purchase of smart speaker are price factor, brand factor, and function factor; It clarifies the relationship among the relevant factors greatly affecting consumers’ purchase of smart speaker, and further analyzes the problems existing in the product innovation design of smart speaker, thus putting forward relevant countermeasures and suggestions for seeking the breakthrough point in product innovation design.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Channel Selection in the Process of E-Commerce Brand Internationalization Based on Weighted Model
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to make an empirical study on the online business environment data of various countries, and get the better choice of E-Commerce brand channel in the process of internationalization. First of all, taking the brand of E-Commerce platform development as the research object, through the analysis of the factors influencing the choice of online and offline marketing channels in the international market, this paper selects the macro quantitative index factors. Secondly, 12 countries are selected as samples, and the weighted model is used to calculate the index weight. Finally, it is concluded that in countries with better economic development, it is better for enterprises to choose online marketing channels to enter the international market, otherwise, it is better to choose offline marketing channels.

articleTitle: Self-learning Constellation Mapping Method Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Neural networks have been gained extensive study and application in the communication systems. This paper applies the neural networks to the transmitter, which proposes a self-learning constellation mapping method. The proposed method contains two kinds of neural networks. One is used to generate a new constellation mapping which can compensate the channel distortion. The other one is used to determine whether the newly generated constellation mapping is optimal. These two types of neural networks constitute an actor-critic architecture which is trained through the reinforcement learning method. Without losing generality, this paper applies the proposed method to the quadrature amplitude modulation systems. In the simulation experiments, the proposed method can generate some new quadrature amplitude modulation constellation diagrams which can compensate in advance the amplitude and phase distortion caused by the channel. Moreover, the performance of the proposed method is superior to the classical compensation method. Significantly, the neural networks in the proposed method are trained online, so there is no need to prepare a large amount of artificial data sets in the training phase.

articleTitle: Research and System Development on Intelligent Optimization Design Technology Of Steel Structure Frame
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: According to the present situation of the poor intelligence in the optimization design of steel structure frame, a new technology rout of structural optimization design is put forward in computer-aided design, the optimization design concepts of intelligent modeling, intelligent computation, intelligent post-processing and intelligent drawing are put forward and related technologies are described. According to the research results of related technologies, the author's team developed an intelligent optimization design system for steel frame based on large-scale finite element calculation software such as PKPM, which greatly improved the design efficiency of steel frame, the safety and economy of steel structure frame design are improved.

articleTitle: Design of a Simulator for Airworthiness Verification of Airborne Navigation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Airworthiness verification is a key problem for air borne navigation equipments and laboratory verification can be a first step for the problem. In order to design an appropriate simulator for these equipments, the airworthiness verification requirements for navigation equipments are analyzed and a simulator design scheme that meets the relevant airworthiness verification specifications is proposed. Taking GBAS landing system (GLS) airborne equipment as an example, a software system for simulator is designed after building an external environment model according to airworthiness requirements. The landing signals generation show the designed simulator can achieve the expected design goals.

articleTitle: Application of flywheel energy storage device in vital places
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Flywheel energy storage technology, as an advanced energy storage technology with a complete technical theoretical system, in-depth research progress, and rapid follow-up of new technologies and materials at this stage, has the theoretical foundation conditions for application. Flywheel energy storage equipment can be used to support high-power loads in important places. In application, it is necessary to fully consider the power quality indicators of the power supply system. Power quality can be described by various indicators systematically. This article introduces several energy storage methods, and introduces several types of more common voltage-sensitive electrical equipment. A practical application case is introduced. The application shows that when flywheel energy storage equipment is equipped with high-power sensitive electrical equipment in important places, its output is stable and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on a new topic crawler based on HITS algorithm and semantic fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The topic crawler needs to filter for Web prior to crawl Web page, and the crawl strategy of traditional topic crawler is to evaluate the content or evaluate the link relation, for the former topic crawler usually lack of overall importance, it is difficult to reflect the whole situation of the Web, and the theme crawler implemented by the latter will crawl to a large number of topic irrelevant pages in the later stage of crawling. In this paper, a new topic crawler algorithm is designed. The SVSM model is built to calculate the topic relevance of web pages, and HITS algorithm is used to calculate the comprehensive score of web pages. The topic crawler crawls the web page in the order of ranking from highest to lowest. In this paper, the new crawler is compared with two traditional crawlers under the same experimental environment, and the accuracy of the new topic crawler is 23% higher than that of the traditional topic crawler.

articleTitle: A Method of Multi-Sensor Data Fusion Based on SPA
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of multi-sensor data fusion, a method of multi-sensor data fusion based on set pair analysis (SPA) is present in this paper. On the basis of set pair closeness degree, the concept of SPA closeness degree matrix is put forward. Based on the principle of information sharing and merging, The proportion of data provided by every sensor is solved in the process of data fusion. The example in this paper show that this method can solve the question of multi-sensor data fusion preferably.

articleTitle: Eddy Current Loss Calculation for Permanent Magnet Eddy-current Coupler
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents an analytical method for calculating the eddy current loss of permanent magnet eddy-current coupler (PMEC). A magnetic equivalent circuit (MEC) model considering the eddy current effect and leakage is established. Then, based on Kirchhoff’s law and Ampere’s law of loop, the flux density passing through the conductor rotor and the induced magnetic field are solved respectively. Thus, the eddy current loss is calculated according to the energy conservation principle. This method is finally evaluated and validated by experiments, and the results show that the proposed model is in good agreement with measurement.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling Simulation of Power Oscillation in Thermal Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, the model of steam turbine and speed control system considering the influence of boiler and other equipment is established, and the load is simulated by upper step to verify the correctness of the model. Combined with the negative damping mechanism of power oscillation and forced power oscillation mechanism, the mathematical model of power oscillation caused by speed regulation system is derived, and several typical fault modes are summarized. For different fault modes, the corresponding simulation methods are given. Finally, Prony algorithm is used to identify the characteristic parameters of power response, and the measures to suppress power oscillation are analyzed and given.

articleTitle: Recommender for Channel Pruning with Weakly Supervised Meta Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The switchable neural network makes it feasible to deploy a deep neural network to a specific hardware platform by adjusting architectures but without retraining parameters. However, searching out the suitable architecture to adjust is time consuming and computation-tense. To accelerate searching architectures, this paper designs a recommender which takes one round to search and evaluate without repeating. In training stages, the recommender is alternately trained with a meta network which offers the recommender gradients as weakly supervision. In searching stages, the trained recommender extracts features from a specified layer’s outputs, and generates suggested channels to prune for every layer. The recommender is deployed and evaluated on three common classification neural networks, including ResNet, MobileNet-v1 and MobileNet-v2. Experimental results validate that the proposed recommender is able to obtain compressed architectures whose accuracies surpass the switchable neural network’s accuracy at a speed faster than evolutionary algorithm based searching methods.

articleTitle: Speed tracking control of mowing robot based on sliding mode control
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to the existence of factors such as uneven grassland, the motion control of mowing robot is unstable and timely. In this paper, the position control law of the robot is designed to track the position of the mowing robot, and the attitude control law is designed to track the motion angle. On this basis, a closed-loop sliding mode trajectory tracking control system with an inner ring and an outer ring is designed to ensure the stability of trajectory tracking. In this paper, we mainly use S-Function, and write the programs corresponding to each S function module. The simulation results realize the trajectory tracking of the mowing robot. The car can realize the trajectory tracking function.

articleTitle: Thermal Modeling and Test Validation of SVOM satellite
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The paper demonstrates the thermal modeling of SVOM satellite built by commercial software Thermica-Sinda. Calculating process is rescheduled to solve the problem when computing the conduction module because of irregular meshes used in the reduced thermal mathematical model of the payload. The model is verified successfully through TVAC.

articleTitle: Abnormal recognition of massive electric power data based on RF and CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In electric power field, electric power data collection equipment collects electric power data every 15 minutes, 96-digit data will be generated for the same account every day. The data generated include highly available real-time electric power data, as well as abnormal data caused by problems such as equipment failures, changes in the enterprise industry, electric power theft and leakage, etc. When using the traditionally manual method to process the exception of electric power data, it cannot meet the needs of current massive data, high throughput, and low latency. In order to better distinguish abnormal data, indicate the cause of the abnormality, and provide support for subsequent abnormal data management on this basis, the paper has carried out the applied research of the combined anomaly analysis model based on random forest and convolutional neural network. Firstly, it analyses the characteristics of massive electric power data and the categories of abnormal causes in detail, and uses the LOF algorithm to perform abnormal data filtering on the massive electric power data. Then, it performs random forest and convolutional neural network model training on the massive electric power data, and uses an automated method to identify the cause of the abnormality for the massive electric power data. Finally, experiments were performed to verify the efficiency, low latency, and feasibility of using the combined RF and CNN model to process the classification of abnormal reasons. From the results, the combined model can well meet the needs of the classification and recognition of abnormal reason on massive electric power data, and it is an effective solution to solve the current problem of identifying abnormal reasons of electric power data.

articleTitle: Research on Methods of Suppressing Starting Current Spike of LLC Resonant Vehicle Charger
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: LLC resonant vehicle chargers have been widely used due to their low cost, high efficiency, wide output voltage range, and high reliability. However, when the charger is started, a very high current spike will be generated on the resonant inductance, and its value can reach dozens of times the inductor current in steady state, making the working conditions of the switching tube very bad, and it is very easy to cause irreversible breakdown of the switching tube which seriously threatens the safety of all the components of the charger. This paper analyzes the methods of limiting the peak value of the current in starting progress, and designs a new soft-start strategy using hybrid control of PWM and PFM. This strategy combines the two control strategies and is more effective in reducing the peak value of the current which make the on-board charger operate safely in the occasion of higher power.

articleTitle: Analysis and treatment for a insulation resistance decreasing accident of clamp to the ground in main transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, insulation resistance of clamp to the ground in the main transformer is reduced during the test of on-site handover. By entering the box at the scene of the substation to check the status for each part of clamp in the main transformer, the reason for insulation resistance decreasing accident of clamp to the ground in main transformer is confirmed, and two schemes of on-site treatment are proposed. Scheme one is selected and implemented after the full demonstration. And it is shown that the scheme is suitable for abnormal conditions similar to the main transformer when the test of on-site partial discharge in the main transformer and operation assessment are completed.

Author Keywords: Insulation resistance of clamps to ground

articleTitle: Investigation of linear fit and maximum injury distribution of SBL-B aPLI
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Flex-PL I is the most used legform impactor in pedestrian protection test at present. However, Flex-PLI was found deficient in kinematics and biofidelity, especially in impactions of high vehicles such as SUVs. A legform impactor named advanced Pedestrian Legform Impactor (aPLI) was designed to have better kinematics and biofidelity and a optimized version SBL-B was released already. Comparison of the new and the old version of aPLI was conducted to find out their linear dependence and injury distribution. SBL-B results show reduced injuries and improved scores evaluated by NCAP test protocol, if compared with SBL-A results. Besides, aPLI performances on sedans and SUVs were distinguished as their different maximum injury positions.

articleTitle: The non-probability interval reliability design method on entire roller embedded shapemeter roll
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For entire roller embedded shapemeter roll, the uncertain range of the strip tension was determined by the gay degree theory, the reliability function that there was no slip between strip and shapemeter roll and the reliability function that strength failure of the detect roll did not occurred were deduced by the non-probability interval reliability theory. On this basis, the non-probability interval reliability optimization design model of detect roll was built, and the shapemeter roll diameter was calculated by field experiment data. The result showed that the shapemeter roll can normally work, when the outer diameter and inner diameter of shapemeter roll were 400mm and 260mm respectively.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Micro Distribution Interconnection System Based on Long-scale Power Flow Calculation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: When connecting to microgrid in traditional distribution network, interconnected system faces a series of problems to be solved from long-scale power flow calculation to short-scale economic operation analysis to ultra-short-scale stable operation. In this paper, aiming at the problem of interconnection system planning in long-scale simulation, the influence of different access points, different penetration rates and different combined power generation conditions on system power flow when microgrid is connected to distribution network is simulated. The simulation results show that the access of microgrid will bring great influence to the power flow of distribution network. Therefore, when the system is running, it should be selected to dispatch the microgrid when its external power is small, so as to avoid excessive fluctuation of the system and affect the power supply quality.

articleTitle: An Omnidirectional Dual-polarized Antenna for MIMO Communication System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A broadband omnidirectional dual-polarized antenna is proposed in this paper. The basic idea of the antenna is the development of cylindrical conformal array. By using a new designed double patch structure antenna element, both polarization ports of the designed antenna can obtain broad bandwidth. Measurement results show that the antenna achieves a bandwidth of 17.5% (return loss S$_{11} \gt 10$dB). Simultaneously, quadrangular conformal array is adopted in this design. By using this structure, two polarization ports of the proposed antenna achieve ideal omnidirectional radiation pattern in a very large bandwidth. Good agreement between the simulated results and measured results is obtained.

articleTitle: Non-uniform Strong Noise Removal Method of Non-cooperative Mine Target Image
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The detection of mine targets will be interfered by the underwater non-uniform strong noise (organic matter, suspended particles, etc). To solve this problem, the paper proposes a novel denoising method. Firstly, a new optimization filtering algorithm LEP-EPC is proposed based on the local edge-preserving (LEP) filtering algorithm. A spatially adaptive edge perception constraint regularization term is introduced into the model to better represent the edges and details of the image, so that the edge-preserving and smoothing property of the algorithm is better. Secondly, the paper uses multi-scale strategy to solve the non-uniformity of strong noise, iteratively applies the LEP-EPC algorithm to the noise removal results of each scale to generate multi-scale decomposition, and gradually increases the denoising scale in the process of multi-scale decomposition. The strong noise of different scales is gradually separated from the mine targets image. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can remove the underwater non-uniform strong noise while retaining the mine target information, which also has a certain guiding significance for mine operation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Microsatellite CAN Bus Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to its advantages of light weight, small size and short launch period, etc., microsatellite is widely applied in military and civil fields. In order to further improve the data processing ability of microsatellite and optimize the integrated electronic system architecture, this paper presents a satellite CAN bus communication system which is suitable for microsatellite. Based on the FPGA module of SmartFusion2 chip, this design implements the IP core expansion of CAN bus, and carries out the dual redundancy design of two-stage bus, which can increase the integration of satellite system while improving the reliability and stability of communication network, and can be applied to the integrated design of satellite operation and attitude control. According to CAN communication protocol, CAN communication function is designed, which can be adopted for data polling, data processing, communication fault diagnosis and other operations. Finally, the rationality and reliability of the hardware and software design are verified by connecting the onboard computer with the real-time simulator to conduct joint simulation, thus meeting the design requirements.

articleTitle: Design Method of Collision Avoidance Impulsive Maneuvers in the Final Approaching stage of Rendezvous and Docking Based on the rectangular Keep-Out-Zone
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on the Hill equation, a general design method of collision avoidance impulsive maneuver in the final approaching stage of R-bar rendezvous and docking is proposed. If the passive safety mode with a very low approaching speed is used to approach the target spacecraft, which will lead to a long flight time. Therefore, the active safety mode is often adopted to approach the target spacecraft in engineering application, so it is necessary to present a design method of an emergency collision avoidance impulsive maneuvers. This thesis makes researches on designing a general method of collision avoidance impulsive maneuvers on the basis of cuboid Keep-Out-Zone, considering the impact of the size of the target and the attitude error. The collision avoidance impulsive maneuvers scheme proposed in this paper can ensure safety under the worst conditions, which provides the foundation in theory for the future rendezvous and docking.

articleTitle: Subjective Image Quality Assessment: A Pre-Assessment on Visual Distortion of Medical Images by Clinicians and Radiologists
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Interdisciplinary researches are increasingly significant in the current global situation. Image Quality Assessment, or IQA, is a process to determine the level of accuracy to a single image. In IQA, usually, two essential assessments will involve, which are Subjective IQA and Objective IQA. This paper proposes a novel ’pre-assessment’ approach, combining with Subjective IQA, aiming for researchers to receive relevant knowledge which is beyond their principle professional fields, so that they can design and plan the formal Subjective and Objective IQA suitably and accordingly. In the paper, a practised example named ’Predict the Impact of Visual Distortion on Medical Images’ has been introduced throughout, which has demonstrated the efficiencies of supposed pre-assessment methodology, by necessary statistics and analysis. The paper also summarises several circumstances where recommend researchers to consider to conduct a pre-assessment, especially under interdisciplinary researches.

articleTitle: Ship Steering Design Based on NOMOTO Equation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper describes the ship’s steering process and the common practice of the crew during steering operation. It analyzes and finds the mathematical theoretical basis of the crew steering control. According to its theoretical basis and considering the wind and flow conditions from the steering timing, steering rudder angle and steering time. The steering of the ship was designed and verified by the MATLAB Simulink simulation environment. The verification results show the actual operability of the design.

articleTitle: Integrated Navigation and Positioning based on UWB
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the service robot industry, the realization of autonomous robot indoor navigation has become the focus of research and development institutions. Due to the low cost and high precision, ultra-wideband (UWB) positioning has become an ideal indoor positioning solution.
