However, under non-line-of-sight (NLOS) conditions, the positioning accuracy of UWB signals will be reduced, and the deviation of the positioning solution due to signal interference will cause the trajectory of the solution to be discontinuous and jump, which makes it impossible to complete continuous measurement. To solve this problem, the UWB/INS integrated navigation method is adopted. Field tests show that the adopted method can track the navigation continuous without jumping, which greatly improves the positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Degradation Representation of Rolling Bearings Based on a Constitution Health Index
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Roller bearings are commonly used components in rotating machinery and are pruned to be failure, which may cause huge economic losses and even casualties. Vibration signals of rolling bearings are signs of rotating machinery. Therefore, they can be used to describe the process of performance degradation. Unfortunately, the signals exhibit non-stationary and non-linear as well as highly non-monotonic behaviors as the bearing condition degrades especially under complex working conditions. In this paper, a method to construct a constitution health index based on vibration signals is presented. Firstly, 40 features in time domain, frequency domain, time-frequency domain and entropy domain are extracted individually. Then, the combined evaluation index is constructed based on the above 40 features in terms of monotonicity, robustness, predictability and correlation. Finally, by comparing the degradation fusion indexes of rolling bearings under different operating conditions with the traditional characteristics, the remaining useful life prediction method based on grey correlation analysis is proposed. The results suggest that the proposed method can effectively predict the RUL of rolling bearings with an acceptable degree of accuracy up to 90%, which outperforms the traditional features.

articleTitle: Power Allocation for Secrecy Rate Maximization in Secure UAV-Cooperative Communications
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Cooperative communications enabled by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can enlarge the transmission distance and coverage area. However, there is a serious issue of information security in UAV-cooperative wireless networks due to the broadcast feature of air-to-ground wireless channel. The framework of physical layer security provides an alternative technology to cope with this problem. Therefore, based on physical layer security, this paper focuses on maximizing the secrecy rate of a UAV-cooperative wireless networks by allocating the optimal power to the transmitter and the UAV. To deal with the difficulties of the resulting optimization problem, difference of convex (DC) programming is introduced to transform the primal problem into a series of convex subproblems which can be solved iteratively by some available convex optimization algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed optimal power allocation algorithm can achieve a higher secrecy rate than the maximum power allocation algorithm does.

articleTitle: Research on Spectrum Sharing of Cognitive Satellite Network Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of wireless Internet services, the number of users in wireless communication systems has increased exponentially, which requires more spectrum and continuous bandwidth. Due to the current fixed spectrum access policy, the available spectrum is less and less, and a large number of spectrum is still not fully utilized. Dynamic spectrum management is an effective method to realize spectrum sharing, which can realize the effective utilization of spectrum resources. Cognitive radio network is the key technology to realize dynamic spectrum access. This paper studies the spectrum sharing method of cognitive satellite network, analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the current dynamic spectrum access mechanism, and puts forward the spectrum sharing system of cognitive satellite network based on blockchain, which not only realizes the maximum utilization of spectrum, but also solves the security problem of dynamic spectrum access. The basic principle of this method are described in detail.

articleTitle: Study on Modeling of Ship Heading Control System Based on RBFNN-DCBC
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A control system model based on radial basis function neural network-discrete command-filtered backstepping control (RBFNN-DCBC) is proposed, for the uncertain, nonlinear and adaptive problem of ship heading control in rough sea states. Firstly, the complex nonlinear mathematical model of ship heading control is proposed, and then radial basis function (RBF) neural network is designed to approximate the complex nonlinear term. Secondly, the accurate estimation value of heading angular velocity is obtained by designing state observer, and then the command-filtered backstepping controller is designed with regards to the virtual control law of heading angular velocity and the actual control law of rudder angle. Meanwhile, to eliminate the command-filtered error itself, a compensator is introduced to compensate the error timely and accurately. Finally, the controlled system has proven to be asymptotically stable, and the block diagram of ship heading control system based on RBFNN-DCBC is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Standardized Design of Satellite Data Stream Based on Packet Format
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The complex and diverse satellite data flow and the customization of the corresponding on-board processing software are one of the major bottlenecks that influence the current standardization of satellite design and rapid development. The universal design and definition of satellite control information and parameter information are used in the form of CCSDS data packet to realize the specialization of satellite information flow by referring to the successful experience of packet telemetry and packet telecommand. The on-board data stream, space-to-ground data stream and space-to-space data stream can be unified through standardization design method based on the packet format, which promotes standardization of the on-board software design, on-board equipment design and satellite interface design. Software reusability and reliability of on-board software are also developed. By this means, the efficiency of satellite development can be improved, and both the cycle and the cost of satellite development can be reduced.

articleTitle: An Improved particle swarm optimization algorithm based on chaotic BAS strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To improve the simplified particle swarm optimization (SPSO) algorithm that is easy to fall into local optimum, the Beetle Antennae Search Chaos Simplified Particle Swarm Optimization (BCSPSO) is proposed based on the Beetle Antennae Search Algorithm and chaos strategy. The Logistic chaos is used to generate chaotic sequences for initialization. Beetle Antennae Search (BAS) has its own judgment of the environment space in each iteration, and not only depends on the best solution and the particles in SPSO individuals of the current global optimal solution, after the particle swarm into local optimum effectively jump out, improved the search speed and precision of the particle swarm, the simulation results show that the algorithm can jump out of local optimal, optimization effect is good, has the good dynamics, stability and efficiency.

articleTitle: The dislocation density of GaN LED epitaxial films grown on Si substrates characterized by X - ray diffraction
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The dislocation densities of GaN LED epitaxial films grown on Si(I11) substrates have been characterized using X-ray diffraction. By the Lattice- Rotation model, the screw and edge dislocation densities of the samples were calculated. The results indicate that the GaN LED films grown on Si substrates have strongly crystal orientation and property. The threading dislocation density of the sample was determined as 1$.8\times 10^{9}\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}^{-2}$or so. In addition, The result of TEM observation for the sample showed that the dislocation density near the regions of InGaN MQW and buffer layers was respectively estimated as the magnitude of $10^{8}\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}^{-2}$ and $10^{10}\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}^{-2}$, which are consistent with the results determined by X-ray diffraction.

articleTitle: A novel whale optimization algorithm and its application in metallurgical process
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To solve the limitations existing in the standard whale optimization algorithm (WOA), a convergence factor based on the sine function is designed to balance the exploration and development abilities of the WOA, furthermore, an improved opposition-based learning strategy is proposed to accelerate the convergence rate of the algorithm, in addition, the mutation operation based on the population diversity is employed to reduce the probability that the algorithm gets caught in the local optimum, the simulation result shows that the novel WOA presents a superior convergence rate and accuracy to the basic WOA.

articleTitle: Optimizing Power Distribution Process on Ships: Research on Energy Management Strategy of Photovoltaic-Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the increasingly complex power system on ships, photovoltaic system plays an important role. Some of them have the problem of unstable output power and power fluctuation caused by sudden load unloading. Therefore, the energy storage stabilization system is needed to suppress this instability. A modified typical topology based on DC bus is adopted, in which photovoltaic array and hybrid energy storage are connected to the load on DC bus respectively through the converters. Aiming at the shortage of the traditional limit management method, a power distribution method based on the supercapacitor charge state is proposed, and the control strategy and working mode of each converter are given. MATLAB/Simulink is adopted for modeling. The analysis on simulation results and engineering test results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed hybrid energy storage management method and converter control strategy. They can reduce the influence of charge and discharge process of hybrid energy storage, maintain the stability of dc bus voltage, and guarantee the effective work of whole power system.

articleTitle: Query Interface Schema Extraction for Hidden Web Resources Searching
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is an urgent task of the Web search field to satisfy people’s demand for having effective access to the high-quality Web. Instead of specifying a URL to send an HTTP request to get the static page information, accessing hidden Web resources (deep Web) need to post queries to the query interface provided by the website. The query interface is the entrance to get the Web database information. Therefore, the research on schema extraction from deep Web query interface is a key step in hidden Web resources mining. This paper presents a novel approach to extract interface schema from deep Web based on domain ontology. Besides, it also proposes a new presentation of query interface attribute, which reflects the semantic relationships between the labels, on the basis of location, label semantic relationship and string similarity. Experimental results show that our system is feasible and efficient, and achieves high precision, recall and F-Measure value across a variety of databases.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Polynomial Nonlinear Systems via Semi-tensor Product Method
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Using the semi-tensor product method, this paper investigates how to represent the polynomial nonlinear system as the matrix and studies the stability of a class of the polynomial nonlinear systems. First, we represent polynomial nonlinear systems as the matrices via semi-tensor product method. Second, we construct and calculate Lyapunov function by using the semi-tensor product method. Third, we get a theorem of judging whether a class of polynomial nonlinear systems are asymptotically stable through semi-tensor product method. Finally, the study of an illustrative example shows that the new theorem of judging the stability of nonlinear systems in this paper is very effective.

articleTitle: A multi-purpose visual image processing system based on vision chip
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a multi-purpose image processing system. The major components of the system are a vision chip that is dedicated to visual image processing, and a field-programmable gate array (FPGA), which handles all the inputs and outputs (IO) of the system. Using an FPGA, the system supports various IO protocols, on-line and offline work modes. Furthermore, using a vision chip for image processing, the system can obtain high performance up to 208 Giga Operations Per Second (GOPS) and high energy efficiency up to 194 Giga Operations Per Second Per Watt (GOPS/W) for image processing.

articleTitle: An AIM-Based Identification for Time Delay of Sinusoidal Signals with Unknown Frequency
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a method based on adaptive internet model to identify the time delay, the frequency and the amplitude of sinusoidal signals received from two spatially separated sensors. Slow integral manifold, averaging method, Lyapunov stability theorem are used in sequence to analyze the exponential convergence property, the dynamic performance and the ultimate boundedness under bounded disturbance. The advantages of the proposed technique are revealed in the following aspects: the little effect of the actual value of the signal frequency on the ultimate convergence property and the little effect of the actual value of the signal amplitude on the convergence speed, the adjustable boundary values of the identification errors of amplitude, frequency and delay time by tuning the three design parameters. Simulation results verify the validity.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control for Nonlinear System with Parameter Jump Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at a class of nonlinear systems with parameter jump, a neural network-based multi-model adaptive control of nonlinear systems is proposed. An adaptive control model and a neural network-based control model are established respectively, and on this basis, a robust adaptive controller and a neural network-based nonlinear controller are designed, thereby constructing a neural network-based nonlinear system adaptive controller. The simulation results show that the proposed adaptive control strategy for nonlinear systems based on neural network has good control characteristics.

articleTitle: A Scheme of Job Collaborative Filtering on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Job recommendation on social media like WeChat, 58.com, Facebook or University campus network is increasing important to empower better user experience. It’s, however, a big challenge to handle hundreds of million users and job opportunities. A collaborative filtering schema is proposed to empower job recommendation on top of social media with massive data. The experiment results show the proposed recommender system could get better recommendation relevance by leveraging the degree of stickiness between friends.

articleTitle: Optimization design of Marine electric fire warning system
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of ship electrical fire, the occurrence process of electrical fire is divided into five stages: initial, precombustion, smoldering, extending and extinguish. In order to improve the early warning effect of ship electrical fire, a classified warning system of ship electrical fire is designed. In initial stage, the system can carry out fault early warning, on the basis of the circuit fault characteristics of leakage, arc and temperature rise, and then eliminate the fire hazard at the source. In the stage of precombustion and smoldering, infrared thermal imager and gas analyzer are used for active detection to improve the comprehensive detection and alarm ability of fire.

articleTitle: Trusted Computing Architecture for Secure Network Functions
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Currently, Network Function Virtualization (NFV) has become a basic technology to support the development of the 5G communication network. Meanwhile, the security protection technology of network function software has also become an important part of solving the 5G security problems. Therefore, we established a simulation network environment for network slicing by using open source software. Then, we designed a trusted computing architecture for security protection technology of network function in this simulation environment. Then, through experiments, we tested the static integrity security protection of network functions and proved that this architecture can resist the tampering attack. Finally, the performance test shows the usability of our trusted computing architecture.

articleTitle: A Study on Tuning Methods of Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control for a Class of Thermal Processes
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Active disturbance rejection controllers have been applied in a certain range in industrial processes. Aiming at the control difficulties of a class of large inertia and large delay thermal processes in thermal power plant, this paper studies two second-order linear ADRC parameter setting methods, and discusses their control effects and applicability. Based on the known process model, one method is to transform model into the form of $K/(Ts+1)^{n}$, and then based on the given maximum sensitivity function, the controller parameter tuning formula is obtained through the asymptote of the Nyquist curve; the other is to transform model into the form of $Ke^{-\tau s}/(Ts+1)$, and then the controller parameters are designed with this approximate model. Taking the superheated steam temperature system of a 330MW thermal power unit as the controlled object, the simulation study was performed by LADRC. The calculation of the control efficiency index and the integration index of ITAE and ISE is carried out from the three aspects, which are set-point tracking, robust performance and noise test. The control effect and scope of application of the two empirical setting formulas are analyzed and the valuable guidance is given.

articleTitle: Inertial navigation technology based on Kalman filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the popularity of smart mobile devices and the development of Internet of Things technology, indoor positioning technology has become increasingly important. This paper proposes an indoor inertial positioning system solution based on inertial sensor-based indoor positioning combined with Kalman filter algorithm. The inertial sensor is used to collect the acceleration and angular velocity of moving objects and processed by the Kalman filter algorithm to obtain object displacement Direction, and get the position information of the object according to the distance estimation algorithm. The test results show that the indoor inertial positioning system based on Kalman filtering can estimate the indoor positioning effect based on its own data, and has high positioning accuracy and good stability in a short time.

articleTitle: Prediction model of multi-step attack
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: There are many security monitoring devices running in the state gird. The security monitoring devices can detect the alerts. Correlations between these alerts are existed. A complete multi-step attack event can be divided into many stages, the serious attack events always occurs in the later stage in a complete attack. We can make better defense when facing attack if we predict the next possible attack event. This paper proposed a multi-step attack prediction model. The attack events in state gird are transformed into the original dataset, which can be considered as the input of prediction model. By using this model, state gird security personnel can use prediction model to take preventive measures from being attacked. Experiments show that the recall rate and accuracy rate of this prediction model have reached 84. 90% and 84. 91%

articleTitle: Trusted Virtual Network Function Based on vTPM
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Mobile communication technology is developing rapidly, and this is integrated with technologies such as Software Defined Network (SDN), cloud computing, and Network Function Virtualization (NFV). Network Functions (NFs) are no longer deployed on dedicated hardware devices, while deployed in Virtual Machines (VMs) or containers as Virtual Network Functions (VNFs). If VNFs are tampered with or replaced, the communication system will not function properly. Our research is to enhance the security of VNFs using trusted computing technology. By adding Virtual Trusted Platform Module (vTPM) to the virtualization platform, the chain of trust extends from the VM operating system to VNFs within the VM. Experimental results prove that the solution can effectively protect the integrity of VNFs from being attacked.

articleTitle: Eye movement analysis of cockpit interface of small aircraft under the airfield traffic pattern
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The eye movement analysis of the man-machine interface of small aircraft under the airfield traffic pattern was carried out to provide a basis for the optimization design of cockpit man-machine interface. The flight simulation experiment was designed, and the simulation platform was built. 16 subjects completed the airfield traffic pattern according to the cockpit interface information as required, and the eye-movement data of the subjects were recorded. From the fixation point, fixation time, fixation hot spot and other data: during the take-off stage, the subjects checked more attitude instrument and course indicator; In the flat flight phase, the attitude meter and the vertical speed indicator were mainly concerned. The attitude meter and airspeed meter were more important than other instruments in the descending stage. Eye movement indices can reflect the distribution regulation of attention in the process of flight, by the participants in the instrument of the attention it was concluded that: Placing pitch attitude information in the middle of the upper part of the interface and space velocity, vertical velocity and height information on the left and right sides can improve the quality of information acquisition and the task execution efficiency, avoid misoperation and cognitive errors.

articleTitle: optimization design of slide valve flow channel
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As the main control element of the hydraulic system, the hydraulic slide valve plays an important role in the hydraulic system. If the flow speed of the oil at the throttle of the hydraulic slide valve is too fast, the oil temperature will rise rapidly, and the vortex and noise will be produced, which will cause energy loss and have adverse effects on the system. According to the flow distribution of the hydraulic slide valve, the flow channel model of the slide valve before and after optimization is established, and the numerical simulation analysis of the slide valve channel is carried out by using FLUENT simulation software. By changing the shape of flow channel and valve spool, the flow field distribution in the slide valve is more uniform, and the flow velocity in the flow channel is reduced, which provides the basis for improving the performance of hydraulic valve.

articleTitle: Emergency Rescue Plan and Rescue Equipment Design For Potholes and Narrow Space
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the emergency rescue problem of people trapped in potholes and narrow space. According to the working environment of potholes and narrow spaces, an emergency rescue plan for potholes and narrow spaces is proposed and the mechanical structure of related equipment is designed. Firstly, the equipment enters the pothole or narrow space by hoisting, and approaches the comatose trapped by itself. Then, the equipment supports part of the human body through the squeeze-in vehicle body, and uses the robotic arm to help tie the wrist or ankle of the person. Finally, the rescue object is transported to the hole through the walking mechanism, then the equipment and the rescue object are lifted out together with the lifting equipment. This study can provide a reference for the design of rescue equipment in narrow space.

articleTitle: Stock forecasting method based on ensemble learning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the stock market, the field related to stock prediction has attracted more and more researchers’ attention. Stock forecasting can promote the development of stock market well, which is of great significance to the society, enterprises and individual investors. Through experiments, we found that the performance of Support Vector Regression model (SVR) is unstable owing to the influence of the distribution characteristics of training data, which is specifically reflected by the large deviation in the stock price forecast of some stocks. To solve this problem, this paper improves the SVR model based on ensemble learning. In the proposed the SVR model, we integrated two simple and effective models, linear regression model (LR) and K-nearest neighbor model (KNN), to enhance the generalization ability of the SVR model. The experiment shows that the proposed SVR model has significant improvement in the accuracy of stock price prediction compared with the tradition SVR model.

articleTitle: A study on the Impact of the Array Pitch on the Angle of Arrival Estimation through an Interferometric Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The paper analyzes the influence of the pitch of the antenna elements of an array on the Angle of Arrival (AoA) estimation accuracy when employing an interferometric approach [1]. The obtained results validate the technique that seems to be very promising to be employed in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) where it is necessary to reduce power consumption associated to the RF section. In particular, the correlation between the variation of the array pitch and estimation quality degradation will be discussed from a theoretical point of view. A set of experiments will then empirically justify the theoretical results.

articleTitle: New Queue Management Scheme to Improve PiggyCode with Delayed-ACK Option
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: TCP communications on wireless multi-hop net-works are bi-directional communications using DATA packets and ACK packets. These properties increase the hidden node problem and the intra-flow interference. PiggyCode, which is an existing scheme focused on bi-directionality of DATA packets and ACK packets, reduces the number of transmissions by applying Network Coding to the DATA packets and ACK packets when relaying these packets. Although some studies have considered the improvement of PiggyCode by insertion of the wait time, they did not take the Delayed-ACK option into account. In this paper, we propose a novel queue management scheme to consider the Delayed-ACK option. Furthermore, we confirm the efficiency of the proposed method via experimental evaluations.

articleTitle: Power angle stability optimization control method based on virtual synchronous generator
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper mainly compares the transient power angle characteristics of synchronous generator(SG) and virtual synchronous generator(VSG). Based on the equal area criterion, the VSG can reduce the acceleration area in the power angle characteristics, increase the deceleration area, and improve the transient stability of VSG. Based on the stability analysis method of equal area criterion and the flexible and adjustable control parameters of VSG, an adaptive inertia parameter control method is discussed to improve the transient stability of VSG system. The advantages and disadvantages of different parameter selection schemes are compared. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is analyzed based on MATLAB/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Software Phase-Locked Loop Based on DSP under Voltage Asymmetry
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Accurate phase information is very important for stable operation of power converter, such as PWM rectifier. The software phase-locked loop (SPLL) has the advantages of free design and strong adaptability, which can quickly obtain the phase of the grid voltage. In this paper, the situation of voltage asymmetry in three-phase electric network is considered, the principle of SPLL is analyzed, the linearized model of SPLL is obtained, the SPLL controller is designed, and the design of SPLL based on digital signal processor (DSP) is realized. Simulation and experimental results show that the designed SPLL can work well in a PWM rectifier, it has reference significance for the design of SPLL in other electric energy conversion devices.

articleTitle: Tracking Control for Supercavitating Vehicles with unknown Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposed a backstepping control approach based on the adaptive Radial Basis Function(RBF) Neural Networks(NNs) for the trajectory tracking problem of supercavitating vehicles. A dynamic model with uncertainties of supercavitating vehicle is built. A backstepping control scheme is then proposed to address the tracking control problem, and the adaptive RBF NNs are to approximate the uncertainties in the nominal model. The network weights are adapted by using the Lyapunov-based design. The superior control performance of the proposed controllers are illustrated by simulations.

articleTitle: Parametrization of Stabilizing Controllers of Block Component Plants
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: We investigate the parametrization of stabilizing controllers of plants that consist of several block components of which parameterizations of stabilizing controllers are already known. This does not assume the coprime factorizability of plants and their components. In this paper, we restrict our attention to two block components. First we give the parametrization with the case of different block components as general case. Then, we give it with same block components.

articleTitle: A Kind of Kinematics Modeling of 2 DOFs Notched Continuum Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It’s difficult for traditional rigid manipulators to complete relevant operations in the single port laparoscopic. The notched continuum manipulator owns the features of flexibility and biocompatibility which can make it possible applied in the single port laparoscopic. A kinematics modeling similar to the constant-curvature approximations is proposed in this paper. It can be utilized to describe the mapping relationship between the length change value of two driven wires and the end position. This method simplifies the complexity of kinematic modeling. And it makes the control method of the continuum manipulator easier to achieve as well. The accuracy of the model has been verified by the prototype.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Multi-Bernoulli target tracking algorithm based on measurement fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-sensor measurement fusion multi-Bernoulli filter to solve the problem of multi-target tracking. A greedy measurement fusion partitioning mechanism based on the multi-Bernoulli filter (MeMBer) is proposed. First, simultaneous selection and fusion of the measurement of different sensors are carried out. Then, the selection of the subsets and the operation of the partition are carried out through the greedy algorithm. In the updating stage of multi-Bernoulli filter, the multi-Bernoulli posterior is updated by using the measurement set after quasi-partitions on the basis of MeMBer filter. Simulation results show that the proposed filtering algorithm can estimate the number and state of multiple targets stably and effectively, and the OSPA error of tracking results is smaller and the cardinality estimation is more accurate than multi-sensor greedy multi-Bernoulli filter.

articleTitle: Action Recognition Based on Hierarchical Graph Recurrent Networks with 2D Skeleton
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Graph convolutional neural networks are recently studied for action recognition. We develop a hierarchical graph recurrent networks for action recognition based on 2D skeleton. Hierarchical graph structure is designed for human pose features extraction and representation of movement including spatial-temporal information. Action labels are online updated by frame graph composed of key frames, which are dynamical weighted by consecutive frames with soft self-attention. Human skeleton graph emphasizes keypoints features learning with position and orientation between adjacent joints. The qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that hierarchical graph recurrent networks (HGRNs) effectively increase accuracy and robustness of action recognition and predict.

articleTitle: Parameters Tuning and Optimization of Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control Subject to Actuator Rate Limit
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The traditional empirical tuning method of Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (LADRC) parameters is obtained without considering the actuator rate limit. Once the actuator rate is limited, then the input and output signals of the actuator cannot be synchronized. Considering that there is no efficient strategy for tuning LADRC parameters when the actuator rate is limited. And the parameters tuning method of LADRC is complex and difficult. Taking the traditional LADRC parameter tuning value as the benchmark and combining with the Pigeon Inspired Optimization (PIO) algorithm, a LADRC parameter tuning method is proposed by constructing the quadratic objective function and changing the weight factor of the control increment. The simulation results show that the LADRC parameters optimization method based on PIO can keep the input and output signals of the actuator synchronized.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Security Monitoring and Management Platform Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Through the integration of communication technology, information technology and wearable equipment, precise positioning equipment, physical sign monitoring equipment, video monitoring equipment, and safety monitoring equipment, a safety monitoring management platform based on the Internet of Things technology is designed. The platform adopts a three-tier logical architecture, A smart security monitoring and management platform with data collection, processing, and analysis functions is built, which solves the problem of incompatibility of various subsystems. The prevention functions of real-time monitoring, data mining, and security linkage make it possible to achieve the expected goal of no blind spots in the prevention area and no loopholes in the prevention methods. The results of its application in an elderly care institution show that the platform can issue safety warnings in a timely manner, effectively reducing the incidence of accidents, and significantly improving the management efficiency of elderly care institutions and the quality of life of the elderly.

articleTitle: Research on “Attack Graph” Development Trend
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of cloud computing, big data and other technologies, cyber space security has become increasingly prominent. Attack graphs are a powerful tool for security risk assessment by analyzing network vulnerabilities and the paths attackers can use to compromise network resources. Attack graphs and model analysis have done a lot of research, and made a large number of achievements. In this paper we chose the advanced search in the “WoS core dataset (E-SCI)”, with a retrieval type of TS = attack graph, finally 2936 papers in the fields are retrieved. Based on the 2936 literature, we carry out time series, co-citation analysis and keywords co-occurrence analysis. The result shows the current hot spot and development trend, and predicts the future research direction in the attack graph field.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic Characteristics of an Airborne Vertical Gradient Magnetic Measuring Probe on the Wing Tip of a High Aspect Ratio UAV with Low Speed
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For a high aspect ratio UAV in low speed, the flows around the probe fairing itself and the airborne vertical gradient magnetic measuring probes on the wing tip were numerically simulated, respectively. The calculation obtained the aerodynamic characteristics influences of the wing-tip vertical gradient magnetic measuring probes installed on the full vehicle. Results showed that the probe fairing itself can not cause flow separation. The lift coefficient, drag coefficient and lateral force coefficient changed little. Obvious flow separation occurred on the fairing near the vertical gradient magnetic measuring probes, and the drag coefficient of the whole aircraft is increased. While the part outside vertical gradient magnetic measuring probes was not obvious, and the increment is mainly the pressure difference drag. The lift and pitching moments were less affected, then the lift-to-drag ratio become small. The full vehicle control and stability is scarcely influenced, and the requirements for safe flight of low-speed and high-aspect-ratio UAVs could be basically met.

articleTitle: Classification Of Malicious Code Based On Grayscale Texture Fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Traditional malicious code classification technology faces a challenge to do with increasingly deformed malicious code, whose problems include having low detection rate and being time-consuming. In order to solve the above-mentioned problems, the traditional malicious code classification technology combines feature extraction of texture fingerprints on the image with the deep learning neural network classification method and proposes a malicious code classification method based on gray texture features. This method first converts the binary file of the malicious code into a grayscale image. It uses the grayscale co-occurrence matrix to extract the features in the malicious code, and the extracted features are in turn substituted into an improved neural network model. Classification training is then performed to reduce the probability of feature loss in the pooling layer. The experimental results indicate that the malicious code classification based on the above method have higher accuracy. Through the use of features extracted by the gray level co-occurrence matrix as output of the pooling layer, the learning time can also be effectively shortened hence making this method best for classification detection usage.

articleTitle: Component modeling for different application scenarios in the virtual commissioning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Virtual commissioning is a upcoming trend in smart manufacturing. Even if it is state of the art the levels of behavior details of the pant components which are necessary to meet the requirement of control program testing is still a matter of discussion. This paper introduces a scalable modeling approach with three different modeling forms (black box, grey box and white box models) for different application scenarios. It provides a modelling example to show the different characteristics and discuss which modeling approach suits best for virtual commissioning and the control program test.

articleTitle: The effect of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness prescription on the level of sex hormone in the model mice of “ Fear of kidney damage ”
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Purpose:to investigate the effect of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness prescription on SOD and MDA levels in mice with“fear of kidney injury”model.Method:The model of fear of hurting kidney was adopted(that is the fear of the kidney damage),to adapt the kunming species of female mice in laboratory after 1 week,digital table method were randomly divided into 3 groups,the party group of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness(dosed with 10g/kg.d suspension of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness prescription)10;The normal control group and the model control group(0.2ml /10g distilled water each day)were given 10 tablets each.Except for the normal control group,the other two groups were frightened by male cats.The serum SOD and MDA levels of the three groups were detected at 21d.Results: Compared with the model group,the serum SOD level of the reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness prescription group was higher than that of the model control group,and the MDA level was lower than that of the model group,with statistical significance (P<0.05, P<0.01).SOD in the model group was lower than that in the normal control group,with statistical significance (P<0.05).MDA in the model group was significantly higher than that in the normal control group and the anti-deafness prescription group (P<0.05).

Author Keywords: the prescription of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness

articleTitle: Exploration into the Interactive Design of Online Education Platform based on the Continuous Usage Behavior
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Free from the limitations of time and space, online education achieves a rapid development in spite of the attack by COVID-19 in 2020. How to improve the user experience through optimizing the product’s interactive design plays a significant role in enhancing the product quality. Based on UTAUT Model in combination with Flow Theory, this research examines the impact factor model and research hypotheses according to relevant questionnaire data from the perspective of interactive design. Corresponding results show that, Performance Expectancy and Flow Experience exert an obvious impact on users’ continuous usage behavior while Content Quality, Interactive Experience and Visual Design impose an indirect impact. In the conclusion part, corresponding interactive design suggestions are proposed in reference to such research results in this paper.

articleTitle: LSTM Prediction Algorithm of Bus Tandem under multi-source Data
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to effectively avoid the problem of bus tandem, the factors of bus tandem and the bus tandem prediction model are studied under multi-source bus data. Firstly, the static and dynamic data of bus operation are analyzed based on bus big data, and the bus tandem factors are analyzed based on decision tree pruning algorithm to obtain the most simplified sample attributes to form a training set and a test set. The different combinations of sample attributes constitute a variety of input data schemes, and the timing sequence of different interval stations is predicted by the long-short-time memory (LSTM) algorithm, and then the optimal estimation of different prediction results is completed by particle filtering. Dynamic pruning of the input attributes of the LSTM algorithm in combination with the decision tree algorithm improves the learning rate of the LSTM algorithm. The particle filtering estimation is a dynamic optimization process for the structural parameters of the LSTM network, which reduces the error of the prediction results. Testing of 300 randomly selected groups of experimental data shows that the LSTM prediction algorithm learns the predicted value within 15% deviation from the actual deviation of 93% of the samples, and the experimental results are good, reflecting the good generalization ability of the algorithm under consideration of multi-source traffic data.

articleTitle: Application of Active Emergency Repair Method Based on Comprehensive Intelligent Research and Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Distribution network emergency repair is the most important daily work of the electric power company’s dispatch management. It has high requirements on timeliness and accuracy. At present, distribution network emergency repairs mainly rely on customer repairs. And the fault information from a certain single system makes the research and judgment logic limited. This traditional passive repair mode initiated by customer repairs no longer meet the requirements of modern distribution network repairs, so Effective fault analysis and identification strategies play an important role in improving the efficiency of emergency repair. This paper proposes an active repair method based on comprehensive intelligent research and identification. And a technical support system based on microservices architecture technology that is more flexible and lower in coupling than a single architecture is established. This system based on containerized deployment is widely used in the emergency repair business of Shanxi Power Supply Service System, and good application results are achieved.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Solution Treatment Amorphous Oxide Semiconductor Switching Devices for Display Backplanes
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Electronic display screens have become an indispensable product in people’s daily lives with the development of technology. The backplane technology determines the performance of the display screens. Amorphous oxide semiconductor (AOS) is one of the materials of the backplane switching device. It is widely used in the production and development of this field due to its ascendant electronic characteristics, simple and reliable manufacturing process and low production cost. The advantages of electronic performance can be learned from many of the device’s measurement figures and data. It has detailed analysis of different measurement contents. In this paper, two different AOS materials having the same substrate and structure were treated by solution and one of the materials was subjected to molecular beam epitaxy treatment of plasma. They are multi stacked structure indium zinc oxide (IZO) thin film transistor (TFT), indium oxide TFT with passivation and IZO TFT injected into the plasma. Although the active channel layers are different, they all have predominant mobility, on-off current ratio, threshold voltage and subthreshold swing. Mobility can reach up to 8. On-off current ratio can be maintained above 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>. Other measurements such as stability and inverter drive also show that the device has decent performance. Changes in electronic properties can be observed in more detail. This indicates solution treatment AOS material as switching devices active channel layer is very suitable for the preparation of switching devices.

articleTitle: Parameter Filtering Method with Circular Update for Deep Neural Network Parallel Training
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a parameter filtering circular update algorithm, which provides an efficient solution for parallel training of deep neural networks as the scale of deep neural networks continues to expand. The parameter filtering circular update algorithm filters a large number of redundant unimportant parameters in the deep neural network training process by setting the importance threshold, and in an iteration process, the parameters of each node are synchronized through the circular update algorithm. The parameter filtering circular update algorithm compresses the training parameters of the DNN, and greatly reduces the overhead caused by the communication between each node and the parameter server in the synchronous parallel training. Experiments show that the parameter filtering circular update algorithm can improve the parallel training speed of the DNNs without losing the prediction accuracy, and the GPU utilization rate on each computing node is higher than that of the general synchronous training method.

articleTitle: Spectral Efficiency Optimization for Full-Duplex Distributed Antenna Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper investigates the spectral efficiency maximization in full-duplex distributed antenna system (DAS), where full-duplex capable remote access units (RAUs) communicate with half-duplex users. We jointly optimize uplink and downlink transmit power, subject to power constraints and the quality of service (QoS) requirements of both uplink and downlink users. User-centric virtual cell is adopted, and each user can only be served by its virtual cell to reduce the computational complexity. The formulated problem is a non-convex problem. To solve it, we convert objective function and constraint to the difference of convex (D.C.) functions, then an iterative algorithm is proposed by using successive convex approximation. The numerical results demonstrate that compared with other reference algorithms, the proposed algorithm can achieve greater spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Matching Method of Navigation Capacity Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the distributed combination optimization problem of navigation capacity resources and production task areas, a navigation capacity matching method based on improved genetic algorithm is proposed. To minimize the amount of transportation resources needed to carry out production tasks, a multi constraint model for the allocation of navigation capacity resources is established. The initial population, crossover operator and mutation operator of genetic algorithm are improved according to the operation characteristics of navigable power generation, and the simulation verification is carried out based on the actual operation data of a large domestic navigation power company. The results show that this method can save 40.7% of the capacity resources compared with the traditional manual scheduling, and the matching results can provide decision-making basis for actual operation control and scheduling.

articleTitle: Objective Ridge Regression System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the actual system, it is very important to get enough training samples for the performance of the model. However, no matter how rich the collection is, there will be a problem: limited training sets cannot really explain the label of these. So we propose an Objective Ridge Regression System (ORRS) to solve this problem in the classification stage. First of all, according to different categories, training samples are regressing to the different objectives we defined by, to obtain a transform matrix. Secondly, all of the test samples are projected into the low dimensional space by this transform matrix. Thirdly, we developed a Diversity Factors Rule (DFR) to divide test samples into multiple batches. Finally, the Minimum Distance Classifier algorithm is used to classify each batch of test samples, and the class-centers are updated synchronously. Circulate the previous steps until all batch samples are classified. Experimental results on the Iris, Wine, ORL and AR databases show that our method outperforms some other algorithms.

articleTitle: Improvement of Face Recognition Algorithm Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the in-depth development of Internet informatization, related technologies in the field of artificial intelligence have attracted wide attention from scholars. Face recognition, as a branch of artificial intelligence informatization, can be learned by convolution neural network, and possesses advantage of quick realization. But there are still some shortcomings in accuracy and training efficiency. The research in this paper is based on the network structure of Bisymmetric LeNet parallel connection, using the improved Softmax regression classification, and using DCT-LBP joint processing method to study the fusion ratio of global features and local features of input images. The improved algorithm enhances the generalization ability, makes up for the problems of low efficiency and accuracy, and has the best recognition effect.

articleTitle: Management Method of Intentional Violation of the Rules Based on Behavioral Economics
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: According safety management, the decision scheme of people could be divided into 3 kinds, i.e. compliance, minor violation and serious violation. The decision tree model was put forward that decision-making processing of violation behavior. From the consequence utility value and state probability view, the countermeasures of rational decision-maker for avoid violation were summarized by using utility theory. On this basis, combined with the behavioral economics concept point, such as reference dependent, subjective probability, loss-aversion and mental accounting, the decision model was modified and the countermeasures were perfected.

articleTitle: Research on the application of blockchain in supply chain information sharing
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: There are some problems in traditional supply chain, such as information asymmetry and weak traceability. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a supply chain information sharing system based on block chain technology, combining with the characteristics of block chain technology. Firstly, the framework of information sharing system based on information chain and supply chain participants was constructed. Secondly, the interaction rules of information sharing process were designed to meet the actual demand of supply chain information interaction. At the same time, based on the role-based access control model, the system authority management mechanism was established to standardize the interaction between supply chain enterprises. Then, the information intelligent contract was deployed based on the above rules, and the supply chain information sharing system was established. Finally, the scheme was compared and analyzed through experiments. The results show that the scheme has certain advantages in the overall system function, fault tolerance and throughput, and can realize the efficient and secure sharing of supply chain information.

articleTitle: Research on a Multi-Echelon Inventory Control Method for Logistics System in Aviation Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of aviation enterprises, the logistics system urgently needs to be improved through digitalization and intelligence. Most of the researches for logistics system focus on the buffer area or the second-level logistics system, which are insufficient to meet the multi-echelon inventory requirements in aviation enterprises. This paper presents a new method through the multi-echelon network model to solve the problems of inaccurate inventory and waste of resources in the logistics system. First, the optimization function is established considering the maximum inventory capacity, the safety stock and the replenishment lead time. Second, the genetic algorithm is used to minimize the cost and maximize the service level. At last, the feasibility of the proposed method is demonstrated through the numerical studies.

articleTitle: A source load value matching method based on matching degree in different spatial and temporal scales
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of new energy, such as wind energy, the scale of wind power installation is gradually increasing. It causes some areas rich in wind resources cannot fully utilize and consume wind power, and then the wind abandonment problem is particularly prominent. At the same time, because of the incomplete basic operation data collection and the complex operation characteristics under different time scales, the matching degree of new energy and multi-load, composed of controllable load and energy storage, is not high at different time scales of power and electricity. In order to solve the problems above, this paper proposes a source-load value matching method for many uncertain factors (such as weather, wind speed, etc.), which is to match the source and load value by calculating the matching degree. The method can be used to improve the nearby wind power accommodation capacity of new energy, so as to improve the utilization rate of new energy. So the measure in this paper is the matching degree. The greater the matching degree is, the better the capacity of wind power accommodation is. In this paper, six schemes are designed and experiments are carried out to verify the reliability and practicability of the method. The scheme with largest matching degree is the best regional scheme of wind power accommodation.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Wheel/rail Squeal Noise and Sensitivity Analysis of Relevant Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Squeal noise is normally attributed to the self-excited vibration of the wheel induced by the lateral creepage when the wheel slides laterally on the top of rail. Due to its unique tone characteristics and high sound pressure level, the human ear is very sensitive to it. With the improvement of living standards, people's tolerance for squeal noise is getting lower and lower. In order to mitigate and control squeal noise, it is necessary to analyze the sensitivity of relevant parameters. In this paper, a prediction model is developed to analyze the effect of various parameters on the sound pressure level of squeal noise. The results show that squeal noise can be significantly reduced by decreasing angle of attack and rolling speed. In addition, the sound pressure of squeal noise can be reduced by reasonably controlling the negative slope of creepage. Furthermore, this mathematical model is used to perform a sensitivity analysis. The results show that squeal noise is most sensitive to the parameter of angle of attack, and the reason for this is illustrated. In particular, the analysis shows that modifying the slope of the creepage curve is effective in mitigating squeal noise, which provides a reference for mitigating and controlling squeal noise in practice, such as the application of friction modifiers at wheel/rail interface.

articleTitle: Fast Frequency Estimation Method With Unbiased Term Design Based On FIR Adaptive Notch Filter
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that adaptive notch filter (ANF) based frequency estimation method is complex, biased and unstable under noise condition, a new ANF based unbiased frequency estimation method is proposed. Firstly, based on the analysis of error function performance for FIR ANF with simple structure, the iterative recursive formula for frequency estimation is acquired; Secondly, the bias analysis of the iterative recurrence formula for frequency estimation is carried out to confirm the deviation compensation item, which should be useful for obtaining unbiased frequency estimation results. Finally, the proposed method is calculated and analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed new FIR-ANF frequency estimation method focus on convergence speed, anti-noise performance and unbiasedness.

articleTitle: Short Video Representation Learning Based on Convolution Network with Text Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Learning video representation with convolution network methods has been proven useful to learn video representation across many video understanding tasks, including video classification, action recognition and object detection. However, traditional convolution methods fail to take the text feature of the video into consideration, which may contain large amount of useful information for final video representation. Besides, current short video often contains a lot of human language from the start to the end. In this paper, we propose a novel neural network system that learns video representation by aggregating information from both video features and text features of the video. This network, named Conv-Text Net, can effectively learn video representation with its text information by a text attention mechanism. Results show that Conv-Text Net achieves competitive performance in video classification task on Short-Video datasets. We provide analysis towards the behavior of our model and show its robustness to errors in proposals. Experiment shows that our method performs well on video classification task and achieves good score on Short Video data set.

articleTitle: Joint MCS Selection, Number of Stream and Stream Power Allocation for MIMO System in 5G
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC) is a key technology to achieve high throughput in wireless communication. However, it only considers adaptive modulation and coding scheme (MCS) and ignores other factors which can also influence throughput. This paper focuses on the joint MCS selection, number of stream and stream power allocation for 5G system, with the target of maximizing average successful transmitted bits of the transport block. Two algorithms are proposed to solve it, which are Interior Point-Dichotomy (IPD) iterative algorithm and Power-based Deep Reinforcement Learning (PDRL) algorithm. The simulation results demonstrate the superiority of the two algorithms we propose. Specifically, IPD and PDRL algorithm respectively offer 0.04dB and 0.18dB gains with respect to adaptive MCS and number of stream (AMNS) on average power scheme.

Author Keywords: average successful transmitted bits of the transport block

articleTitle: Comparison of Disturbance Rejection Performance between Three Types of UAV Linear Controllers
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Anti-interference performance enhancement of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has attracted great interest for laboratory research and civilian applications due to the increasingly worse operating environment of these devices. This article compares the disturbance rejection capability between three types of optimal linear control: Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) control, H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> control and $\mathrm{H}_{\infty}$ control. The article first presents the basic concepts and algorithm steps of these three controllers. Furthermore, the nonlinear model of the unmanned helicopter system is introduced, and then it is linearized near the operating point by using Jacobian linearization method. The disturbance rejection performance of LQG, H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and $\mathrm{H}_{\infty}$ controllers is measured and compared with regard to the stability of the inner loop of the system. It is shown that the performance of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and $\mathrm{H}_{\infty}$ controllers is better than that of LQG controller.

articleTitle: Mechanical Performance Analysis and Experimental Study of Flat Spiral Spring
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The contradiction between energy consumption and pollution has become increasingly prominent, and it is urgent to collect and store energy. The flat spiral spring is a widely used elastic element, which can realize energy storage and release. In this paper, the theoretical analysis and experimental verification of the torsional stiffness characteristics of the flat spiral spring were carried out, and the mechanical model was established to obtain the torsional stiffness of the spring. The spring was treated as a flexible body by ADAMS, and its dynamic simulation analysis was carried out, and the stiffness characteristic of the spring was obtained. After the springs made of 60Si2Mn and 304 stainless steel were tested. The result shows that the torsional stiffness curves of the simulation and experiment have the linear characteristics in a certain range.

articleTitle: A DOA estimation method for area array based on dimensionality reduction processing
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of traditional beamforming algorithms that require a two-dimensional angle search for two-dimensional DOA estimation using rectangular arrays, which takes a long time, this paper provides a dimensionality reduction method through theoretical derivation and numerical calculation. This method uses coordinate conversion and secondary optimization, successively calculates the angle of the target relative to the X and Y axes, and combines the idea of least squares to finally calculate the azimuth and elevation angle of the target, turning the two-dimensional problem into a one-dimensional search, which greatly reduces the amount of calculation. The simulation results show that the angle estimation accuracy of this method is equivalent to that of the traditional MUSIC method, but its algorithm complexity and calculation time are reduced a lot, which is very suitable for engineering applications.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of ADT and DSM in Architecture Design
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Architecture design is an extremely important part of complex system design, and it is of far-reaching significance to carry out research on architecture design. Starting from the needs of users, this paper combines the “Z”-shaped mapping structure and hierarchical decomposition mode of the axiom design theory, as well as the design structure matrix method to implement system module division, and specifically analyzes the system architecture design concept generation process.

articleTitle: Optimized Space-station CV Method and Its Differences from GNSS CV
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: There will be better atomic clock system and micro-wave time comparison link in the space station, like Chinese Space Station and European ACES(Atomic Clock Ensemble in Space) project, than those in the GNSS(Global GNSS satellite System) satellites. Therefore, space station CV(Common View) will realize more accurate time comparison than GNSS CV in theory. But due to the orbit characteristic of the space station, there are some limitations if traditional GNSS CV method is applied to the space station. In order to solve these problems, the GNSS CV method is optimized and the method that is appropriate for the space station is proposed. First, the differences between GNSS and space station CV are studied, and the influences of orbit error on these two CV methods are analyzed in detail. Then traditional CV method is optimized to be fit for the space station. Finally, the performance of the optimized method is validated by simulated experiments. The simulation results show that the space station time comparison accuracy of several tens of picoseconds can be obtained by the optimized method. Furthermore, the problem of CV blind area is solved by the optimized method effectively.

articleTitle: Extrinsic Calibration between Camera and LiDAR Sensors by Virtual Planar Junctions Matching
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: We propose an accurate calibration method for extrinsic parameters of LiDAR and camera by virtual planar junctions matching. It is difficult to find reliable feature correspondences between the LiDAR and the camera due to the sparsity and centimeter-level measurement errors of LiDAR point clouds. In our approach, a large size board with sparse corner markers is used as a calibration board to estimate the extrinsic parameters between a stereo pair and a multi-scanline LiDAR. In data acquisition stage, the board is placed in different positions around the LiDAR-cameras and virtual junctions are computed by each set of three planes for the calibration process. Based on matching virtual planar junctions between camera and LiDAR coordinate system, an ICP algorithm is used to solve the extrinsic parameters iteratively. Our experiments demonstrate that our method can get the rotation error is less than 0.15 degrees, and the translation error is less than 1.5mm.

articleTitle: Design of CEC Bus Controller Based On HDMI Interface
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In view of the need to use multiple remote controls to operate separately when watching HDTV, in order to reduce the unnecessary operation of users in the process of viewing the film, HDMI-CEC is generated, which just meets the needs of users. At present, all HD(High-Definition Multimedia Interface) devices produced by manufacturers have CEC(consumer electronic control)function. CEC function brings a lot of convenience to users. It allows end users to control multiple HD devices with CEC by using one remote controller, thus reducing the number of remote controls. This design is a controller based on HDMI version. The Hardware Description Language Verilog is used to realize the design of CEC bus controller IP core. VCS simulation tool is used to verify the design. The experimental results show that the design meets the requirements of hdmi-cec bus controller design. This article mainly talks about HDMI-CEC protocol, design architecture, micro architecture, and software hardware coordination design method.

articleTitle: Influence of random disturbance on hit accuracy of Rocket Launcher
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The effect of random disturbance on the accuracy of rocket launchers has been studied in this paper. The random disturbance model of the rocket launcher is developed based on the rigid body kinematics theory. The trajectory equation of the projectile is given, and a quantitative perturbation algorithm for the launcher and the directional tube is proposed, which provides a theoretical basis for the calculation of the hit rate. Then the MEMS sensor error is processed by quaternion, Kalman filtering and wavelet threshold denoising methods to improve the precision of hit accuracy calculation.

articleTitle: Indoor Dynamic Human Detection Based on Channel State Information
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of communication network, wireless network has played an increasingly important role. The use of wireless access points and wireless signals for human detection has become a popular research field. This paper proposes Wi-Mov approach to detect human motion with different moving speeds and postures by obtaining fine-grained channel state information. Phase calibrating is performed on the collected data to obtain the calibrated phase in the subcarriers. According to the Doppler frequency shift effect, the change in frequency caused by the movement of the human body relative to the receiver is calculated. The fast Fourier transform is leveraged to transform the micro frequency and extract the features. The Gaussian mixture model is utilized to classify the feature sets and the detection result is finally obtained. The combination of the above data processing and algorithm makes Wi-Mov have a high detection accuracy in indoor dynamic human motion detection. When the indoor human body moves at different speeds and the indoor human body moves at the same speed but with different arm movements, Wi-Mov still maintains a high detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Innovative Thinkings of University Labor Union in the Age of Educational Information
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: University labor union is a mass organization of teaching staff, and it plays a very important role in safeguarding the rights and interests of teachers, promoting university construction, participating in university management, and carrying out the education of teaching staff. This article first analyzes the changes of university labor union work mode in the age of education informatization, and then proposes innovative ideas, including improving the information literacy of teachers, mobile information services, data sharing, etc., so as to build a new pattern of university labor union.

articleTitle: Risk assessment technology of ship power system based on improved time series algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Because of the sequential Monte Carlo simulation method can better reflect the change of state variables related to time, and its sampling process will proceed over time, it can reflect the corresponding information of state variables in time series, which is suitable for online reliability assessment technology. However, when the system parameters fluctuate frequently and the base number of state variables is very large, most of the time of sequential Monte Carlo operation will be spent on extracting and evaluating the safe state, which greatly reduces the timeliness and efficiency of operation. From the point of view of state acquisition and processing, the sequential Monte Carlo method is optimized by discretization and standardization, which can not only improve the efficiency of the algorithm, but also increase the accuracy of the algorithm, thus providing the possibility to solve the real-time problem of power system reliability evaluation. To this end, in the IEEE-RTS79 system, the proposed algorithm is compared with the general sequential Monte Carlo simulation method. The analysis results show that the optimized algorithm can increase the accuracy of the results and the calculation efficiency of the system by about 30 times, which shows the feasibility and efficiency of the improved method.

articleTitle: Design and Verification for Autonomous Operation of Cameras Carried by the Micro-Satellite
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Because of such advantages as light weight, small sizes, short launch cycle, the micro-satellite technology has been extensively used in military and civilian fields.
