To further improve the autonomous operation of a micro-satellite, and reduce intervention and control of the earth station, the author has controlled the autonomous operation of the cameras carried by the micro-satellite based on previously developed satellite service software. Also, the author has built a semi-physical simulation system for functional verification. The experiment result shows that this design is rational and reliable, which efficiently improves the autonomous operation ability of the micro-satellite.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Data Processing Algorithm for RF Ion Source
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the development and testing of long-pulse RF ion source, a large number of pulse-type experimental data will be produced. Based on the basically complete data acquisition system and long-pulse radio frequency ion source intelligent analysis and automatic storage system, according to the existing engineering experience and requirements,this paper designs and analyzes the core data processing module of long-pulse radio frequency ion source intelligent analysis and automatic storage system, so as to achieve the goal of enhancing the intelligent level of the software and enhancing the accurate acquisition of valid values. This paper describes in detail the variance window algorithm which is based on the data characteristics and is applied to the data processing module that has been tested on the RF ion source test platform. Finally, the reliability of data processing is examined and the overall performance of the algorithm is evaluated.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of A Current Signal Isolator Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the field of industrial measurement and control, analog signals, such as pressure, temperature, valve opening, and flow, are widely transmitted in the form of current signals. Analog signals often need to participate in a variety of control or display process loops after being converted into current signals. To ensure the stable and reliable operation of the industrial process control system, the input current signal needs to be converted and output by an isolator. However, the isolator has conversion error and the conversion errors of different channels of the isolator are generally different, so the current values of different output channels of the isolator are generally inconsistent. With the long-term operation of the industrial process control system, this numerical difference may increase gradually be unbearable. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a design scheme of the current isolator based on FPGA. In this design scheme, FPGA collects the current value of each output channel, runs the automation correction algorithm, adjusts the value of the output current dynamically, and finally makes the current value of each output channel remain consistent. The hardware implement and test of the current isolator are carried out and the test results show that this isolator implementation scheme is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Factors Influencing Comments on the Online Cultural Heritage Exhibition under the COVID-19 Epidemic Situation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As people are restricted from travelling due to the attack of COVID-19, various museums are launching their online cultural heritage exhibitions in succession in order to break through the time and space limitations. However, since the design and marketing of online cultural heritage exhibitions vary, user’s comments on such exhibitions are mixed. In this paper, a research is conducted on various factors influencing online cultural heritage exhibitions for the purpose of improving users’ comments on the online cultural heritage exhibition. As a result, nine major impact factors are analyzed from three aspects (Organizer, Cultural Heritage and Users) by means of literature reading, investigation and brainstorming. Meanwhile, DEMATEL is also applied to analyze each factor. According to the questionnaire data, the centrality and causation of each factor is concluded, on which basis, the cause-and-effect diagram is set up to reveal the causal relationship of various impact factors. Eventually, it shall be noted that, the artistic value of cultural heritage and the brand building are key factors influencing comments on the online cultural heritage exhibition. Therefore, users’ comments on the online cultural heritage exhibition will be largely improved through enhancing the artistic value of cultural heritages exhibited, determining the brand positioning, designing the brand logo and formulating effective brand communication strategies.

articleTitle: Sparse Representation of Rational Transfer Function by l1 minimization
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new method for sparse representations of rational transfer functions in H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>(D) space by using Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares (IRLS) and shifted Cauchy kernels. IRLS is an l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> minimization algorithm. This problem originates from identification of transfer functions of FIR models. We also give three examples to illustrate the idea.

articleTitle: Identification Model of Chinese Students Negative Emotion Based on CNN and BIGRU
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Colleges should pay more attention to students difficulties and help them to solve the problems or carry out necessary psychological counseling. It is a good method to monitor the change of students emotion through network comment and identity the negative emotion, but at present, it is mostly realized by artificial means. An identification model of Chinese students negative emotion based on the convolutional neural network (CNN) and bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU) in the deep learning model is proposed. Comparative experiments have shown that the model has higher accuracy and lower resource consumption. The model has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: A Parallel Nonlinear Control System of Improved Generalized Predictive Control and Single Neuron PID Based on U-model
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: For a class of smooth nonlinear plants, an improved generalized predictive control (JGPC) and single neuron PID (SNPID) parallel control framework based on U-model is proposed. In this framework, firstly, the nonlinear plant is transformed into a U-model, and then the control law of the U-model is designed by using JGPC. According to the current error, SNPID is used to compensate the control effect of JGPC to improve the dynamic performance of system. At the same time, tracking differentiator can reduce overshoot and improve the anti-interference ability of the system. A simulated case study is conducted to illustrate effectiveness of the control framework.

articleTitle: Features of the Development of Devices for the Analysis of Problem Areas of the Skin by the Optical Method
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The inhabitants of the circumpolar region are experiencing the unfavorable conditions of the Arctic. The incidence of skin cancer in Europe’s northern areas is higher than skin cancer incidence in the southern regions. Also, in the circumpolar region, residents most often live in small groups at large distances from each other, which significantly complicates the early diagnosis of skin cancer. Most often, residents of the northern regions are treated by general practitioners who are not specialists in cancer diagnosis. There is the challenge of developing a simple device for general practitioners that can diagnose skin cancer early. This study aims to create such a tool that would allow a non-specialist to diagnose skin cancer and save images so that it is possible to check the condition of the problem skin area in dynamics for several months.

articleTitle: Spatial Correlated Massive MIMO Channel Estimation Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a massive MIMO channel estimation algorithm based on deep learning is proposed. Aiming at the spatial correlation model of massive MIMO system, it uses a combination of feedforward neural network and bidirectional long short-term memory network to estimation under different pilot conditions. Simulation experiments prove that its algorithm is better than traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Model and Algorithm for Vehicle Modal Driving Cycles
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Microtrips are the key in driving cycle, and the base for constructing a driving cycle. For the construction of a modal driving cycle, the study firstly used principal component analysis to reduce the dimensions of the index data of microtrips, then a multi-objective optimization model was established with the goal of minimizing the deviation between the feature of the vehicle modal driving cycle and the actual vehicle operating feature. The non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm-II (NSGA-II) was designed to save the optimization model. Based on the correlation test of actual data, the designed method can obtain highly representative solutions.

articleTitle: Market-based Dynamic Resource Allocation in Mobile Edge Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) is critical to the development of the Internet of things (IoTs) and 5G networks. However, the computation and communication resources of edge servers are limited, so it is challenging to perform resource allocation especially when the competition among edge servers is also taken into consideration. In this paper, we propose a trading model to investigate both the computation and communication resources allocation in MEC systems with multi-server and multiuser. We model the dynamic behavior of mobile users (MUs) using an evolutionary game, and then we build the deterministic model to study the evolution of MUs where the evolutionary equilibrium is considered as the solution. We propose an evolution algorithm to obtain the evolutionary equilibrium. Furthermore, we analyze the competition among edge cloud servers (ECSs) by a noncooperative game, and propose an iteration algorithm to obtain Nash equilibrium. The existences of evolutionary equilibrium and Nash equilibrium are validated in performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation method in family life scene
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The application of home service robots is the future development trend of mobile robots. To make the mobile robot perceive the family living environment and serve all kinds of people, based on collecting images and segmenting them into data sets, a semantic segmentation method for the family living environment is proposed. The photographed images of the research objects (bed and stroller) constitute the image dataset which is split into training and test datasets. Two semantic segmentation algorithms, FCN and SegNet, are utilized to learn the training set, and the performance of each semantic segmentation algorithm is compared and evaluated on the test set. Experimental results show that the accuracy of the two semantic segmentation algorithms for strollers is higher than that for beds. Among them, the AP and the MIoU of the FCN algorithm for the stroller are 95.39%, and 91.08% respectively whereas the SegNet algorithm is 88.88%, and 81.34% respectively. The FCN algorithm shown better performance compared to the SegNet algorithm and it can be applied in our daily life.

articleTitle: Shear Velocity Prediction in the Tight Oil Formation with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Shear velocity is an important parameter for reservoir characterization especially in the unconventional reservoirs such as tight oil and shale gas, but shear velocity log is not available in the field for its high cost, so it is crucial to predict shear wave velocity with conventional logging data. The existing methods of shear wave prediction mainly include empirical formula and rock physics modeling. The empirical formula method is inappropriate for predicting shear wave velocity in the occasion of complex lithology, and many parameters need to be optimized in the process of rock physics modeling, thus it was difficult to be applied widely. This paper focuses on the predicting shear wave velocity with deep feedforward neural network (DFNN) subsequent to the quality control and preprocessing of the input logging data, this method was proved to be much more effective in predicting the S-wave velocity through validation wells than empirical and rock physics modeling method.

articleTitle: Application Research of Anti-Radiation Weapon Resistance in Air and Missile Defense System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In anti-air and anti-missile system, this paper aims at the severe threaten by anti-radiation weapon. It provides five ways against anti-radiation weapon, including pre-warning, cajolery, intercept to destroy, adopting advanced radar system and radar set net. Under protection of our army electronics equipment and personnel’s safety, we should strike electronics equipment and personnel of the enemy with all our might.

articleTitle: Optimal evaluation of shading components for educational buildings in hot and humid areas
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The lighting quality of educational buildings needs to be improved caused the most classrooms show that intense light near the windows but insufficient in the interior. The average daily learning time of primary and secondary school students is more than 9 hours, which puts forward higher requirements for lighting, including illumination and daylighting uniformity. In some cases of leading edge, using reflector as shading method can shade and improve the uniformity of lighting. Taking Guangzhou as the breakthrough point, this paper studies the shading and daylighting problems of educational buildings in hot and humid areas. Using grasshopper software to analyze the climate in Guangzhou, optimize the reflective sunshade component, not only improve the lighting quality, but also enhance the ventilation and heat dissipation. Moreover, the optimal evaluation is determined by the illumination analysis of Ecotect software. The research results actively explore the combination of architectural design and energy-saving means, providing a convenient sunshade method for classrooms in Guangzhou, which has reference for high temperature and high humidity areas.

articleTitle: Expression recognition algorithm based on local and global feature reconstruction residuals
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm is proposed to improve expression recognition by combining reconstructed residuals of local and global information. Firstly, positional relation is introduced into local binary features encoding, and a non-negative matrix decomposition method with sparse correlation constraints is employed to perform reducing of dimension. Then, the features are encoded by bag-of-words model to form local features. Secondly, a discrete wavelet transform is used to emphasis on expression information and extract expression-enhanced global features. Thirdly, collaboration Represents is used to calculate local partial reconstruction residuals and is combined with global reconstruction residuals to construct the final residual to be classified at the decision level. Experiments on Jaffe, TEFID and CK+ data sets prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis on Stock Market Trend Based on Clustering : ——Sichuan Languang Dev as Example
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The Importance of the stock markets in the economy makes researchers pay a large amount of attention to reveal their latent rules. While uncertainty is the most distinctive feature of the stock market, which makes it is difficult to find these latent rules. This paper proposed a new method to analyse the trend of stock price based on the clustering algorithm. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme, an experiment was performed with the stock price data of Sichuan Languang Dev Stock.

articleTitle: A New Control Strategy of T-type Three-level Converter Based on Differential Flatness Theory and Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the robust and dynamic performance of T-type three-level converter and reduce the harmonic content of grid-side current, a new double closed-loop control strategy based on differential flatness theory and sliding mode control (SMC) is proposed. The SMC is adopted in the inner loop, and differential flatness control(DFC) is adopted in the outer loop. In this paper, the working principle of T-type three-level converter is analyzed, and the detailed steps of controller design are given. Finally, the feasibility and superiority of the control strategy are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Laser Measurement of 3D curved Glass Contour based on computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the mobile phone glass industry, curved glass is widely used. Whether the curved glass is measured with high efficiency and precision and whether the curved edge profile error can be evaluated directly affects the quality and service cycle of glass products. In view of the difficulty of accurate measurement and evaluation of 3D mobile phones curved glass profile, a visual measurement method of 3D mobile phones curved glass profile error based on laser scanning and shape template matching is proposed in this paper. Accurate measurement of mobile phone curved glass greatly improves the fit between curved glass and mobile phone and the efficiency of production. Therefore, this paper proposes a method for evaluating the contour degree of curved glass on mobile phones based on Open Cascade and OpenCV. This method uses the lasers and camera equipment to extract the profile outline of the curved glass, then extract the profile outline of the mobile phone curved glass model that has been drawn in 3D software. The extracted contour lines are matched by methods such as translation and rotation, and finally the distance between the corresponding points is calculated as the contour error. Experimental results show that the method is able to accurately measure the profile error and greatly reduce the measurement instability and have good robustness.

articleTitle: Attention-based sequence modeling for categorical emotion recognition with modulation spectral feature
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Emotion information from speech can effectively help robots or virtual agents to understand speaker’s intentions in natural human-robot interaction. Previous studies have indicated that temporal-modulation cues are important for emotional speech perception. Utterance-level modulation spectral features (MSF) obtained from temporal modulation cues are commonly used for emotion recognition. However, MSF is a kind of statistical feature and cannot reflect the temporal dynamics of speech signals very well. In this paper, we propose a categorical emotion recognition method by modeling time sequence of segment-level MSF. Considering that the voice regions of an utterance are more emotional, we use a temporal attention model to capture the salient regions of emotion representation in each utterance. Our experiments with the IEMOCAP database demonstrate that the proposed method can be effectively used to recognize the emotion state of speech from segment-level modulation spectral feature.

articleTitle: Analysis of the relationship between intestinal infectious diseases and socioeconomic factors based on machine learning model
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is not clear how socioeconomic factors affect the incidence of intestinal infectious diseases in China. This article uses generalized linear models and generalized additive models to analyze the relationship between socioeconomic factors and infectious diseases. Research shows that these two models can reflect the relationship between socioeconomic factors and infectious diseases, but GAM has the best goodness of fit. In the GAM model, considering the comprehensive influence of a variety of socioeconomic factors, the proportion of higher education (p=0.0226) and the population over 65 (p=0.0012) have the most significant impact on the incidence. The number of people under 14 years old (p=0. 0206) and the growth rate of fiscal revenue (p=0. 0269) also have a certain impact on the incidence. Considering the impact of single socioeconomic factors, except for the unemployment rate which has no significant impact on the incidence of hepatitis and cholera (p>0.05), the other five socioeconomic factors have a significant impact on the incidence of intestinal infectious diseases (p<0.05). We believe that the incidence of infectious diseases is related to socioeconomic factors, but the influence curves between socioeconomic factors and disease incidence are not in the same direction and are often non-linear which can provide an effective reference for formulating intestinal infectious disease prevention strategies.

articleTitle: An Algebra of Reversible Quantum Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: We extend the algebra of reversible computation to support quantum computing. Since the algebra is based on true concurrency, it is reversible for quantum computing and it has a sound and complete theory.

articleTitle: EPCA basaed Modal Parameters Identification with Test data
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: During the process of modal parameters identification by traditional principal component analysis (PCA), to reduce the effects of the magnitude influence of response data on different discrete points, a method of identifying modal parameters from test data based on equalization PCA (EPCA) is proposed in this paper. The basic idea of this method is equalizing the test data before identifying modal parameters by PCA. Besides, to decrease the undesirable influence of the trend in the test data, we will first remove the trend in the response data. To verify the method proposed in this paper, two different beams’ modal tests have been taken. The modal parameters have been obtained by the modal tests and the response data with different points has been collected either. The modal parameters are identified by traditional PCA and EPCA with the same constraints of principal component cumulative contribution rate with the response data. The results show that, compared with the traditional PCA, the modal shapes identified by EPCA are more similar to the modal shapes obtained by the modal tests.

articleTitle: Application of FBG three-dimensional stress sensor in similar simulation experiment of mining
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensor was presented and designed which was used to monitor the three-dimensional stress independently in similar simulation experiment. The sensing elements with FBGs in x, y, and z directions were combined in one intact material, and the stress would be obtained without interference from other directions because each element could deform independently. To get the relationship between applied stress and wavelength drifts of the FBG sensor, the calibration experiments were carried out, and the sensitivities in x, y, and z direction were obtained. By application in similar simulation experiment, FBG and electrical sensors were laid in the model to monitor variation of stress in rock strata during mining, and the result indicated that the FBG sensor could independently sense the three-dimensional stress which was in accordance with the electrical sensors. It is of great significance for obtaining complicated stress state in rock strata and achieving intrinsically safe mining in coalmine.

articleTitle: Research on the Fast Template Matching Method of Micro Parts
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Through the analysis of the characteristics of high detection frequency, various parts shape, random position and angle in the feeding process of large batch of micro parts assembly, the specific requirements of matching recognition of micro parts are elaborated, such as fast matching speed and affine transformation functions of displacement, rotation and flip. Based on the analysis of the existing typical image matching algorithms, a hybrid multi-level acceleration method is proposed with NCC similarity evaluation algorithm. According to the overlap rate of contour area of the binary template before and after affine transformation, the acceleration initial parameters can be calculated. By calculating the relative proportion of sampling points in contour area of the binary template before and after sampling, the sampling step size of template can be computed. On this basis, the specific steps of cycle multi-level acceleration are described in detail. An example is given to show the convergence of each parameter in the template matching process. The comparison results of six typical matching methods show that the accelerated NCC matching method has the advantages of high similarity, small error, fast speed, good robustness to the effect of illumination and texture, and meet the requirements of template matching in micro parts assembly process.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Evaluation of Rural Smart Tourism in Ningxia under the Cloud-edge-terminal Architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: At present, Ningxia is vigorously developing smart tourism based on the regional smart tourism strategy. Combining the advantages of the cloud computing center in western China, the cloud-edge-terminal tourism information system is building. In order to realize the information service and the decision support of Ningxia smart tourism, this paper researched the construction of cloud-edge-terminal architecture of smart tourism, and described the process logic and function feature of this architecture. Taking the rural agritainment tourism data which is submitted in cloud of this system as an example, the decision support process of smart tourism analysis of the architecture is discussed, which is expressed as Topsis based on entropy and AHP are used to get the situation and overall influence mechanism of rural agritainment tourism in Ningxia.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of high-precision weighted area ratio algorithm for fluorescent optical fiber temperature sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Microwave hyperthermia is a new method to treat cancer, and its therapeutic effect is directly determined by the heating temperature. Fluorescent fiber optic temperature sensors are widely used in this field due to their insulation advantages. In this paper, in order to meet the high-precision requirements of temperature detection in this field, a new weighted area ratio algorithm is implemented. According to the characteristics of random noise distribution, different weight values are superimposed on the fluorescence decay curve data to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of this algorithm. Through numerical simulation analysis, the accuracy of this algorithm is improved by about 77.6% compared with the traditional integral area ratio algorithm. Therefore, this algorithm can meet the high-precision requirements for temperature detection in the field of microwave hyperthermia.

articleTitle: Ultra-short baseline positioning algorithm and error analysis based on three-element plane array
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Underwater Ultra-short baseline (USBL) positioning system has the advantages on system size, installation complexity etc. However, the positioning accuracy of USBL system is very sensitive to time delay measurement error. In this paper, the traditional quadrangle orthogonal array is improved, a three-element plane array is designed, the azimuth and pitch angle equation of the three-element plane array are given, and the effect of time delay difference on the formation measurement accuracy is analyzed, results shows that when the time delay error is within $3\times 10^{-7}$ seconds, the direction finding accuracy of azimuth angle is within 2°, which provides the theoretical basis for the three-element plane array USBL system.

articleTitle: Design of user behavior analysis model of e-commerce website based on Spark
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the context of the era of big data, the demand for website user behavior analysis is increasing. This paper proposes a real-time analysis system for user behavior of e-commerce websites. The system is based on the streaming data processing framework-Spark Streaming. The system combines HBase database, log collection tool Flume, and distributed publish and subscribe messaging system Kafka and relevant technologies. The system includes real-time data collection and preprocessing module, real-time analysis module, and visual display module. E-commerce website users have four common behaviors: click, bookmark, add to shopping cart and make payment. This article is based on their performance in different commodity categories and different time periods. The real-time analysis system analyzes the overall distribution and trend of user behavior. The conclusion is that this article provides a strong basis for helping operators improve the service and maintenance of the website.

articleTitle: A graphical method - genetic algorithm (GMGA) approach for parameter estimation of twofold Weibull mixture model
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This study presents a graphical method - genetic algorithm (GMGA) approach which combines graphical method (GM) and genetic algorithm (GA) for the parameter estimation of twofold Weibull mixture model. GM is firstly conducted to obtain crude estimates based on which the searching domain of each parameter is constructed to prevent the subsequent GA process from local convergence. Then GA searches the optimal parameter estimates according to the fitness function, which is a measurement of the absolute residuals between the fitted and the empirical distribution functions. The fitness function is developed through modifying the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) test so that it can also be directly used as a criterion of goodness-of-fit test. A numerical example is provided to verify the effectiveness of GMGA. The results show that the parameter estimates obtained by GMGA are more accurate than by some existing approaches.

articleTitle: The method of singular value processing for non-contact detection of rotating parts
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of the contour size detection process of rotating parts, the methods of rotating parts, and the stepping movement of the laser sensor for non-contact detection was adopted. Due to the discontinuity of the detection area, the singularity of the detection data was inevitable, which results in the instability of the detection data. Aiming at this problem, the characteristics of data distribution are studied, the causes of singular values are summarized, and a method based on the combination of improved K-means clustering method and evaluation index was proposed. First, according to the characteristics of the data distribution, the negative data in the detection data was replaced by the adjacent value, and then the K value and the initial cluster center of the improved K-Means algorithm were calculated. Finally, the indexes of eligibility and singular value evaluation were established. The experimental results show that this method can accurately judge the qualification of the parts compared with the box plot method and 3$\sigma$ method, and effectively identify the singular value of the detection data and deal with it.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Plan Strategy for Manipulators Based on Movement Rules of Human Arms
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Based on movement rules of human arms, the arm posture prediction of manipulators is studied. Firstly, by observing the movements of the human arms, the conjectures about the movement rules are proposed. On the basis of the conjectures, the human arm movements are analyzed and studied systematically. A hierarchical plan strategy (HPS) according to the movement rules of human arms is proposed to decompose the arm movements into different processes. The distance condition and the orientation condition can be obtained. Then according to the features of the HPS, a modified RRT algorithm is proposed to accomplish a smooth transition of joint trajectory of multiple targets and different dimensions in different motion states. By setting state field, the search space is optimized and the search efficiency is raised. Meanwhile, the constraint functions are set to select the nodes to make the searched joint trajectory conform the movement rules of human arms. Finally, the efficiency of the HPS and the modified RRT algorithm have been verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Depth Guided Auto-Encoder Network for Human Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Human pose estimation (HPE) from the monocular image has been a recent hot topic which has great potential applications on health, safety and security monitoring. However, the estimation accuracy and the requirement of large scale training dataset are two main challenges in this area. In this paper, we introduce a depth guided auto-encoder (AE) network for human pose estimation from the monocular image. Specifically, the Image-to-Depth Auto-Encoder of the network is obtained during the pre-train stage using depth data. The embedding learnt from this AE is then used to train parameters of the decoder in the network for pose estimation. The learned AE from depth data aims to increase the human pose estimation accuracy. Furthermore, we can pre-train the AE using depth information from synthetic data which greatly reduces the need for training data. For evaluation, the proposed approach is applied to SURREAL which is a synthetic dataset. Our depth guided auto-encoder network outperforms the one without it. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization for Linear array CCD Attribute Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In wind tunnel experiments, it is significant to accurately measure the parameters of the model attitude after loading. Linear array CCD high-speed, high-resolution features with a cylindrical lens and planar array CCD array as an auxiliary to be measured together complete the wind tunnel attribute measurement experiment of high-speed test substances with high precision. The special low distortion lens are designed and fabricated using linear array CCD cylindrical lens, lens distortion design specifications are better than 0.05%, in actual test, lens distortion in the middle of the view field is smaller than 0.1%, the edge position distortion is relatively large, but is not more than 0.3%, and is less overall distortion. It is satisfied to the requirements of the large field of view, and high-precision in wind tunnel experiments.

articleTitle: Direct torque control technology of brushless DC motor based on new four-level Inverter topology
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The direct torque control technology of Brushless DC motor can only select one voltage vector in a control cycle, while the direct torque control method under traditional hysteresis control has only three voltage vectors that can be selected, therefore brushless DC motor will produce large torque ripple. For this reason, this paper proposes a new four-level inverter topology and establishes a lookup table of switch state for it, then gives the corresponding four-level direct torque control strategy. At the same time, the voltage of two capacitors is approximately equal by selecting different switch states. The proposed strategy can reduce torque ripple greatly. Finally, the proposed control strategy was simulated on MATLAB to verify its practicability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Linear Quadratic Regulator Controller Based on Adaptive Cuckoo Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to quickly and effectively determine the weighted matrix Q and R in the linear quadratic regulator (LQR) controller of active suspension, this paper presents adaptive cuckoo search algorithm (ACS) for LQR optimization design. ACS improves step size control and discovery probability in standard cuckoo search algorithm (CS) based on adaptive dynamic adjustment strategy. Compared with other test algorithms, for optimizing active suspension LQR controller, experimental results show that the convergence speed of ACS is faster, the solution accuracy is higher, the stability is stronger, and the performance indexes of active suspension are significantly improved.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Compress Method of STL Mesh for Realtime VR Visulization
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the real time VR rendering and simulation, there are normally two ways to solve the conflict between the large-scale data and the speed: one is to enhance the hardware, which will result high cost, and another is to simplify the data, which will waste labor and time if removing interactively. By solving the practical problem, a hybrid compress method has been presented to compress the triangle mesh. The number of triangles can be greatly reduced by applying the normal oriented algorithm, the color-oriented algorithm, and the correcting algorithm. The normal and ray are often used in the shading. Using z-buffer non-hue rendering, a pixel-based algorithm, the colors displayed in the viewport can be compatible with the triangles one to one. The correcting algorithm can solve the problem of the pixel-based algorithm. A STL Compressor has been prototyped to do this task. It can import/export STL format file to connect with the most modeling and the real time VR systems. This method is applied normally to a series of fixed cameras.

articleTitle: Extraction of non-uniform reflected laser lines based on multi-channel region constraint method
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: At present, the existing laser line extraction algorithms need to be in good lighting conditions to get better results. However, in practical application, due to the uneven illumination of the scene or the inconsistent reflection degree of the scanned object surface, the laser line extraction results will be greatly reduced. In some conditions, in order to improve the scanning efficiency, the grid laser line is used, but the grid laser is used Lines usually cause uneven distribution of laser lines. This paper proposes a method of extracting grid laser lines under the condition of non-uniform reflection. In the first step, the influence of global light can be eliminated using the difference between global illumination intensity and its first moment, and the image blocks can be classified using the average illumination intensity of local area to obtain the Region of interest (ROI). In the second step, a constrained region can be calculated by using edge gradient variance of local area and edge gradient maximization. In the third step, the center coordinates of sub-pixel laser line are finally obtained by combining the constrained region and illumination intensity map with Steger algorithm. The method used in this paper needs less empirical parameters to be set manually, and has a wider range of application. The accuracy of extraction is consistent with that of Steger algorithm. From the experimental results of this paper, we can see that we get more effective data, lower error rate and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Development of driver assistant system for heavy duty vehicles and economic calibration
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To optimize the cycle-based fuel economy of the heavy duty vehicle, a driver assistant system with coordinated power system and dynamometer control is developed, and the automatic driving cycle calibration is carried out. The developed system can control the cyclic speed error within the range of ±3km/h. Economic calibration tests were carried out for a certain non-road power system under different debugging rules. The results show that the optimized shift law can reduce fuel consumption by 21.7% compared with the original shift law in typical sand-gravel pavement. The driver assistant system developed has good following effect and high practical value.

articleTitle: Test of the fault behaviors of the component model in the virtual commissioning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to test an industrial component and the control programs in the virtual commissioning, not only the normal behavior but also the fault behavior and incorrect operation must be considered in the modeling of the component. Based on these component models the test during the virtual commissioning identifies whether the system/ component can react properly and safely in fault scenarios. This paper introduces a method which can support the model design and the test case selection by the Failure-Sensitive Specification method.

articleTitle: Research on Cyberspace Modeling Framework for Intelligent Defense
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the ever-increasing demand for Cyberspace in Defense Technology, researches surrounding Cyberspace have become a hot topic. This article firstly elaborates on the concept of Cyberspace and its attributes from the geographic, informational and social perspectives. Then based on the angle of modeling, the framework of “ Three Dimensions and Five Levels ” is proposed, and the modeling of Cyberspace map is discussed. Finally, this article discusses the possibility of intelligent defense from the perspective of knowledge space.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Power Supply System for EAST In-Vessel Down Divertor Coil
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: EAST (Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak) requires the use of in-vessel down divertor coil to realize quasi-snowflake, FTD (Fishtail Divertor) and detachment of plasma. The required current of the down divertor coil is up to dc 20kA and ac 30kA with adjustable frequency from 5 to 100Hz. The response time is less than 1ms, the current rise rate is more than 10kA/ms, and the power factor is unity or high. This paper describes a topology design through analyzing three different high-power topologies. The carrier phase-shift modulation method (CPS-PWM) is applied to solve the contradiction of high-power switch devices between output high current capability, fast response speed and low output ripple. The advantages and feasibility of the proposed design have been verified by simulation using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Construction of Driving Cycle: A Study Based on PCA, K-Means, and GA
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The microtrips is the key in driving cycle. For the selection of microtrips, the study firstly used principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the dimensions of the index data of microtrips, and used K-Means clustering analysis to classify microtrips. Then the microtrip’s feature vector-based construction of driving cycle was analyzed with the optimization model of the minimum on the Euclidean distance between the microtrips’ feature vector of different categories and the clustering center, and the designed genetic algorithm with elitist strategy, multi-point crossover and mutation genetic operators. The results of actual data show that the proposed method has some reference value.

articleTitle: A Shallow Crack Detection Method Based on Attractor Model
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: When the overall image processing method is used to detect the cracks in the building with different degrees of depth, the shallow cracks could not be detected or the detection is incomplete. In this paper, a shallow crack detection algorithm based on attractor model is proposed. Each pixel on the image is assumed to be a vector and regarded as an attractor. Then according to the degree of attraction between them, the two are matched to obtain multiple attractors. The rectangular region between each set of attractors was determined, and the corresponding rectangular region in the original drawing was processed, the final shallow crack skeleton diagram was obtained by splicing. The results show that this method can detect shallow cracks clearly and accurately.

articleTitle: A novel Low-energy input welding system for lightweight material
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Compared with other metal materials, the welding performance of lightweight materials is obviously lower, which seriously hinders the industrial application of such materials. In order to improve the welding effect of lightweight materials, the overall design scheme of cold welding power source (low energy input gas metal arc welding inverter power source) was designed. The proposed scheme adopts a bipolar soft switch control system on the of voltage and current waveforms for the hardware, to effectively reduce the switching energy consumption. Besides, A welding expert system is designed for the software. The expert system adopts a Newton interpolation welding parameter self-adjusting algorithm to realize fine adjustment of output control, which can not only eliminate splash factors, but also significantly reduce arc energy consumption. The Welding experiment results show that the welding process is stable and the weld joint is well formed. That’s to say, the cold welding power source based on the expert system is effective in welding lightweight materials, such as aluminum and magnesium sheets.

articleTitle: Robotic Arm Control in Polar Coordinate System Using Distance-Speed Curve
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of complex multi-degree-of-freedom robotic arm structure and high coupling control, a three-dimensional robotic arm system in polar coordinates is designed in this paper. Due to the traditional mainstream control algorithm being prone to rapid changes in stepper motor speed, resulting in damage to the mechanical structure of the system, we propose a strategy for robotic arm control based on stepper motor and distance-speed curve. The distance-speed curve stepper motor control algorithm establishes the maximum operating speed curve according to system design requirements, mapping the target distance parameters to the speed curve to achieve speed control. The experiments prove that the three-dimensional robotic arm in polar coordinate reduces the complexity of the system and improves the reliability and practicality of the system.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning Model Integrating Short-term Trend and Long-term Trend Used in Stock Price Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of the stock market and the improvement of people’s living standard, more and more investors enter the stock market, and how to use historical information to analyze and predict the future trend in the complex stock market has become a hot issue at present. Based on SVR model, this paper introduces a stock price prediction model on the basis of short-term and long-term ensemble learning, analyzing and verifying the ensemble learning model with a large amount of historical data of the stock price. The results of the experiment show that the ensemble learning model can effectively improve the accuracy of the SVR model in stock price prediction.

articleTitle: Multiple sound source localization by using diffuseness estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a scheme for multiple source localization by using diffuseness estimation. According to the sparsity of the voice signal, single source time-frequency point (SSTP) always exists in the microphone recorded sound signal. The DOA estimates of these SSTPs have favorable localization statistical significance. Through analysis the characteristics of diffuseness measure, this paper gives an assumption that there is some correlation existed between diffuseness measure and SSTP. Through experiments, we found that the TF point with low diffuseness measure can be classified as SSTP. Therefore, a SSTP detection method based on diffuseness estimation is proposed. Meanwhile, the multiple source localization problem is converted to a single source localization among the detected SSTPs. The objective evaluations revealed that the proposed method achieved higher localization accuracy compared to some existing technique based on single sound source zone detection.

articleTitle: Over-frequency Generator Tripping Control of Sending-end System Considering Transient Instability Generating Units
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the high penetration of renewable energy sources participating in the power grid, frequency stability control becomes a significant problem restricting the security and stability operation of a multi-HVDC sending-end system with a small load and large power. HVDC monopolar blocking or bipolar blocking leads to increasing the sending-end system frequency. Over-frequency generator tripping is an important control measure to restraining the sending-end system frequency increasing. This paper proposes the configuration principles of over-frequency generator tripping considering the transient instability generating units, the frequency protection of wind turbines, and the variation of the line power flow. Then, the configuration process and the method of the over-frequency generator tripping scheme is proposed according to the configuration principles and the field operation experience. An example of a provincial power grid is used to verify the effectiveness and the adaptability of the proposed over-frequency generators tripping scheme under different operation modes and HVDC blocking failures.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Using t-SNE and GWO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Fault diagnosis of the key component (i. e., bearings) can ensure the normal operation of the wind turbine and reduce the economic loss. In this paper, aiming at the difficulty in bearing feature extraction, a novel fault diagnosis model using refined composite multiscale sample entropy (RCMSE), t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE), and grey wolf optimization-based support vector machine (GWO-SVM) is proposed. Firstly, RCMSE is introduced to extract the features of bearing signals in different states, and a high-dimensional feature set can be obtained. Then, t-SNE manifold learning is applied to extract the sensitive and low-dimensional feature set. Finally, the RCMSE+t-SNE set is input to the GWO-SVM classifier for classification. The proposed method is applied to analyze the experimental signals of wind turbine bearings, while the results show that it can effectively and accurately identify various bearing faults. Moreover, compared with other methods, the proposed method has higher recognition accuracy.

Author Keywords: grey wolf optimization-based support vector machine

articleTitle: The Application Analysis of the Construction Method of Minimum Entropy Unsupervised thesaurus in Ancient Chinese Word Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Ancient Chinese text segmentation is the basic work of the Intelligentization of ancient books. In this paper, the unsupervised thesaurus construction algorithm based on the minimum entropy model is applied to a large-scale ancient text corpus, and the lexicon composed of high-frequency cooccurring neighbor characters in the ancient text is extracted; and the lexicon is combined with existing word segmentation tools to perform ancient text segmentation experiment. The experimental results show that this method has different enhancement effects on the word segmentation effect of ancient texts in different periods, which shows that the vocabulary has a certain range of effectiveness. In addition, this article is one of the few works that apply monolingual word segmentation methods to ancient Chinese word segmentation. The work of this article has enriched the research in related fields.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on the coal gasification process in dry feed entrained gasifier
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a detailed 3D computational fluid dynamics (CFD) model for two-stage entrained flow dry feed coal gasifier was developed. With the standard computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software FLUENTO15.0, a number of simulations were conducted to show the process of coal gasification at different coal and oxidant ratio, and to form the distribution between the two stages of the gasifier. Based on published experimental results, we investigated firstly different reaction mechanism for the validated model. And then investigations were made through the validation of the model for crucial parameters such as species concentration, char conversion and so on. At the first stage, the distribution of Coal is 50% and Oxygen is 60%, and the distribution of Coal is 50% and Oxygen is 40% at the second stage. According to per reference experimental conditions, the overall Oxygen/Coal (O/C) ratio was maintained at 0.9, 1.0, 1.1 for preliminary validated study. The analysis of the results show that the composition of syngas at the exit of gasifier are quite similar to the referred experimental case in conditions of E. And when the Oxygen/Coal (O/C) ratio is equal to 1.0, overall performance is optimized, such as syngas, temperature and carbon conversion.

articleTitle: Research on Device Management Mechanism for Smart Home Edge Gateway
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, the maturity of cloud computing technology has greatly promoted the wide application of smart home. As the key function of smart home system, device management can not meet the user’s efficient and secure application requirements only relying on cloud platform. Therefore, this paper applies the idea and technology of edge computing to the field of smart home, and takes the gateway near the device side as the edge server, and on this basis, constructs the corresponding device management mechanism. The main work includes the construction of data centric device discovery mechanism and plug-in device control mechanism, which provides an effective solution for the problems of diversity, heterogeneity, efficiency of smart home devices. Finally, the corresponding prototype system is implemented and the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Commutation Torque Ripple Suppression of Brushless DC Motor Using Simple Four-Level Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of torque ripple caused by the limitation of the DC bus voltage during the commutation of the brushless DC motor, a four-level conversion circuit control method is proposed. The circuit has a simple structure and convenient to be controlled. The charging process of the capacitor can be realized without an external charging device, so that it is able to improve the utilization rate of motor energy. During the commutation in the low speed range, the duty cycle is increased to suppress torque ripple. During the commutation in the high speed range, the torque ripple is suppressed by connecting the capacitor to increase the bus voltage. The capacitor energy storage comes from the modulation method adopted during the two-phase conduction period. This control method can achieve a good suppression effect in a wide range of speed. Finally, the proposed method was simulated and analyzed in MATLAB to prove the reliability and correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on speed control algorithm of belt conveyor based on controllable parameter PSO-PID
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of excessive average acceleration, large overshoot and obvious oscillation in belt conveyor speed regulation, a parameter controllable particle swarm optimization–proportional–integral–derivative (PSOPID) speed control algorithm is proposed. Simulation analysis shows that the algorithm can maintain the average acceleration within a reasonable range and significantly reduce overshoot and oscillation, which can effectively reduce the damage to the belt conveyor caused by speed regulation and maximize the high efficiency. And the algorithm thus has high application value in coal, port, power, mining, metallurgy, chemical industry and other industries.

articleTitle: The Force Feedback and Master-Slave Teleoperation Robot for Live Working
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of rescue and safe operation in power industry, we design the live working robot whose structure and control method are introduced. We design the system solution of the force feedback and master-slave teleoperation robot for live working. Its structure and performance are optimized by kinematics, dynamics and finite element analysis. Besides, we build the kinematics model of the robot. Aiming at the problems of master-slave synchronous operation and force control in working process, teleoperation control method and force feedback control method are designed. Through the force feedback simulation experiment on WEBOTS, we verify that the force feedback control meets the design requirements. The feasibility of the method is verified by semi-physical simulation platform. Finally, experiments are carried out on the force feedback master-slave teleoperation robot, which verifies that the synchronization of the master-slave teleoperation meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: An End-to-End Network for Single Image Dedusting
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Dust storm not only reduces visibility of natural scene, but also affects capture capability of outdoor monitoring equipment. Image dedusting aims to remove dust storm in images and make image scenes clearer. However, most of existing image enhancement-based methods have focused on defogging and deraining, and have paid little attentions to image dedusting. Therefore, research of image dedusting is necessary. In this paper, we presented an end-to-end network for single image dedusting. First, the proposed method uses an encoder module to encode a dusty image into image feature maps. Second, it uses the latest smoothed dilated residual convolution module to alleviate gridding artifacts caused by a widely-used dilated convolution. Third, it adopts an attention-based module to fuse image features at different levels and extract more contextual image information. Finally, it utilizes a decoder module, which decodes the feature maps, to obtain a residue, and adds it to the input dusty image to obtain the final image dedusting result. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in image dedusting.

articleTitle: GNSS Spoofing DetectionWith Using Planar Array
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: GNSS spoofing interference is a major threat to the security of the GNSS services. Among all the spoofing type, the type that the spoofing signals come from different emitting sources is the most deceptive one, which is difficult to detect. In this paper, an anti-spoofing method was proposed to detect this type interference with using planar array. The method recognizes spoofing signal by comparing the carrier-phase single difference (CPSD) measurements, which is calculated between different array elements, with the expect CPSD estimations. As the attitude of the antenna array is assumed to be unknown, it has to be estimated in the process of estimating expect CPSD. The spoofing decision variable was deduced based on the differences between CPSD measurements and expectations. And the statistical characterization of the variable was analyzed as well. In the last, the spoofing detection performance was evaluated by Monte Carlo simulations. The simulation results illustrated that no matter how many emitting sources, as long as the angle between the incident direction of spoofing signal and corresponding authentic one is larger than 5 degrees, it will be detected effectively by the proposed method with a 3 elements array.

articleTitle: Intersecting Line Trajectory Tracking Control of Robot Manipulators and Dynamic Simulation Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: It is difficult to weld the intersecting line, and the accuracy is difficult to guarantee. In order to improve the welding quality, taking the intersection line welding seam track control as the research object, it uses the visual sensor to identify and locate the intersection line weld and track the welding track in this paper. The control system is designed by using the adaptive fuzzy PID control method, so as to improve the welding quality and motion precision. The dynamic simulation software adams is used for the simulation calculation and analysis for the welding trajectory of the intersecting line in the welding process, and the adaptive fuzzy PID controller is simulated by MATLAB. It ensures that it has good adaptability and can realize fast and accurate tracking of welding seam.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Multi-modal Signal Generator
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a frequency-adjustable signal generator based on Xilinx FPGA and uses Verilog language to realize long-range waveform output and adjustment through UART serial communication interface. The design realizes sine wave, triangle wave, square wave and other waveforms. The output design analyzes the principle and advantages of using FPGA to implement Direct Digital Synthesis (DDS). The main indicators reach 14-bit data width and 1024-bit depth ROM meter output, and the frequency adjustable output range is 1Hz-100MHz. And through the oscilloscope display and Vivado simulation tools for simulation waveform verification, the system meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Internet of Things Edge Autonomy Technology Based on Microservice in Power Pipe Gallary
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of power internet of things and the continuous improvement of the State Grid Company's requirements for the safe operation of the station, there are more and more monitoring systems for power transmission and transformation pipe gallary in engineering application. The information between multiple systems is relatively isolated. The workload of the operation and maintenance personnel increases dramatically, and the operation safety risk increases accordingly. In order to improve the perception ability, remote operation and maintenance level of the station, it is necessary to study a kind of management platform for information sharing. Based on mqtt protocol and using microservice architecture, the design makes function module plug-and-play possible. An edge autonomy technology of IOT is proposed to integrate intelligent substation and internet of things which can improve the high reliability of the system operation and ensure the security and stability of the power system.

articleTitle: A Multiple-Vehicle Decision-Making Model for Left-Turn Behavior of AVs at Urban Intersections based on conflict resolution
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the complex and dynamic urban road environment, conflicts in time and space between different traffic participants are inevitable. In this paper, a model to predict the trajectories of oncoming straight vehicles is proposed based on the Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) model with the consideration of analysis of left-turn potential conflict behaviors. Then, a conflict resolution method for left-turn behavior of autonomous vehicles at urban intersections and a driving action selection method considering multiple factors, such as safety, efficiency, comfort and altruism, are proposed. Experiments show that the model can guide the unmanned vehicles to complete the task with a success rate of more than 90%. The research results can provide decision-making support for autonomous vehicles passing through urban intersections safely.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis based on multi-sensor information fusion using LSTM and D-S evidence theory
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The aero-engine is so complex that make it very difficult to diagnosis faults. The fusion diagnosis is a hot research pot, and may give a new way to solve the above problems. LSTM neural network and D-S evidence theory methods are studied in detail, and a novel fault diagnosis method based on sensor information fusion is constructed. Taking C-Mapss turbofan engine simulation fault data as an example, the sensor data is classified, and the output result of LSTM neural network is used as input to construct a recognition framework of DS evidence fusion for fault diagnosis. The results show that this method can help avoiding false alarms to a certain extent, improving the accuracy of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Design of Auto Cruise System for Robots Based on UWB with Kalman filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to give full play to the advantages of UWB, we combine cruise robots with UWB technology to realize the function of indoor robot cruising. This paper proposes the Kalman filtering algorithm for optimizing the positioning fluctuation problem and several design schemes of cruise algorithms based on the PID algorithm, double tags method and electronic compass direction marking method.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Experimental Teaching Project of Nursing Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, virtual reality technology has been effectively applied in the field of medicine, especially in experimental teaching. It is helpful to solve the problem of insufficient teaching resources, stimulate the interest of nursing students in learning, promote the development of empathy teaching, solve the difficulties in traditional experimental teaching, and improve the practical application and hands-on ability of students. This paper shares the construction and application of virtual reality technology in nursing experimental teaching from the aspects of design, production, and application of experimental projects, and provides reference for promoting nursing practice teaching reform and resource construction.

articleTitle: Nonlinear modified sliding mode control of ship heading
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Sliding mode control with differential compensation solves the overshoot problem of the system to a great extent, but also increases the energy consumption of the steering gear. A sliding mode controller with nonlinear modification is designed to solve this problem, and the MMG model of “MV KOTA SEGAR” is simulated. The simulation results show that this method can reduce the energy consumption of steering gear to a certain extent, and has good robustness.

articleTitle: Multi-variable Discretization Based on Extended Maximum Information Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Supervised data discretization is partitioning continuous variables based on a label of classification. The label usually defaults to a categorical variable. But in some applying scenario, the label may be a continuous variable. The usual way to handle this problem is transferring the label to a categorical variable, then discretizing target variable. However, the error generated in the first step may be magnified in the second step. Therefore, we propose a data discretization method based on an extended maximum information coefficient which can deal with multiple variables to combine two steps in one. We analyze the mathematical properties and calculation strategy of the method, and give examples of data set from the world health organization.

articleTitle: A Semi-analytical Algorithm for Remotely Estimating Suspended Particulate Matter of Inland Waters
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Monitoring total suspended particulate matter (TSM) by remoting sensing is particularly challenging for inland waters. Although several models have been developed for TSM inversion, their accuracy varies evidently due to variability in inherent optical properties (IOPs) of the inland waters. To address this issue, we proposed a semi-analytical algorithm, which is based on Quasi-Analytical Algorithm (QAA), for remotely estimating TSM concentration in Maozhou River, located in Shenzhen, China. An innovative loss function was defined to represent homogeneity and rationality of IOPs within a small geographic region in this paper. Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) was employed to modify the QAA model by minimizing the value of the loss function. The proposed approach requires no in-situ IOPs data, which makes it practical. Furthermore, a TSM inversion model based on Normalized Difference TSM Index (NDTI) was developed and validated. The results of higher relevance between TSM concentrations and IOPs retrieved by the Modified QAA model showed that the approach we proposed was helpful for TSM inversion. The values of MRE, MAE and RMSE showed that the accuracy of the model is acceptable for inland waters.

articleTitle: Development of Data Acquisition System of Electric Parameters for Neutral Beam Injector Ion Source
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The neutral beam injection(NBI) is one of the most effective heating and current driven methods. The ion source is the important part of beam line, which electric parameters are important for experimental operation and troubleshooting. In order to acquiring the experimental parameters of ion source, the data acquisition system of electric parameters of ion source for NBI has been developed. Considering the galvanic isolation, the data acquisition system must contain the function of isolation transmission. The transmission rate of the system reaches 3kHz, which meets the experimental demands absolutely. Experimental results show that the data acquisition system achieves the measurement of current and voltage signals of ion source.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Factors influencing Users’ Psychological Reactance to Artificial Intelligence Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This study aims to examine factors influencing users’ psychological reactance to Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications. We defined and categorized psychological reactance into cognitive reactance and emotional reactance. Built on concepts and theories on technology readiness, technology acceptance model and privacy concerns, we developed a comprehensive model explaining factors influencing users’ cognitive and emotional reactance to AI applications. An online survey was used to collect data. The results of data analysis show that users’ insecurity, perceived usefulness, subjective norm and privacy concerns significantly affect their cognitive reactance; discomfort and privacy concerns significantly affect emotional reactance; and users’ psychological reactance significantly affects their attitude towards AI applications.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Three-dimensional Finite Element Analysis in Comparing Different Kinds of Orthodontic Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Orthodontics has the characteristics of complex mechanical properties, changeable causes and types of malocclusion, and long treatment course, which makes students feel boring in theoretical study and can not combine theoretical study with clinical practice well. This paper focuses on the application of finite element analysis in orthodontic teaching to establish models of different malocclusion, in order to deepen students' understanding of various orthodontic techniques and mechanisms, and to make students understand the characteristics of different appliances concretely, in order to solve the existing problems. We expect that through the combination of three-dimensional finite element analysis and orthodontic teaching, students can get twice the result with half the effort in the study of orthodontics.

articleTitle: Visual Display of Tunnel Water Damage in Construction Stage
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Research purpose: the tunnel often suffers from water disaster during the construction stage under the influence of various factors,, and the Water inflow can reflect the threat to the tunnel to a certain extent. At the same time, the impact of water damage on the tunnel has a long-term nature, and its occurrence location is a sensitive part of the operation stage, which must be monitored later. However, the water hazard information record in the construction phase is generally paper-based, and the archive information data is too much and not intuitive. Therefore, it is necessary to visualize the archive data. In this paper, BIM Technology is used to locate and visualize the water inflow of the tunnel, so as to facilitate the maintenance during the operation period. The conclusions are as follows: (1) Based on the established 3D solid tunnel model, the program to determine the specific location of water damage on the tunnel cross section is compiled. (2) RGB color can give different warning to the observer, reflecting the feasibility of tunnel water output in the construction stage. (3) The research results can provide a reference for the visual display of information files of disease problems in tunnel construction stage.

articleTitle: Making Connections: How Do Control and Hydraulic-Mechanical-Electrical Subsystems Relate to Low Frequency Oscillations in a Hydropower Generation Unit : Making connections: subsystems relate to low frequency oscillations
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
