abstract: This paper aims to understand the performance of low frequency oscillations in a hydropower generation unit. Considering a nonlinear hydropower model, the effect of varied control parameters on the oscillation frequency and damping ratio is revealed. The correlation coefficient of the low frequency oscillation related to the hydraulic, mechanical and electrical subsystems is also calculated under different control parameters. Moreover, the sensitivity of various flow passage components to different types of low frequency oscillations is quantified. It is useful to identify the dominant component that has a close relation to the specific oscillation mode. The results help reveal the correlative mechanism between the stability of subsystems and the oscillation mode.

articleTitle: The application of ratio correction method in radio spectrum
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Molecular spectrum lines can be viewed on the radio spectrum, but discrete digital power spectrum analysis algorithms would introduce errors that make it difficult to obtain accurate information about spectral lines. In this paper, the ratio correction method were studied and carried out to solve the problem of frequency offset. It is a kind of spectrum correction method, which is characterized by its simple, convenient and fast algorithms. The effect of such correction is determined by the change of the normalized frequency offset under two conditions: different spectral resolution with the same and different radio signals. Setting the radio frequency to be 80.0, 141.8 and 270.8 MHz, the frequency resolution were finally improved to 7.5 Hz/channel. By comparing the experimental results, the optimal frequency resolution of the sampling system used in experiment was 50.0 Hz/channel and 200 Hz/channel.

articleTitle: Construction of complex electromagnetic environment based on complex network theory
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: the research on the construction of complex electromagnetic environment has always been a hot topic for scholars, but most of them are inseparable from the study of frequency domain, time domain, spatial domain and energy domain. This paper provides a new perspective for the construction of complex electromagnetic environment, studies the construction of complex electromagnetic environment from the perspective of complex network theory, and preliminarily analyzes the feasibility of this construction method.

articleTitle: Modeling Method Of Integrated Unmanned Warehouse System Based On Flexsim
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Integrated unmanned warehouse system is a special kind of physical protection systems (PPS). The traditional physical protection system can only be used to protect their own goods and materials from theft, robbery and illegal transfer, but not realize the safe exchange of materials between the two sides. In this paper, in order to solve the above problems, the integrated unmanned warehouse system technology research for specific background, combined with dual authorization authentication technology based on Biometrics, through Flexsim simulation software, proposed a modeling scheme to solve the above problems and carry out simulation, to achieve the seamless monitoring of the material conversion process of both parties of the contract is realized.

articleTitle: Research on Factors influencing the Epidemic Information Acceptance of Middle-aged and elderlypeople on Mobile Terminals
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to enable middle-aged and elderly groups to have a more efficient access to epidemic information when facing diseases, this paper takes covid-19 information as an example, 12 related factors interrelated to the efficiency have been selected through literature and user studies, amog which the key points and their correlation have been found out through decision-making trial and evaluation laboratory(DEMATAL). Results shows that the key elements that ultimately affect the epidemic information acceptance of middle-aged and elderly groups are content presentation, page readability and shareability;and the three factors that largely affect others are vision problems, page readability and page layout. Besides, the problems in the process of the middle-aged and elderly groups using mobile products to obtain information are further analyzed, and related countermeasures and suggestions for improvement are proposed.

articleTitle: A Phase Current Compensation Control for Comfort and Handling stability Improvement in In-Wheel Motor Driven Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, the automotive industry has experienced an increasing demand for highly efficient and compact power transmissions. Independent-wheel drive electric vehicles with in-wheel motor (IWM) system, which integrates multiple functions assembled, has brought significant attention. However, the advantages are overshadowed by its inherent noise and vibration due to the weak damping structure. In this paper, some factors behind medium frequency noise and torque ripple of SR motor are investigated. A phase current balance control strategy to improve output torque ripple in operation are proposed. Results show that the medium frequency noise and torque ripple can be eliminated by applying the proposed current balance control strategy.

articleTitle: Output Feedback Control of Networked Control Systems with Compensate for Packet Loss and Random Time Delays
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a state observer is designed for the unmeasurable state in the system to compensate time delay and packet loss. First, the packet loss is established as a random Bernoulli sequence. Second, a state observer is designed for the long-time and short-time delay respectively, and a stochastic system model is obtained. Then, the stability analysis is got by Lyapunov stability theory, controller parameters is caculated. Simulation results show that this method can effectively compensate the impact of packet loss and time delay

articleTitle: The implementation of zero-shot algorithm on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: By introducing attribute variables, the zero-shot learning method can reduce the labeled data set needed for model training under the condition of ensuring the correctness of deep learning model. In this paper, the hardware IP modules of convolution and pooling layers are designed, then by writing the hardware driver and software driver in Vivado, the deep neural network is accelerated on Zedboard. The traditional zero-shot learning method is implemented on hardware, and both performance analysis and correctness verification of the system are carried out.

articleTitle: Research on surrounding rock abrasivity and its influence factors in TBM tunnelling inclined shaft project
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The rock abrasivity index of Cerchar Abrasivity Index (CAI) is an important indicator affecting TBM cutter wear. This paper aims to study the relationship between rock abrasivity and its influencing factors. Based on the inclined shaft tunnelling project in Bulianta coal mine, fourteen groups of rock specimens were selected to perform CAI test and relevant mechanical experiments. Also, the analyses of linear regression and multiple regression are conducted to discuss and predict CAI correlated with its influencing factors. The results indicate that rock specimens are medium abrasive and each mechanical parameter has significant effect on rock abrasivity. Uniaxial compressive strength (UCS) has a strong linear relationship with CAI when single factor is considered, while mineral weighted hardness value (WHV) and UCS impose most influence on CAI and account for 93.6 percent of the factors influencing rock abrasivity. If other factors remain unchanged, the CAI value increases by 0.01 (or 0.438) unit when UCS (or WHV) increases by one unit. Accurate measure of CAI can provide cutter wear prediction issue with certain guidance and reference.

articleTitle: Construction of source-charge probability distribution model for electric power field
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of new energy industry, it’s beneficial to analyze the characteristics of new energy which stabilize the operation of the power grid and economic dispatch. It’s more and more important to model the uncertainty of new energy. Although there are some probabilistic modeling methods based on real load data for wind power output, they are not accurate and have high computational complexity. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a source-charge probability distribution model based on variational autoencoder. The model uses deep learning techniques to perform variational autoencoder and probabilistic modeling for real-time wind power data. This unsupervised method can learn the characteristics of wind power data and generate new data based on the characteristics of the observation without the scene reduction process. It improves the efficiency and quality of scene generation.

articleTitle: Aero-engine Gas-path Fault Diagnosis by CNN Based on QAR Data
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Civil aero-engine gas-path fault diagnosis is challenging due to its complicated parametric variation mechanism and the nonlinear relationship between fault performance and parameter variation. There still lacks effective approaches to provide reliable fault detection results with the massive Quick Access Recorder(QAR) data which has been used to monitor the gas-path condition by expert experience. In this paper, we propose a novel fault diagnosis methodology using Convolutional Neural Network(CNN). We use C-MAPSS data to train the neural network. Using the theory of transfer learning, the trained neural network is used to diagnose the fault of QAR data. The diagnosis result shows the method is able to reliably monitor the aero-engine condition and detects the gas-path fault automatically.

articleTitle: A Moving Object Detection Method Based on 3D Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Moving object detection technology, which is always used in many aspects such as video classification, animal motion capture and human-computer interaction, is now the most common technology in computer vision and video information processing. Although the current moving object detection technology has been quite mature, due to environmental factors and a series of reasons, it still faces many challenges such as the impact of noise, camera shake and automatic adjustment, natural light changes, moving objects stagnation, background object movement, dynamic background and so on. In this paper, we use the convolution neural network to solve the problem of moving object detection, the proposed method will extract the feature of moving object through a lot of training. The model proposed in this paper is called 3D-CNN, it combines information of both time and space to extract feature which makes the model more rational. According to the experiment results, our 3D-CNN model achieves a higher accuracy than the most traditional methods.

articleTitle: A Transient Enhancement Circuit Applied in Peak-Current Mode Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A transient response enhancement circuit applied in peak-current mode converter is proposed, which can improve the system transient response. Because the bandwidth of the traditional peak-current mode Boost converter is limited by the right half plane zero, the transient response speed is limited during the load step. A circuit is proposed which can adaptively adjust the output voltage of the Boost converter and optimized the system transient response. The proposed circuit is simulated and verified by 0.18um BCD process. The recovery time was reduced from 67$\mu$s to 49$\mu$s while the load current changed from 1A to 200mA. The recovery time was reduced from 47$\mu$s to 35$\mu$s while the load current changed from 200mA to 1A.

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling Strategy of Single Process Intelligent RGV
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the formulation of single process fault free intelligent RGV dynamic scheduling strategy, a double objective optimization model is established to improve the efficiency of RGV and shorten the production time of single material. For the solution of the model, firstly, the shortest moving path of RGV is determined according to Greedy algorithm and Tabu search algorithm, and the loading and unloading sequence of RGV is determined according to the short job priority scheduling algorithm. For intelligent RGV dynamic scheduling problem with single process failure, The failure time is determined by the cumulative failure probability model of the system, According to the period of the fault point, after determining the fault CNC, a new dynamic scheduling model is obtained according to the no fault scheduling strategy. Finally, the model and the algorithm are verified by the data.

articleTitle: Effects of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness prescription on SOD and MDA levels in mice with “fear of kidney injury” model
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Purpose: to investigate the effect of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness prescription on SOD and MDA levels in mice with “fear of kidney injury” model. Method: The model of fear of hurting kidney was adopted(that is the fear of the kidney damage), to adapt the kunming species of female mice in laboratory after 1 week, digital table method were randomly divided into 3 groups, the party group of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness (dosed with 10g/kg. d suspension of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness prescription)10; The normal control group and the model control group(0.2ml/10g distilled water each day)were given 10 tablets each. Except for the normal control group, the other two groups were frightened by male cats. The serum SOD and MDA levels of the three groups were detected at 21d. [Results]: Compared with the model group, the serum SOD level of the reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness prescription group was higher than that of the model control group, and the MDA level was lower than that of the model group, with statistical significance(P<0.05, P<0.01). SOD in the model group was lower than that in the normal control group, with statistical significance(P<0.05). MDA in the model group was significantly higher than that in the normal control group and the anti-deafness prescription group(P<0.05). Conclusion: Hypoglycemic anti-deafness prescription can increase SOD and decrease MDA in serum of mice with “fear of kidney injury”.

Author Keywords: the prescription of reducing blood sugar and preventing deafness

articleTitle: Image recognition and tracking of flowing sub-flame in downward fire of building insulation materials : A Method based on image morphology, SVM and db-scan algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The fire of the XPS foams on the building facade is a big threat since their fast burning with melting, dripping and flowing. This work developed an image processing algorithm to track the flowing sub-flame and extract the dynamic flame leading curves. The flame leading edges were extracted with Moore-Neighbor tracing algorithm and the image close operation. The image morphology operation was used to locate the candidate flowing sub-flames, and the true melting sub-flames were identified by SVM and a critical distance to the flame leading edge. The moving trajectory of flowing molten sub-flame was obtained through the db-scan method. The results show a wave-like movement of the flame leading curves. The disturbance to the flame leading curve is more obvious for the bigger dripping at the lower locations. The flowing sub-flames can be well tracked by this image processing method. The results indicate that the size of the flowing sub-flames is close to the lognormal distribution.

articleTitle: Non-holonomic Constraints Aided SINS Integration for Autonomous Land Navigation without External Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) based vehicle weapon system increases great significance in land navigation. In order to obtain considerable navigation performance, SINS based integrated navigation is required to implemented. However, the popular aided sensor such as Global-Positioning-System (GPS) is not regarded as autonomous sensor. The autonomous sensor such as odometer can be also damaged in practical applications. In this paper, we utilize non-holonomic constraints (NHC) to aid SINS without external sensors. The measurements of NHC include zero lateral velocity and zero vertical velocity in vehicle orthogonal reference frame. Then, the close-loop Kalman filter can be implemented for SINS/NHC integrated navigation. The simulation results show that the SINS/NHC integrated navigation can estimate all the error states with specific movements. Moreover, SINS/NHC can achieve considerable position navigation performance. Therefore, the proposed method can realize autonomous land navigation without external sensors.

articleTitle: Controlled Source Electromagnetic Data Denoising Based On CEEMD and Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Controlled-source electromagnetic method (CSEM) signals are inevitably contaminated by man-made noises. For this reason, a new CSEM data processing method was proposed. First, the 50 Hz powerline interference was removed by FFT method, followed by the CEEMD method to remove baseline drift, and finally the correlation analysis method was used to select the high-quality signal. The method was applied to the processing of measured data in Huidong, Sichuan. As a conclusion, the presented method can effectively remove the strong cultural noise from raw CSEM data and preserve the useful signal completely; the apparent resistivity curves acquired by using the filtered data are improved significantly upon the previous.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Amplitude-Frequency characteristic of helical feeder
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Piezoelectric screw feeder is one key component of automation equipment in the electronic packaging industry, it works on resonance, this article will establish an accurate dynamic model which fully considers each part to predict the working state of the whole machine. The essay rebuilt the 3-DOF dynamic model based on related researches, considering both the coupling of the torsional vibration and the vertical vibration of the system and the influence of the rubber foot. The resonance point obtained by theoretical analysis is 1213rad/s, the actual test resonance point is 1196rad/s, and the error of the numerical calculation result of the model is 1.42%. Through the numerical calculation of the theoretical model, it is found that rubber foot has a significant influence on the vibration characteristics of the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Temporal and Spatial Dynamics of Forests From 2003 to 2018
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper takes The Sejila Mountain area in Nyingchi City, Tibet province as the research object, studies and analyzes the land use/cover change and its driving factors in the past 15 years, and provides a technical basis for the rational use of sejila mountain land and for the land management department to formulate management policies and implement various management measures. Using landsat5-TM and Landsat8-oli remote sensing satellite images as data sources, spatial analysis method of transfer matrix and dynamic attitude of land use were used to analyze spatial-temporal dynamic changes of land in ArcGIS. At the same time, the driving force of woodland change was analyzed in combination with woodland change investigation in this area. In the past 15 years, the area of the Forest area of Sejila showed a trend of “increasing - decreasing - increasing”, but the overall phenomenon of area decreasing was shown. In space, there is a decrease from southeast to northwest. The main driving force of the change of forest land is the construction of industrial and commercial land and reclamation into farmland From 2003 to 2018, the land/cover change of Sierra Mountain was obvious, among which climate, population and urbanization level were the main driving factors of land/cover change of Segila.

articleTitle: Research on 3D rendering effect of substation based on OSG
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Substation 3D visualization is one of the important links to realize the digital transformation of China’s power grid. The existing 3D model engine is difficult to meet the real-time state dynamic display of many devices in the complex scene of substation. In this paper, an improved OSG 3D rendering engine for 3D visualization of substation is designed, and a dynamic data interaction method between 3D rendering engine and auxiliary equipment is proposed. The scene management function is optimized, and the optimized mapping and lighting effect models are selected. The experimental results show that the rendering effect of the engine designed in this paper is more real and gorgeous than ordinary OSG, and the processing efficiency is higher, which can meet the needs of 3D visualization display of substation.

articleTitle: Design of the Safe Operation Management and Control System of Ring Main Unit based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient management and control in the process of operation and maintenance of ring main unit in traditional power system, the systematic, real-time, safety and standardized management and control are not rigorous, the process control method of operation and maintenance of ring main unit is researched. Through the organic integration of Internet of Things equipment and the operation process of operation and maintenance, combing and improving the operation process of ring main unit, closed-loop management is realized. On this basis, a design method of safety management and control system for operation and maintenance of ring main unit based on Internet of Things technology is proposed which can improve the safety and standardization of ring main unit operation by intelligent means, ensure the safety of operators and realize the active prevention of safety risks.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of earthquake disaster assessment system under different intensity based on residential area
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Most of the existing earthquake disaster assessment systems take districts, counties or townships as evaluation units. Due to the lack of data accuracy, there is a big gap between the evaluation results and the actual losses. With the development of technology, the acquisition and update of residential data is more convenient and rapid. Compared with the evaluation system based on districts, counties or townships, the results of the evaluation system based on residential areas are more detailed and accurate. In this paper, the existing calculation model as the skeleton, ArcEngine as the GIS development platform, using C / S structure to design the seismic disaster assessment system under different intensity based on residential area. The system takes the residential area as the evaluation unit. According to the selected assessment area, the system evaluates the damage of buildings and casualties of earthquake disasters according to the five grades of VI, VII, VIII, IX and X. The results can provide technical support for governments at all levels and relevant departments to carry out regional earthquake risk assessment and earthquake disaster pre assessment.

articleTitle: Improved Numerical Integration Algorithm for Electrical Parameter Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The principle of improved numerical integration algorithm is introduced and the simulation on the algorithm has been carried out. The effects of the first sample point and frequency offset on the measurement accuracy have been analyzed in details. The performances of the improved numerical integration algorithm and conventional numerical integration algorithm have been compared. The simulation results come to the conclusion that the improved numerical integration algorithm has high accuracy in measuring voltage, current and active power. And the relative errors of the measurement results are within 0.02%.

articleTitle: Ensemble-Based Graph Model and Dense Reconstruction Error for Infrared Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, Ensemble-Based Graph Model and Dense Reconstruction Error for Infrared Target Detection algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the infrared image is constructed as a closed-loop by using the super-pixel segmentation. Then the saliency map of the target area and the corresponding part of the background are extracted respectively by using the graph model-based manifold ranking algorithm and the dense reconstruction error. And the fused result of the two saliency maps is insensitive to the background clutter interference, which can clearly locate the target area. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can suppress the background clutter interference and maintain the integrity of the target edge.

articleTitle: Context-based Fine Hierarchical Object Detection with Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: We present a method for object detection by adopting an agent that follows a fine hierarchical search strategy. The key idea of this strategy is that the agent detects the target on region proposals by analyzing the image information of the search region at each level. Start from the entire image, the agent detects the subregion that contains the object level by level until it confirms the target has been found. We model this process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) to use reinforcement learning to train the agent to learn the optimal strategy. By utilizing a hierarchical search strategy, we can avoid the generation of a large number of region proposals. Besides, we add the ReNet layer that extracts context information to improve the agent’s ability to understand the information conveyed by the image. The experiments we conducted have demonstrated the efficiency of our proposed method. Experiments demonstrate the efficiency of our proposed method, the agent only needs 2 or 3 steps to detect the target in images under most circumstances.

articleTitle: An efficient algorithm for high average utility itemset mining with buffered average utility-list
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: As a hot topic of association rule mining, high average utility itemset mining (HAUIM) provides a scientific measurement of an itemset’s utility, thus it can be adopted to find out the rules that are critically useful to the real applications. However, there is a prominent deficiencty in existing algorithms for HAUIM, a huge number of memory consumption are needed during the generation of high average utility itemset. Hence, an efficient algorithm called BAUL-Miner is proposed to solve the memory problem, in which a buffered average utility list with a more compact upper bound and two pruning strategies are introduced to reduce the searching space. Finally, detail experiments in synthetic and industrial datasets verify the effectiveness of BAUL-Miner, it outperforms traditional HAUIM algorithms in runtimes, memory consumption and scalability.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Chaotic Coupled Fractional-Order Memristive Neural Networks and Its Application in Image Protection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper concentrates on the synchronization issue for chaotic coupled fractional-order memristive neural networks (CFMNNs) with time-varying delay. A class of CFMNNs consisting of an isolated master subnetwork and several identical slave subnetworks with coupling term and controller is formulated and analyzed herein. Besides, a coupled feedback controller is designed to realize the complete synchronization of CFMNNs, and novel synchronization criteria are derived in terms of linear matrix inequalities. To illustrate the chaotic characteristics of the controlled CFMNNs, an image encryption scheme is designed based on the synchronization of chaotic CFMNNs. Numerical simulations are carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness and potential applications in image protection.

articleTitle: Anti-Interference Energy-Efficient Power Allocation for Ultra-Dense Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The energy-efficient (EE) power allocation is studied in the distributed multi-carrier ultra-dense networks (UDNs). A distributed anti-interference power allocation scheme is proposed so that each cell can independently maximize the EE using interference channel gains (ICGs) while suppressing the severe inter-cell interference. The multi-cell interaction is processed based on the non-cooperative game theory to achieve a Nash equilibrium of potential game. In order to solve the non-convex utility function in each best response process an accurate and low-complexity stair water-filling (SWF) algorithm is proposed under the QoS and maximum transmit power constraints. These constraints reduce the accuracy of the conventional Dinkelbach algorithm since its search process possibly exceed the feasible domain. Simulation results and numerical analysis show that the proposed scheme can improve the EE performance while guaranteeing good spectrum efficiency (SE) performance.

articleTitle: Hybrid Precoder Design for Millimeter Wave Massive MU-MIMO Systems with Low-Resolution Phase Shifters
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The study of hybrid precoder has been focused on the application of the low-resolution phase shifters (PSs) since they can reduce the power consumption of RF chains. In this paper a heuristic iteration algorithm is proposed to design hybrid precoder and combiner in mmWave massive MIMO systems to improve the PSs quantization performance using MMSE criterion. This heuristic algorithm first builds a cost function, which can continuously converge to the optimal solution of the quantized shifter phases with constant modulus constraints. Simulation results show that the proposed design of hybrid precoder can achieve significant performance with low-complexity in mmWave massive MIMO systems.

articleTitle: A hybrid approach using human posture and contour for gait recognition under body occlusion
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a hybrid method using a Gaitset network for gait recognition. We firstly use Alphpose model to obtain key points of human posture to improve the extraction of human contour under body occlusion. The human contour map is obtained by pose2Seg model with the key points of human posture. Both human posture and body contour are used as input of the network. By using the hybrid method, it can effectively improve the accuracy and robustness of gait recognition with the upper body information under occlusion. In scenes of human walking under body occlusion, our experimental results show that the accuracy of the proposed method in self-built database can reach 84.6% accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Two-Stage CMOS Operational Amplifier for Fluorescence Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Transimpedance amplifier is an important part of the signal processing circuit in the fluorescent optical fiber temperature sensor to amplify the current signal and convert it into a voltage one. The two-stage CMOS operational amplifier, which can be designed to achieve high gain, high CMRR and low input offset voltage, can be used in transimpedance amplifier circuits. Based on 0.18 $\mu$m CMOS process, a two-stage differential operational amplifier is designed in this paper. The simulation results show that the gain of the reaches 85.5dB, the CMRR and the negative PSRR are both around 90dB. The Miller compensation circuit in the circuit increases the gain bandwidth of the two-stage CMOS operational amplifier and makes the phase margin reach 80°. This paper introduces the circuit principle of CMOS two-stage operational amplifier in detail, and according to the simulation result, this operational amplifier meets the index requirement.

articleTitle: Decoding Method of the Cyclic Code Based on the Compressive Sensing Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: By the compressive sensing theory under the no noise condition, the compressive sensing model of the reconstructing error pattern E is proposed. The syndrome S is used as the measuring signals, the check matrix H is used as the measuring matrix, the error pattern E is reconstructed by the generalized orthogonal matching pursuit gOMP algorithm and the basis pursuit BP algorithm, then the value of the code word C is estimated. Taking the (9,3) cyclic code as example, it proves that the reconstructing error pattern E is correct. Taking the (7,1),(7,3), (7, 4), (9, 3) and (15,9) cyclic code as example, it proves that the correcting error capability of the cyclic code is correct. The simulation experiment of the cyclic code is designed, taking the (7,3),(9,3) and (15,11) cyclic code as example, the simulation experiment is completed. By the bit error rate and the success rate of the reconstructing code word C, the decoding effect of the gOMP algorithm and the basis pursuit BP algorithm and the maximum likelihood algorithm is analyzed and compared. The experiment result show that the cyclic code can be decoded well by the the gOMP algorithm and the BP algorithm based on the compressive sensing theory.

Author Keywords: Generalized Orthogonal Matching Pursuit gOMP algorithm

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Method based on VGGNet and Visual Saliency Map
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, infrared and visible image fusion task plays an important role in military and civilian applications. In this paper, a novel infrared and visible fusion method is proposed based on VGGNet and Visual Saliency Map to deal with the problem that loss of detail information and low brightness and contrast after traditional infrared and visible. Firstly, the source images are decomposed into low-frequency subbands and high-frequency subbands by Weighted Least Squares(WLS). Then, low-frequency subbands are fused by adopt an improved VSM weighted average strategy for adaptive fusion. While the high-frequency subbands are feed to the VGG-19 neural network to extract multi-layer features to generate weight map, and the high-frequency fusion are obtained by combining the l1-norm and the max selection strategy. Finally, the fused image will be reconstructed by combining the fused low-frequency subbands and high-frequency subbands parts. The experimental results show that the proposed fusion framework performances better than other typical fusion methods in both visual quality and objective evaluation.

articleTitle: Stackelberg Game-based Stock Transaction Model and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of the capital market of China, more and more market entities have begun to participate in the investment in the stock market. The game between different entities in the stock market has also become a popular topic. This paper established a model to analyze the game mechanism between stock manipulators and retail investors based on Stackelberg game theory. This paper also verifies the effectiveness of the proposed game model through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Identification of Microseismic Signals of Rock Mass Fracture in Mines
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The underground monitoring environment is more complicated, and the rock mass rupture signal is often mixed with various noises. How to identify and extract the rock failure signal are the basis of application research on microseismic monitoring technology. In order to solve this problem, a combined analysis method based on qualitative and quantitative analysis was proposed in the paper. Firstly, based on field tests and empirical judgment, significant regularity signals, such as electromagnetic pulse, artificial rock percussion, tramcar transportation, and multi-millisecond blasting, are filtered based on different characteristics in amplitude, phase and frequency; Secondly, the energy characteristics informations of signals which are difficult to distinguish using qualitative method, can be mapped to different frequency bands. These can be significantly showed under different resolutions, which were not obvious originally. Such as the energy distribution difference between underground secondary blasting signals and rock fracture signals: the energy of underground secondary blasting signals is concentrated in 250~500 Hz, accounting for about 69.24% of the total energy; when rock fracture signals are more obviously concentrated in 0~125 Hz, accounting for about 77.22% of the total energy. The research may offer new methods and ideas for the identification and analysis of microseismic signals.

articleTitle: PlayerNetVis: A Visual Analytics System for Evaluating NBA Player Performance Based on Network Topology
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With traditional statistical method such as point, rebound and assist, the self-worth of basketball player cannot be truly reflected in the original evaluation system. In this paper, combined with the structure characteristics of network topology established by passing path, passing quality and technical statistics, a novel visual evaluation model is proposed to redefine the indicator system of player performance and analyze the player’s tactical role in the team. A visual analytics system called PlayerNetVis is developed to analyze the real position and role of single player in team tactics, focus on the key moments of the whole game, compare and analyze the influence of players’ performance on game trend. Finally, the validity of the system in this paper is verified through the analysis of multiple set of cases.

articleTitle: Thermal analysis of high power red light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the 21st century, LEDs have been widely used in various fields, but due to the low external quantum efficiency, the junction temperature of LEDs is easily increased, and the increase in temperature will have a serious impact on the performance parameters of LEDs. Therefore, The research on the junction temperature and thermal resistance of LEDs is crucial for optimizing the performance of LEDs and improving luminous efficiency. In this paper, the forward voltage method is used to measure and calculate the junction temperature and thermal resistance of red LEDs. The junction temperature and thermal resistance of the LED were measured under the conditions of thermal silica gel and non-thermal silica gel with different heating currents. The result shows that the thermal silica gel can fill the gap between the LED and the constant temperature bath, reduce the generation of thermal resistance. The junction temperature and thermal resistance of the red LEDs increase with the increase of the driving current.

articleTitle: Analysis of Regenerative Chatter in Roll Grinding Process with Duffing Oscillator and Its Suppression
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Regenerative chatter that is the most common type of self-excited vibration is investigated in this paper. The kinetic model of roll grinding process made up of a workpiece and a grinding wheel with the Duffing Oscillator is proposed. The three degrees-of-freedom grinding model system contains two time delays derived from the regenerative chatter of the grindstone and the cylindrical roll. Based on the model, the impact of the width of cut on the regenerative chatter is studied and the stable boundary is plotted in parameter plane. Afterwards, the curves of time history and the bifurcation diagram are used to identify the behavior of dynamic system. The results show that the width of cut has a significant influence on chatter in grinding process. In the end, the velocity feedback is introduced to suppress the regenerative chatter, which has a great effect.

articleTitle: Structure optimization of four-electrode detector for CFRP damage detection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Due to the requirements for safe operation of aircraft, real-time and accurate structural health monitoring of aircraft composite materials is required. From the perspective of improving the accuracy of composite damage detection, this paper proposes a scanning four-electrode electrical impedance nondestructive test method based on five different electrode radius measurement modes. The finite element analysis software COMSOL is used to construct an anisotropic CFRP laminate model, and the five measurement modes are compared and evaluated from the perspective of measurement accuracy, and three different types of structural damage are simulated to compare and analyze the detection results. In order to verify the validity of the model, by scanning the detection model, the structure damage information is obtained for image reconstruction, and a model suitable for CFRP damage detection is obtained. The research results show that the 0.7mm electrode radius measurement mode is better when detecting scratch damage; the 1.3mm electrode radius measurement mode is better when detecting impact and delamination damage. This research improves the measurement electrode structure, improves the detection accuracy of composite material non-destructive testing, and provides a reliable technical foundation for aircraft maintenance personnel.

articleTitle: A Novel optimization Approach for Phased Array Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The beamforming (BF) technique is very important for the phased array antenna, which includes beam pointing direction, sidelobe level suppression, and nulls. In this paper, a new beamforming optimization method is proposed. We transform the problem of beamforming as solving a nonlinear multivariable optimization problem with constrained. The fmincon function in the MATLAB optimization toolbox is introduced here to search the optimal solution. Several numerical examples are presented to prove the effectiveness of the method. In addition, compared with the stochastic optimization methods such as genetic algorithm (GA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO), the proposed method is outperforming on beamforming.

articleTitle: A novel cluster head selection algorithm based on multiple criteria decision making for underwater sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Data gathering is the basis of monitoring applications in underwater sensor network, and excellent network coverage and data transmission reliability are the guarantees for the quality of monitoring tasks. However, the energy consumption of the nodes is too fast due to the heavy load of the cluster heads closer to the Sink when data is transmitted between cluster heads (CHs) and the Sink by multi-hop, which leads to an energy hole problem in an underwater sensor network of clustering technology. Aiming to address this problem, we propose a novel cluster head selection algorithm based on multiple criteria decision making (CHSA-MCDM) in underwater sensor network. The entire monitoring network is divided into many layers. For selecting a cluster head in each layer, multiple criteria decision making of intuitionistic fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and hierarchical fuzzy integration is adopted. Then, the simulation results show that CHSA-MCDM can not only effectively balance the energy consumption of the network and prolong the network lifetime, but improve network coverage and data gathering reliability as well.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Visual Analytics System of Network Security Situation Based on Multi-source Log
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Network security visualization takes advantage of the human perceptual and cognitive processes, provides an effective visual tool for analysts to understand the network status, find network anomalies, identify network attacks and solve other security problems. In this paper, with the help of visual analytics methods, uses its great advantages in network security analysis and massive data analysis, slices data in units of times, emphasizing network hierarchy, correlation, traffic timing analysis and collaborative interaction between views. A visual analytics system is developed to analysis the abnormal host asset communication, the abnormal analysis of database and user behavior and the analysis of abnormal traffic within 24 hours. Finally, the validity of the system in this paper is verified through the analysis of multiple set of cases.

articleTitle: Simulated Annealing-based Method to optimize Routing Paths for City-pair Airlines
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper, considering the path diversity of city-pair airlines, a simulated annealing-based framework is proposed to optimize the routing paths on air route network for each city-pair airline, such that the traffic congestion of air route network can be alleviated, where an elaborated method for perturbing solutions, named Selection after Remove (SAR), is adopted. Experimental results show that, compared with the default routing paths, shortest routing paths and random routing paths, the proposed routing paths optimization strategy can reduce the maximum traffic flows of air route network by 2.4%, 4.6% and 4.8%, respectively, which shows that the proposed optimization method is an effective way in alleviating the traffic congestion of air route network.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Dioxin Emission Concentration in MSW Incineration Process Based on Stochastic Configuration Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The increasing municipal solid waste has become one of the stubborn diseases of modern society. Incineration technology with the advantage of reduction and resource utilization is an important avenue to solve this problem. Toxic gases emitted from incineration not only pollute the environment but also pose a serious threat to human health. However, the complexity of incineration process brings great difficulty to the detection of pollutants concentration in the exhaust gases. In order to address the problem that the concentration of pollutants is difficult to predict, a prediction model of dioxin emission concentration based on stochastic configuration network is developed in this paper. The prediction model takes the online operation data of municipal solid waste incineration power plant as input parameters and realizes the online prediction of dioxin emission concentration. It provides a scientific basis for choosing the appropriate control strategy. When compared with BP neural network, RBF neural network and support vector machine prediction model, it is easily found that the proposed prediction model can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of dioxin emission concentration during the municipal solid waste incineration process.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Surface integrity in Precision Cutting of Ti6Al4V
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Ti6A14V alloy is widely used in military, biological and chemical fields. Therefore, the research on the surface integrity of Ti6A14V milling is highly concerned at home and abroad. In this paper, the influence of cutting parameters on surface integrity of Ti6A14V is studied, which provides experimental data reference for surface integrity control. The conclusions show that the cutting surface roughness, cutting force and surface residual stress decrease with the increase of spindle speed, and increase with the increase of feed rate and cutting depth. With increased of spindle speed, the milling temperature first decreases and then increases. With increased of feed rate and milling depth, the milling temperature gradually increased.

articleTitle: A Privacy-Preserving Energy Consumption Data Sharing Framework for Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the era of big data, smart grid utilities are seeking new opportunities to create profits by making use of in-hand power big data. However, these data, such as energy consumption data, power grid measurement data, etc., are often sensitive digital assets that cannot be directly shared to third parties or individual users. To meet this gap, in this paper we propose a Privacy-Preserving energy consumption Data Sharing framework (PPDS) for smart grids. In this framework, two Paillier-based algorithms are designed respectively to achieve privacy-preserving data acquisition and secure computation of the mean for energy consumption data in a specific period or regions. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed PPDS framework is efficient in privacy-preserving energy consumption data sharing.

articleTitle: Automatic Checking of Functional Closeness of Web service Composite System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: the function closure in Web service composite system is the premise to ensure the correct interaction of the system. This paper realized the automatic detection of function closure in Web service composite system. Firstly, the syntax and semantic interface of Web service is defined and parameter mapping is set up by using of semantic relationship among the parameters. Secondly, the mapping relationship of sending actions and receiving actions is established by merging the parameters of the same action in the same service. Finally, the functional closure of web service composition system can be determined by checking whether all the sending actions have corresponding receiving actions and the receiving parameters in each receiving action have corresponding sending parameters. The algorithms are designed to realize parameter mapping, action mapping and system function closure detection automatically. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example of network file system.

articleTitle: High Performance Convolutional Neural Network Accelerator Based on Design Space Exploration
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have achieved a wide range of applications in the field of computer vision. However, its large number of parameters and computation limits its deployment in embedded terminals. Designing dedicated CNN accelerators becomes an efficient way to solve the situation. In this paper, a basic access model of systolic accelerator is established to find the optimal design parameters for specific CNN structure. The experiment result shows that $14 \times16$ is the optimum size of processing element array for AlexNet and VGG16, which matches with the design parameters of accelerators with the same architecture.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Server Management Platform in Data Center
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the in-depth construction of the energy Internet of Things, the continuous and rapid development of cloud computing and edge computing, a large number of data centers will be deployed accordingly and the corresponding energy consumption will increase sharply. According to the actual production and operation needs of the power information system, this paper studies and designs a set of distributed server energy management platform for the data center based on the detailed demand analysis. Through the trial operation of this platform within the company, it can be seen that the platform can realize the dynamic collection and control of important indicators such as server temperature and power in the data center, so that operation and maintenance personnel can more reasonably and accurately manage the server business scheduling in the data center, while reducing the energy consumption of the data center and improving the energy efficiency management ability.

articleTitle: Compact L-band High Performance Self-bias GaN Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a compact high performance L-band GaN power amplifier. It uses a 3.6 mm gate width die for input and output matching. The circuit uses self-bias technology to realize single power supply. Finally, under the condition of 32V single power supply bias, 300 $\mu$s pulse width and 15% duty cycle, the output power of the amplifier is more than 20W, the gain is more than 15dB and the power additional efficiency(PAE) is more than 58% in the frequency band of 1.2 $\sim$ 1.4 GHz. The whole circuit is soldered in a 17.4mm $\times 24$ mm metal and ceramic package, which fully demonstrates the excellent performance of the self-bias L-band GaN power amplifier.

articleTitle: Fast Multi-output Regression Based on Piecewise Linear Approximation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In this paper a fast Multi-output Regression algorithm is implemented based on piecewise linear approximation (PLA). Maximum distance point splitting is used to fit lines piecewisely. Then the best knot set of linear segmentation is obtained. The independent variable X is divided into some linear intervals, which make it possible that linear regression is implemented in fast and accurate way. The knot set with the smallest error in all dimensions of dependent variable is used as the node partition scheme. The matrix of regression model is derived by the least square. The Experiment results prove that the algorithm achieves the performance of the state-of-the-art with predicting time below millisecond.

articleTitle: Temporal and Spatial Variation Characteristics of NDVI in Qamdo and the Relationship with Climate
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Vegetation, as an important part of terrestrial ecosystem, has a profound impact on ecological structure and function. In-depth understanding of the spatial and temporal evolution of vegetation characteristics and its relationship with climate, help to deepen understanding of the ecosystem structure, processes and functions, providing an important reference for the ecological protection and construction. Based on the NDVI data set from 1998 to 2018, and combined with the precipitation and average temperature data of meteorological stations in and around Qamdo, the trend analysis method, catastrophe test method, mean method, partial correlation analysis method and R/S analysis method were used to analyze the spatial-temporal dynamic characteristics of NDVI and their relationship with climate factors in Qamdo for 21 years. The results show that: (1) The NDVI in Qamdo region showed an upward trend from 1998 to 2018, with the improved region accounting for 33.09% of the total area, the degraded region accounting for 36.49%, and the basically unchanged region accounting for 30.42%. (2) NDVI has a negative correlation with annual precipitation and a positive correlation with air temperature. It shows that temperature is a significant climatic factor affecting vegetation coverage in Qamdo area.

articleTitle: The Applicability of Sensor Size in Inhomogeneous Electric Field Based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the power industry, accurate measurement of the electric field around the equipment is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of the power equipment. In inhomogeneous electric field space, the size of the sensor will affect its surface distortion electric field. In this paper, the influence of sensors of different sizes on the inhomogeneous electric field is studied, and ANSYS is used to simulate the size of the sensor and the inhomogeneous field in a narrow space. The peak electric field of the sensor surface and the calibration field are compared and analyzed, and the size of sensor is obtained under different electric field environments.

articleTitle: Automatic Docking Design of Flange Pipe Based on Spatial Information
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: With the development of ship industry, pipeline system has been more and more widely used. However, the pipeline site space is narrow. Mechanical and electrical equipments are of all kinds. The pipeline cable is densely distributed. All problems mentioned above seriously affects the pipeline construction. In order to solve the problem of pipeline docking, the method of making model and comprehensive lofting is usually adopted. However, this method is technically backward. The operation is inconvenient due to the narrow onsite space. The required period is long. With low information utilization and accuracy, the method of making model and comprehensive lofting has a great influence on the development cycle and design quality. In order to solve these problems, this paper presents a design method and system of flange pipe docking. A binocular camera is used to obtain the image of the pipe joint. The center position of the flange surface and array holes on the flange surface are extracted from the image, which is bias of subsequent work. First, the path of the intermediate connecting pipe is calculated. Then, according to the pipe standards of intermediate connection pipe and production specification of enterprise, the model of intermediate connecting pipe is automatically generated by using secondary development technology of CAD. In this paper, the binocular vision technology is combined with pipeline docking design, which significantly improves the utilization rate of field space information and design efficiency, and solves the problems of inconvenient operation and safety risk of traditional profiling method.

articleTitle: An Encoder-Decoder Network with Residual Convolution for Leukocyte Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The appearance analysis and counting of peripheral blood leukocytes can assist the diagnosis of blood diseases such as leukemia. Therefore, it is necessary to automatically extract leukocytes from blood smear images. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end peripheral blood leukocyte image segmentation method based on fully convolutional neural network, which can not only encode multi-scale contextual information, but also capture clear boundary information through decoding. Specifically, the proposed method first utilizes the context-aware feature encoder with residual convolutions to extract a set of multi-scale features. Then, a refinement module of parallel dilated convolutions with multiple dilation rates for expanding the receptive field of the feature maps is introduced to aggregate contextual information. Finally, clear prediction results are reconstructed by the context-aware feature decoder and skip connections. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method on two publicly available datasets.

articleTitle: Image Stitching Algorithm Based on Improved Harris Corners Extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved Harris corners extraction algorithm, which consists of coarse screening and fine screening in the corners extraction process. Firstly, image segmentation is used to find the redundant regions of feature points in the image. Secondly, the original image is divided into 3x3 blocks to separately deal with the response values of the Hession matrix of the corners contained in each block. Finally, for the corners in the three small blocks on the left of the figure, since they are the farthest from the overlapping area, only two corners with the largest response values are taken from each small block. Similarly, the corners in the middle three small blocks are required to take 20%-60% of the number of corners in each block, and the corners on the right three small blocks are required to take 90% of the number of corners in each block. After removing the redundant corners, the rest corners are the key feature points to be matched. Experimental results show that the algorithm proposed by this paper not only improves the operating speed, but also improves the registration accuracy by reducing the number of corners, so as to lay the foundation for subsequent image stitching.

articleTitle: A Co-Melting Reduction Auto-Encoder
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The auto-encoder has been widely used in deep learning techniques as one of the unsupervised feature extraction algorithms. This paper proposes a Co-Melting Reduction Auto-Encoder (CMRAE) model to enrich extracted and release the burden of model parameters in image feature extraction. Firstly, a co-melting reduction structure is designed to realize feature fusion in the encoder, and it can reduce feature loss and model parameters in the decoder. Secondly, a multi-reconstruction loss function introduces reconstruction loss between feature layers, which can strengthen the connection between the feature layers and avoid the model premature effectively. The experiments prove that CMRAE can improve the feature extraction ability and efficiency of the model. The classification accuracy of features extracted by CMRAE is better than the state-of-the-art results on the datasets including Cats vs. Dogs (CvD), lung CT images, and multi-class weather (MWD).

articleTitle: Multi-LoD Surface Reconstruction Using Stratified Contour Extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The three-dimensional point cloud obtained by laser scanning has a wide range of applications in fields such as surveying and mapping engineering. Surface reconstruction is a key step of transforming the scanned point cloud into a finally usable model. Using the stratified point cloud, a new method of contour reconstruction and multi-LoD (level of detail) expression is proposed in this paper. The proposed method is able to achieve the contour expression under the specified level of detail. The proposed method belongs to the step-by-step refinement method, which indicates that a complete model is not required before simplification. The generated contours are consistent with the definition of concave hull in computer graphics. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the existing methods in reconstruction effect and efficiency.

articleTitle: An Improved Convolutional Neural Network and Its Applications to Image Super Resolution
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper studies an improved convolutional neural network application in the image super-resolution problem. On the traditional super-resolution model, we improve the model framework, the upsampling method and the network design. And through the experiment of traditional super-resolution convolution neural network with improved super-resolution convolution neural network and compare the effect of the reconstruction image, it is concluded that the improved super-resolution network model compared with super-resolution in higher PSNR and better visual effect, stronger image resolution.

articleTitle: High Resolution Remote Sensing Image Classification Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Optimized BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The classification efficiency and accuracy of high resolution remote sensing image classification method based on BP neural network or Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) optimized BP (PSO-BP) neural network are affected because the weight threshold parameter convergence of BP neural network is slow, and the inertia weight and learning factor of standard PSO are fixed. In order to solve these problems, a classification method based on Improved Particle Swarm optimization (IPSO) optimized BP (IPSO-BP) neural network for high resolution remote sensing image is proposed, which the inertia weight and learning factor of PSO can change linearly and dynamically with the increase of iteration times. The classification model is constructed by using the digital matrix and color feature vector of remote sensing image as input and output training. The optimal weight threshold obtained by iterative optimization of IPSO is directly assigned to BP neural network, and then the remote sensing image classification is realized. The experimental results show that, compared with the maximum likelihood, support vector machine, object-oriented nearest neighbor, BP neural network, and PSO-BP neural network remote sensing image classification methods, the proposed method has significantly improved the classification accuracy of single category, overall classification accuracy and kappa coefficient, reflecting the good classification effect.

Author Keywords: high resolution remote sensing image classification

articleTitle: Resolving energy hole problem based on unequal cluster size in heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Energy hole problem is one of the most important hot spots of the academic research in Wireless Sensor Networks. The proposed strategies of clustering focus on heuristically determining the cluster size rather than obtaining the optimal cluster radius for Wireless Sensor Networks and fall short in the application requirement of time-sensitive. To overcome these limitations, in this paper, the strategy of resolving energy hole with unequal cluster radius is proposed on basis of time-sensitive in heterogeneous WSNs. Firstly, we formulate the optimal model of non linear programming problem accorded with the requirements of network lifetime and latency-time in heterogeneous network model. Then, NLP problem is simplified by Lagrange-Newton method in order to prove that there is a feasible solution for the optimal model. In succession, an effective algorithm to obtain the optimal solutions of cluster radius is proposed after analyzing the characteristics of this optimal model theoretically so that it can be good practice guidance for deployment of heterogeneous WSNs. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the performance advantages of our strategy.

articleTitle: Petri Net Model Predictive Control Method For Manufacturing Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: A method of optimal schedule and control of AGVs in manufacturing systems is presented in this paper. Taking into account high complexity of manufacturing systems, it is difficult to search evolution states for an optimal schedule strategy. A model predictive control (MPC) method based on timed Petri net (TPN) is proposed. By predicting next step of AGVs, it can be utilized to quickly and effectively guide AGVs to complete given tasks, in turn to make multi-type tasks of a manufacturing system be performed by smartly schedule devices. In the meanwhile, numerical experiments are carried out to verify the proposed MPC algorithm.

articleTitle: DSP Fast Processing Technology Based on BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Image recognition has always been an important research topic in the field of pattern recognition. This article uses the printed character recognition of bills as the research background. Through the detailed analysis of the recognition process, some preprocessing algorithms are selected and implemented, including image enhancement, binarization, filtering, character cutting, skew correction, etc. Finally, transplant each algorithm to the simulation platform, mainly for BP algorithm, according to the characteristics of DSP, optimize from two aspects of compilation options and source code to meet the requirements of fast processing. Finally, the requirements of better recognition effect and fast processing speed are realized.

articleTitle: Research on Node Collaboration Mode Based on Mixed Meta-path
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: To solve the problem of Collaborative Pattern Mining in heterogeneous networks, we propose a collaborative pattern mining model based on mixed meta-path for heterogeneous networks. According to the heterogeneous network structure and information, multiple meta-paths are extracted, and the multiple meta-paths extracted are fused and analyzed. Then, random walk strategy is used to generate a large number of sequences. Frequent item-sets are extracted by the sequences in FP algorithm, and the collaborative patterns of nodes in the network are analyzed. The experimental analysis was carried out in two public data sets, tmdb5000 and DBLP, to verify the validity and scalability of the model.

articleTitle: Effect of Friction on Dynamic Fit of Injection Mechanism of Squeeze Casting Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In the process of squeeze casting, the clearance between the shot sleeve and the punch is constantly changing, which results in the friction between the punch and the shot sleeve. The friction has a great influence on the quality of the casting and the service life of the equipment, so this study aims to find out the mechanism of friction. A friction coupling numerical analysis model in squeeze casting was established and verified by the actual experiment. Simulation and experiment results indicated that the friction coupling model is effective, which reflects the actual squeeze casting process more accurately.

articleTitle: A Novel Consensus Evaluation by an APP for Suppressing Bad Driving
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In order to suppress bad driving, this paper presents a framework which through an APP for users easily to get the pictures and score them of indicated bad behavior cars or violators, on consensus evaluation mechanism to obtain an open cars’ credit-like score, named as civilized-score. The score can be broadly applied on traffic management and social activities, such as in enforcement, insurance business and used car markets. This proposal is a bright new traffic management system for upgrading civil quality and traffic safety. The paper except involving data acquisition, computing algorithm, a novel methodology applied by fuzzy membership with Recursive Deep Learning (RDL) is introduced, which to accomplish the consensus evaluation procedure and outcome the civilized-score. This humanization mechanism is a pioneer proposal in the world. Based on the task experience, we found such a social power can suppress driver’s bad-manner, and improve traffic safety.

articleTitle: Bounding Box Repairing Algorithm for Underwater Object Detection Based on IoU Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning based methods have achieved excellent performance in standard object detection. However, these methods lack sufficient capabilities to handle underwater object detection due to these challenges: (1) underwater images have color shift and low contrast, and (2) various noises (sediments, bubbles, etc.) would cause blurring in underwater images. To address these problems, our work investigates optimization policies to detect low-contrast and blurred mine. We propose a bounding box repairing algorithm based on Intersection over Union (IoU) optimization. The algorithm mainly optimizes Mask Scoring R-CNN network. Firstly, we use the Mask Scoring R-CNN model to generate the coarse-grained detection results of mines. Secondly, we perform IoU between the coarse-grained boxes and the annotated boxes in the dataset to obtain the best matching area. Finally, we use the best matching area to repair the coarse-grained boxes. Experimental results show that our method achieves promising object detection and localization performance in underwater environment.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of GNSS System Time Offset during GNSS Modernization
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: The rapid development of Global Satellite Navigation System (GNSS) not only provides more available satellites to the global GNSS users, but also accelerates the GNSS compatibility and interoperability. Currently, GNSS system time offset monitoring system at the National Time Service Centre has been upgraded. The system time of four GNSS can be monitored, which are BDS, GPS, GLONASS, and Galileo. First, the background and status of the four major GNSS are discussed. Then, monitoring principle of GNSS system time offset by receiving signal-in-space (SIS) and the handling methods of key parameters are introduced. Finally, monitoring results are analysed, which lasted 201 days. The results show that: during test period, 1) BDS time (BDT) and Galileo time (GST) have changed more than 10ns; 2) At the same epoch, there is certain deviation among the monitoring results of different BDS signals; 3) There is time offset about 10.01ns between monitoring results of BDS-2 and BDS-3 by dual-frequency signal (B1I/B3I); 4) The monitoring results’ stability of BDS dual-frequency signal is better than single-frequency signal.

articleTitle: A Real-time Tracking System Used for Surface Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: In industrial production, the high speed of object on conveyor always causes motion blur when computer vision is used to achieve appearance inspection, results in difficulties in image processing. In this study, a real-time tracking system based on cam transmission was applied to eliminate the relative movement between camera and objects. The outline of the cam was specifically designed to meet the requirement of real-time tracking and simplified the motor control. To test the system, the velocities of both camera and object were collected using rotary encoders. It was found that the camera velocity would be almost equal to that of object in a certain period when cam rotated uniformly. Also, the images were captured by triggering the camera at the suitable moment, and it was shown that the object in image was very clear. Compared with conventional restoration algorithms, the proposed method resulted in clearer images without any distortion, and could save computation time, which was especially suitable for on-line inspection in industrial production such as boards.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Hyperledger Fabric Retrofitted by SM2/3/4
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
