abstract: The underlying cryptography suite of Hyperledger Fabric only supports international cryptographic algorithm, and does not support Chinese commercial cryptographic algorithm SM2/3/4, which prevents the promoting of Hyperledger Fabric in China. To further promote the application of Hyperledger Fabric in China, we retrofit the underlying cryptography suite of Fabric v1.4.3 by Chinese commercial cryptographic algorithm SM2/3/4, called Fabric-SM, and then evaluate the performance of Fabric v1.4.3 and Fabric-SM in various aspects, such as transaction throughput, execution time and transaction latency. The experimental results show that the performance of Fabric-SM is close to that of Fabric v1.4.3. Without any degradation in performance, Fabric-SM fully meets the requirements of Chinese government on the legality of cryptography. In a word, developers can develop various applications of Permissioned Blockchain based on Fabric-SM under the condition of safety and legality.

articleTitle: An Improved TurboEdit Cycle-Slip Detection Method for Ground-based High-precision Local Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Ground-based High-precision Local Positioning System(GH-LPS) is a new type of ground-based navigation system. In order to solve the cycle slip problem of carrier phase measurement during high-precision positioning, an improved method of cycle slip detection and repair based on TurboEdit was proposed in this paper after analyzing various cycle slip detection methods and combining the relevant conditions of GH-LPS. Adaptive sliding windows is used to enhance detection capabilities of MW combination in data quality changing dramatically. The pseudo-range smoother is used to attenuate the effect of pseudo-range measurement noise on GF combination. A large number of simulation and experimental results show that the improved TurboEdit method has a significantly lower probability of missed detections and false alarms than the other widly used cycle slip detection methods. After the cycle slips were repaired, positioning accuracy will be improved by about 70%.

articleTitle: The Information Center Internet of Vehicles (IoV) Cache Service Strategy Based on Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: This paper studies the cache service strategy of Internet of vehicles based on edge computing, and proposes a cache storage algorithm based on node core degree. The algorithm uses the node core degree to evaluate the contribution of network nodes in the Internet of vehicles cache communication service. RSU obtains node core degree by analyzing its own vehicle access number and topology information, carries out statistics on content popularity, classifies content popularity and RSU core degree, and then pushes popular content to the edge of network. Simulation results and performance analysis show that the cache storage algorithm based on node core can improve the cache hit rate and also shorten the average request time.

articleTitle: A Large-scale Access Scheme for Internet of Things Based on Distributed Queuing
publicationTitle: 2020 7th International Conference on Information Science and Control Engineering (ICISCE)
abstract: Internet of Things will be one of the most important application scenarios of the future 5G technology. However, the competition solution mechanism of the traditional cellular network cannot satisfy the large-scale access demand. Under the traditional scheme, when there are too many devices switched in the stability of the whole system will be impaired, thus causing serious congestion and making it hard to guarantee the service quality. Concerning the above problems, this paper proposes a large-scale access scheme for Internet of Things that is based on the distributed column and the tree-splitting algorithm. Simulation results suggest that, when a large number of devices have the request of access, the access scheme proposed by this paper can reasonably balance the access time delay, access success rate, and other indexes.
